data.jd_text:
**Together we make the difference**
 We are a leading provider of innovative and high\-performance solutions for airport logistics. Our portfolio includes products and solutions for baggage and cargo handling, high\-end software for the digitalization of logistics processes as well as an extensive range of maintenance and services. Major customers include renowned airports and airlines around the globe.
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced
 **Director of Project Execution** 
 who will
 **report directly to the Executive Management** 
 and oversee multiple airport BHS and MHS projects. You will provide guidance and leadership to the Project Execution and Site Management teams, foster collaboration across internal functions and external stakeholders, and ensure projects are delivered safely, on\-time, on\-budget, contract compliant, and to the required quality through to handover.
   

  

**What are my responsibilities?**
* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of airport BHS/MHS programs, ensuring safe, on\-budget, contract\-compliant execution.
* Serve as senior client and stakeholder lead, aligning airport authorities/operators, consultants/PMCs, contractors, and internal teams.
* Own the full lifecycle from engineering coordination through installation, integration, testing, commissioning, ORAT, and handover to Service.
* Drive strong project governance (steerco, reviews, workshops), ensuring clear decisions, actions, and follow\-up.
* Manage portfolio performance across multi\-site/multi\-country matrix teams; control KPIs, risk, change, and escalations, including recovery/turnaround.
* Ensure effective site execution in live airport environments, including M\&E installation, upgrades, brownfield works, and system interface management.
* Ensure completeness and quality of technical/contract documentation and reporting across the project lifecycle.
* Lead successful handovers to Life\-Cycle Services, ensuring continuity, training, spares, warranty transition, and sign\-off.
* Support Sales \& Bid activities to develop opportunities and ensure executable delivery strategies and resourcing inputs.
* Build and lead high\-performing teams through coaching, accountability, and continuous improvement.


**What do I need to qualify for the role?**
* 10\+ years delivering complex engineering/automation/site projects; strong ownership of cost, schedule, quality, and safety.
* Proven leadership in multi\-stakeholder environments with strong client\-facing and executive communication capability.
* Strong experience in airport BHS or MHS systems including site execution and commissioning; ORAT exposure is a plus.
* Solid understanding of automation integration environments (mechanical/electrical, PLC/SCADA/controls, interfaces).
* Strong commercial and contractual discipline: change control, risk/opportunity management, claims awareness.
* Proficient in project tools (e.g., MS Project/Primavera, MS Office; Jira/Confluence is a plus).
* Willingness to travel and operate in dynamic airport environments.
* Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.

**Location:** 
 Dubai, UAE (Hybrid)
   

  

**Reports to:** 
 Global PMO Lead
   

  

**About The Role**
 This role exists to help build and embed a fit\-for\-purpose PMO capability for the Emerging Markets (EM) business, enabling disciplined execution of innovation and portfolio priorities at pace and with quality.
   

  

 As Flora Food Group continues to scale consumer\-led innovation across regions, the Emerging Markets business requires stronger orchestration across Marketing, R\&D, Supply Chain, Finance and Operations. The PMO Manager will act as a foundational builder of this capability: setting up robust ways of working, driving executional discipline, and ensuring projects land on time, in full, and with clear accountability.
   

  

 This role is critical to reducing execution risk, improving speed\-to\-market, and freeing up functional leaders to focus on content and decision\-making rather than coordination.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 Operating at the intersection of strategy and execution, you will help establish an Emerging Markets PMO operating/ framework model aligned to global P\&P / PMO standards, while tailored to local business realities.
   

  

 You will bring consistency, transparency and rigor to how innovation and portfolio initiatives are planned, governed and delivered, and act as the single point of truth for execution status, risks and delivery confidence across the EM innovation and portfolio agenda.
   

  

 You will act as the executional backbone for end\-to\-end project \& activity management, by owning the planning and orchestration of priority innovation and portfolio initiatives, ensuring cross\-functional teams’ ownership and accountability to deliver against clear timelines, milestones and decision gates.
   

  

 You will improve delivery confidence, resource visibility and decision quality across the EM portfolio by ensuring high\-quality data, discipline and follow\-through in portfolio \& project management systems. You will act as a role model for execution discipline, pragmatic problem\-solving and collaborative leadership; and you will help to build the EM PMO capability over time, including a small team, templates/tools, playbooks and best practices, as the EM hub scales.
   

  

**What This Role Is (and Is Not)**
 You will be
 **accountable for execution and orchestration** 
 , not for project content ownership. Project leadership and strategic direction will remain with the Marketing / Business leads; this role ensures the work lands.
   

  

 You are biased toward action, clarity and simplification — not to add bureaucracy.
   

  

**What Does It Take To Be Successful**
 You combine strong project management fundamentals with the confidence to operate in complex, cross\-functional FMCG environments. You are comfortable building structure where it does not yet exist, and you bring calm, clarity and momentum to ambiguous situations.
   

  

* 5–10\+ years’ experience in project, program or PMO roles within FMCG / CPG or similarly complex environments
* Experience acting as owner of PMO data quality, reporting cadence and execution dashboards in enterprise environments
* Strong systems thinker with the ability to design simple, scalable ways of working, with proven experience setting up or scaling PMO / project management structures
* Hands\-on experience managing end\-to\-end innovation, transformation or portfolio initiatives.
* Strong understanding of stage\-gate models, innovation lifecycles and launch readiness
* Confident facilitator and communicator with experience in influencing senior and cross\-functional stakeholders without direct authority
* Excellent planning, prioritization, execution discipline, high accountability mindset comfortable holding others to commitments and follow\-through for continuous improvement
* Values transparency, pragmatic, solution\-oriented, resilient under pressure and energised by building capability and enabling others to succeed
* Preferred, but not required: PMP, PRINCE2, Agile / SAFe certification.


**What’s next?**
**Flora Food Group** 
 is committed to culinary essentials for better food. We believe fewer, better ideas — executed with excellence — are what drive sustainable growth.
   

  

 This is a career\-defining opportunity to work with our high\-impact brands in a high\-energy, high\-accountability environment. If you recognise yourself in this profile, apply and be part of this exciting journey. Apply now at www.florafoodgroup.com.We prefer to receive your application before
 **25th June 2026** 
 .
   

  

 We understand your resume might not be up to date and recommend that you apply with what you have or your LinkedIn Profile. Flora Food Group is dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workplace, we understand that you might not meet all the requirements stated in the description, but we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be the right candidate for this role or other roles.
   

  

*Flora Food Group is an employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace and equal opportunities for all. We recruit based only on values, qualifications, performance, skills, behaviours, experience, and knowledge. We ensure job advertisements are free from unintentional bias.*
*No personal characteristics should be a barrier to joining Flora Food Group. We prohibit discrimination and harassment based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or other personal characteristics.*

**Job Description**
 As the PMO, you will be the central focal point for the COO to monitor, track, and synchronize all cross\-departmental efforts. Your primary mission is to optimize the Payment Integration Lifecycle and manage the high\-stakes intersection of Product, Engineering, Sales, and Compliance. You will turn strategic vision into a structured, visible, and predictable execution roadmap.
   

  

**Job Requirements**
* Experience: 5\+ years in Project/Program Management, with 3\+ years specifically in Fintech, Payments, or Orchestration, 1\+ years in Leading 2\+ members team.
* Technical Literacy: Strong understanding of API\-based architectures, Webhooks, and Payment Flow Logic.
* Tools: Expert\-level mastery of Jira/Confluence and specialized PMO software.
* Location Awareness: Familiarity with the fintech ecosystem. And willngness to get into a new locations and learn.
* Strong proficiency in integrating AI tools into daily workflows to drive efficiency, quality, and innovation
* Education: Degree in Business, Engineering, or Computer Science. PMP, PRINCE2, or Agile certifications are highly preferred.


**Job Responsibilities**
**Strategic Oversight \& COO Support**
* The Focal Point: Serve as the "Single Source of Truth" for the COO, providing a consolidated view of all global projects.
* Executive Reporting: Design and maintain real\-time dashboards (Jira/Monday/Tableau) that track project health, resource utilization, and delivery velocity.
* Cross\-Functional Orchestration: Lead weekly synchronization meetings between Department Heads to resolve dependencies and resource conflicts.


**Integration \& Product Delivery**
* Payment Pipeline Management: Own the end\-to\-end lifecycle of new PSP/Bank integrations—from initial API documentation review to Production Go\-Live.
* Process Engineering: Standardize the "Integrations Playbook" to reduce Time\-to\-Market for new payment rails.
* Agile Governance: Partner with Engineering and Product leads to ensure sprint capacity matches commercial priorities.


**Operational Excellence**
* Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify "at\-risk" projects and provide the COO with remediation options (Trade\-offs, Resource shifts).
* Compliance Alignment: Ensure all projects meet the regulatory  standards of PCI DSS, PSD2 and any specific jurisdiction requirements.


**Job Benefits**
* Competitive salary package aligned with experience and market standards.
* Medical Insurance starting from day 1\.
* Access to training resources and development opportunities that support your professional growth.
* Well\-stocked office with snacks, drinks, and refreshments available daily.
* A multinational organisation that promotes a strong, collaborative culture
* Regular team\-building events and company activities that strengthen collaboration across teams.
* Employee Recognition Program celebrating our "Employee of the Month" with special perks.

data.jd_text:
**Head of Transformation (Project Lifecycle Management)** 




  





**About the Role** 




 We are seeking an experienced Head of Transformation to lead a large\-scale enterprise transformation programme across a complex project and real estate portfolio. This is a strategic leadership role responsible for driving end\-to\-end business transformation across project delivery, commercial operations, governance, financial management, handover, and operational readiness.
 



  





 The successful candidate will own the transformation vision, business case, value realisation, and adoption strategy, ensuring measurable business outcomes through the implementation of standardised processes, governance frameworks, and technology\-enabled ways of working.
 



 This role is focused on transforming how projects are delivered and managed across the organisation—not simply implementing systems or managing programme governance.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Define and lead the transformation vision, strategy, and business case across the project lifecycle.
* Drive measurable business outcomes including improved governance, compliance, cost control, schedule performance, transparency, and operational efficiency.
* Lead the design and implementation of future\-state operating models and standardised ways of working.
* Champion organisational change and user adoption across multiple business functions and stakeholder groups.
* Partner with executive leadership to secure alignment, influence decision\-making, and resolve cross\-functional challenges.
* Develop and manage a multi\-year transformation roadmap, balancing business priorities, value delivery, and organisational readiness.
* Oversee delivery through programme, platform, integration, and change management teams.
* Ensure successful coordination between business and technology functions, including enterprise platforms and integrated systems.
* Build and lead high\-performing transformation, product, and change teams capable of sustaining long\-term organisational capability.
* Manage external partners and vendors to ensure delivery against agreed timelines, budgets, and business outcomes.



  





**Required Experience** 



* 12–18\+ years of experience leading large\-scale enterprise transformation programmes.
* Proven track record delivering measurable business value through organisational transformation and change initiatives.
* Experience leading multi\-year, cross\-functional transformation programmes at enterprise scale.
* Strong change management and adoption leadership, with demonstrated success driving behavioural and process change.
* Ability to influence C\-suite stakeholders and navigate complex organisational environments.
* Strong commercial acumen with experience balancing priorities, risks, and business outcomes.

data.jd_text:
**Job Location:** 
 Dubai, UAE
   

  

 Whiteshield is a global policy advisory and AI economics firm known for our ability to respond to global challenges rapidly and incisively. We use the most advanced tools and technology and combine them with our team of leading international experts to engage decision\-makers in tackling society's most significant challenges. We are recognized for our rapid decision support, innovation, data science algorithms and deep policy expertise. We are specialists in "connecting the dots" between policy, business and technology.
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced and driven
 **Digital Delivery Manager** 
 to join Whiteshield to become an integral part of our delivery organization. This role will be instrumental in establishing governance frameworks and driving excellence across our complex digital and policy initiatives. This Digital Delivery Manager should have very strong experience in project and program management, ideally with deep expertise in Agile methodologies and digital product delivery to complement our technical and policy teams.
   

  

 This is a role with a lot of responsibility and the potential to make a true impact \- on our delivery capability, within the business, and on government across the globe. We look for entrepreneurial people that want to make their mark on the world, and we empower and reward our staff accordingly. There is a lot of room for creativity and big ideas that shift the status quo. We are constantly delivering large new features and complex initiatives.
   

  

 You will report to our Principals and Partners working across all of our cross\-functional delivery teams, closely collaborating with product managers, developers, UI/UX designers, data scientists, business analysts, and QA teams.
   

  

**Who You Are**
 Entrepreneurial and ambitious, with your own perspective and ideas, and with an eagerness to contribute to the success of the organization's delivery excellence.
   

  

 Highly independent and self\-motivated, with strong leadership skills and a get\-things\-done attitude to deliver results.
   

  

 Passion for the public good and eagerness to make a societal impact with their work, ideally with a particular interest in economic development, workforce development, and education.
   

  

 Highly organized and eager to push the boundary on delivery excellence and really rethink traditional project management approaches.
   

  

 Eager to work in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment that challenges you to excel.
   

  

 Detail\-oriented with high standards for quality and governance.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**End\-to\-End Project Leadership:** 
 Lead end\-to\-end planning, execution, and closure of complex digital and policy projects from inception through delivery.
   

  

**PMO Governance:** 
 Establish and enforce PMO governance, delivery standards, and reporting frameworks across all projects to ensure consistency and quality.
   

  

**Cross\-Functional Coordination:** 
 Coordinate and drive cross\-functional delivery teams including product, data science, data engineering, AI and BI development to achieve project objectives.
   

  

**Stakeholder Interface:** 
 Act as the primary interface between business stakeholders, executive leadership, and technical teams to ensure alignment and transparency.
   

  

**Product Delivery Oversight:** 
 Govern the design, development, validation, and deployment of digital products to ensure they meet quality standards and business requirements.
   

  

**Analytics \& Reporting:** 
 Ensure effective visualization and consumption of insights through Live Jira dashboards and related analytics platforms for real\-time project visibility.
   

  

**Toolset Management:** 
 Manage project delivery using Jira, Confluence and Azure\-based toolsets, ensuring transparency, traceability, and control across all initiatives.
   

  

**Risk \& Issue Management:** 
 Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate project risks, issues, and dependencies to keep projects on track.
   

  

**Scope \& Schedule Control:** 
 Monitor and control scope, schedule, and benefits realization across concurrent initiatives to ensure successful outcomes.
   

  

**Quality Assurance:** 
 Ensure quality and consistency of deliverables through formal reviews and adherence to Whiteshield standards.
   

  

**Executive Reporting:** 
 Provide clear, concise, and regular status reporting to senior stakeholders and steering committees.
   

  

**Resource Optimization:** 
 Optimize resource planning, capacity management, and prioritization across multiple workstreams to maximize efficiency.
   

  

**Requirements**
* Exceptional analytical, critical thinking, and problem\-solving skills
* Multiple years of experience in project/program management and PMO leadership, preferably in a dynamic, high\-growth and highly innovative environment
* Proven successful experience in delivering complex digital products and technology initiatives from scratch
* Proficiency with relevant tooling (such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, and analytics platforms)
* Professional certifications such as PMP, PMI\-ACP, PRINCE2, or Agile certifications (Scrum Master, SAFe, etc.)
* Strong understanding of Agile, Scrum, and hybrid delivery methodologies with experience adapting frameworks to organizational needs
* Experience with data\-driven decision making and building dashboards/reporting frameworks for executive visibility
* Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to multitask and resilience to meet deadlines and manage stressful situations
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills and experience with stakeholder management at all levels


**Benefits**
**Inclusive by Design**
 At Whiteshield, we champion equal opportunities \- not just in principle, but in practice. We believe the best ideas grow in spaces where every voice is respected, and every background adds value. Our inclusive culture empowers all team members to bring their whole selves to work, knowing their perspectives are welcomed and their contributions matter.
   

  

**Celebrate the Climb**
 We don't just notice high performance \- we reward it. Whether it's through career advancement or peer recognition, we celebrate those who push boundaries and raise the bar. Your growth is our priority.
   

  

**Flexible, Human\-Centered Work**
 We understand that ambition and wellbeing go hand in hand. That's why we offer flexible working models and a culture that values balance, autonomy, and trust. Whether you're recharging or reaching new heights, we want you to thrive \- both inside and outside the office.
   

  

**Impact with Purpose**
 At Whiteshield, your work drives real change. From shaping national labour strategies to advising global climate policy, we work on challenges that matter. For professionals who want their career to stand for something, this is your platform to make it count.
   

  

**Global Mindset**
 Join an international network of economists, data scientists, policy advisors, and strategists \- all collaborating across borders with a shared mission. Expect sharp minds, open conversations, and a genuine team spirit.

* About Arada


 Founded in 2017 and headquartered in Sharjah, UAE, Arada was created to build spaces that inspire, connect, and enrich communities. As one of the region’s fastest\-growing master developers, Arada has delivered landmark residential, retail, hospitality, and lifestyle destinations that redefine modern living.
   

  

 At Arada, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We foster a collaborative, innovative, and high\-performance culture where talented professionals are empowered to make a meaningful impact on the communities we create.
   

  

**Role Purpose**
 Act as the central operational link and technical attaché to the Project Controls Director, driving portfolio\-wide data consolidation, cross\-functional stakeholder coordination, and executive reporting from the Head Office. This role is responsible for standardizing reporting frameworks across all high\-rise and master development sites, monitoring design and procurement trackers, and developing C\-suite presentations, serving as the strategic right\-hand support for all departmental operations.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Portfolio Data Consolidation \& Reporting Governance
* Central Database Management: Establish and maintain the department's central project controls database, ensuring seamless data harvesting and consolidation from all project sites.
* Reporting Standardization: Design, implement, and enforce standardized weekly and monthly reporting templates across contractors, consultants, and internal project teams to ensure consistency, accuracy, and transparency.
* Periodic Audit \& Review: Conduct rigorous reviews of incoming site reports, cross\-verifying contractor progress claims against actual site conditions and flagging critical path anomalies, schedule risks, and reporting inconsistencies directly to the Project Controls Director.
* Cross\-Functional Stakeholder Coordination (Pre\-Contract Tracks)
* Design \& Procurement Tracking: Establish, manage, and continuously update comprehensive trackers and dashboards for pre\-construction activities, with a strong focus on design development, authority approvals, procurement milestones, and package award schedules.
* Internal Stakeholder Interface: Coordinate directly with Development Managers, Design Directors, and Procurement leads to resolve scheduling conflicts and ensure pre\-contract deliverables align with planned construction commencement dates.
* Master Program Development: Support the Project Controls Director in developing, maintaining, and logic\-linking portfolio\-level master programs that integrate design, permitting, tendering, procurement, and construction activities.
* Executive Analytics \& C\-Suite Presentations
* Dashboard Management: Maintain and oversee the department’s live Power BI and ERP\-based dashboards, transforming complex project, commercial, and schedule data into meaningful performance indicators and executive\-level insights.
* Executive Presentation Development: Consolidate portfolio\-wide progress updates, schedule risks, delay exposures, and cost\-related insights into professional, structured presentations and briefing materials for the CDO, CFO, CEO, and Executive Leadership Team.
* Special Briefings \& Ad\-Hoc Analytics: Act as an operational extension of the Project Controls Director by conducting deep\-dive analyses, forensic schedule reviews, and focused data audits on critical or distressed project packages as required.
* Site\-HO Bridging \& Compliance Enforcement
* Site Coordination: Maintain close engagement with embedded site planning teams, consultants, and contractors to ensure real\-time visibility of progress, risks, and emerging critical path delays.
* Process Enforcement: Audit planning and reporting compliance across all projects, ensuring schedule networks, baseline updates, milestone reporting, and delay notifications adhere strictly to Arada’s Project Controls Manual and governance requirements.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
**Education**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline.
* PMP or PMI\-SP (Scheduling Professional) certifications are highly advantageous.


**Experience**
* 7–10 years of progressive project planning and scheduling experience within the UAE real estate, developer, or construction sector.
* A balanced background is essential, including:
+ Minimum 3–4 years of hands\-on site\-based construction planning and execution experience.
+ Minimum 3–4 years within a Head Office PMO, Project Controls, or Developer corporate environment.

* Proven experience supporting multiple projects simultaneously and coordinating across diverse stakeholder groups.


**Technical Skills**
* Advanced to expert\-level proficiency in Primavera P6\.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel reporting and analytical capabilities.
* Strong Power BI dashboard development and data visualization skills.
* Advanced PowerPoint presentation design with the ability to prepare executive\-level reporting materials.
* Strong understanding of project controls methodologies, schedule governance, and portfolio reporting frameworks.


**Core Competency**
* Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and organizational agility.
* Ability to confidently engage with senior leadership while maintaining strong technical credibility with consultants, contractors, and project teams.
* Strong analytical mindset with the capability to challenge assumptions, identify reporting inconsistencies, and provide data\-driven recommendations.
* Highly organized, detail\-oriented, and capable of operating effectively in a fast\-paced, multi\-project environment.

**Knowledge And Skills (Functional And Technical)**

**Company Description**
 As one of the fastest\-growing global media agency networks, Spark Foundry is not beholden to legacy. We embrace nimbleness, agility and open\-mindedness as part of our Startup Spirit. But as part of Publicis Media, we tap into a Powerhouse Soul, gaining access to first\-mover opportunities alongside market\-shaping clout, plus leading\-edge AI and technology. Together, our Startup Spirit and Powerhouse Soul allow us to innovate and iterate faster than any other agency, bringing clients a distinct competitive advantage. Our innovative experiences have been recognized by Cannes Lions, Effies, Shortys and Webbys, all delivered by best\-in\-class talent across more than 70 global offices. Spark Foundry is part of the global Publicis Media agency network, a key division of Publicis Groupe \[Euronext Paris FR0000130577, CAC 40].
   

  

**Overview**
 The IAT Director oversees the Power of One model and integrated ways of working across 5 for 72 markets. This role collaborates with global and regional leaders to customize and implement the integrated agency model across various capabilities such as media, creative, production, commerce, and social/influencer, both within Publicis and with clients and partner agencies to drive the process forward.
   

  

 Key responsibilities include managing client marketing initiatives holistically within Publicis to create a seamless, scalable approach that leverages market insights for continuous improvement. This role acts as the connective tissue, customizing and applying global standards and best practices, identifying successes and risks, and optimizing processes to support local, regional, and global transformation ambitions and ways of working.
   

  

 Ideal for a strategic, process\-driven individual who seeks innovative, effective ways of working, it requires understanding global vs. regional operating models, process implementation, insights management and relationship\-building with diverse stakeholders across multiple markets and capabilities.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Oversee daily orchestration, implementation, and optimization of the integrated operating model from briefing to delivery across marketing capabilities.
* Customize and manage standardized processes, address current challenges, and develop ideal workflows supported by a collaboration platform.
* Collaborate with internal and external teams to ensure seamless integration of marketing efforts.
* Manage intake of integrated and capability\-specific client briefs, including review and assignment to the appropriate internal teams for execution.
* Oversee and/or support resource management across briefs/projects, ensuring efficient allocation for marketing initiatives.
* Communicate project details, timelines, and action steps clearly to internal and external stakeholders.
* Track deliverables, budgets, and project overlaps, adjusting schedules and notifying teams as needed.
* Lead initiative and process feedback conversations with clients and internal teams to ensure continuous optimization of ways of working.
* Manage development of scope components, including timelines, resources, and costs.
* Drive connectivity across regions and capabilities on shared topics, surfacing insights, sharing performance results, and scalable use cases on a monthly basis.
* Partner with the Agency Orchestration team to propose solution\-led approaches aligned with global standards and best practices.
* Identify blockers and opportunities for regional leadership and clients, and develop local and regional action plans accordingly.
* Confidently manage client\-facing communication and develop presentations/documentation for senior stakeholders.


**Qualifications**
 The ideal candidate will bring a minimum of 12–15 years of relevant industry experience.
   

  

 Native Arabic speakers are highly preferred.
   

  

 Proven experience managing global clients and complex stakeholder environments.
   

  

 Demonstrated leadership experience managing and developing high\-performing teams.

**Role Description:** 




 This is a senior, group\-level role based in Dubai, reporting directly to the CEO. The Head of Operations \- Group provides operational leadership, governance and standardisation across Byrne's regional operations in the GCC.
 



 You'll drive fleet availability and utilisation, workshop and maintenance performance, logistics effectiveness, CAPEX planning and HSE compliance balancing local operational agility with Group\-wide consistency. Working closely with General Managers, Operations Managers, the Group Asset Manager, Procurement, HSE and Finance, you'll establish and monitor Group\-wide operational KPIs, scale operations efficiently and maximise fleet ROI across all territories.
 



  





**Qualifications \& Experience:** 



* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering (Electrical, Mechanical or related), or an equivalent technical foundation gained through experience
* 10\+ years in equipment rental, power generation, industrial services, logistics or construction equipment, including several years in a senior multi\-site or regional operations leadership role
* Multi\-country GCC experience (strongly preferred)
* Proven leadership of multi\-disciplinary, multi\-site teams (ideally across multiple countries) spanning operations, fleet, workshop/service, yard, transport and logistics
* Demonstrable track record of scaling operations while maintaining control, reliability and service standards
* Strong workshop, fleet, transport and operational cost\-control background
* Hands\-on experience with ERP / rental systems and asset utilisation reporting
* Strategic mindset with the ability to standardise and scale operations across regions



  





**Ideal Background:** 




 You're a hands\-on yet strategic operations leader with a solid engineering or technical foundation, who understands equipment and fleet inside out. You've progressed through operational roles in equipment rental, power or industrial services, built systems that let a business grow without losing control, and led teams across multiple disciplines and ideally multiple countries. You combine commercial awareness with operational rigour, lead from the front on safety and standards, and know how to turn performance data into action.
 



  





**Company Description:** 




 Byrne Equipment Rental LLC, part of the Byrne Group, has been a leader in the Middle East’s equipment rental industry for over three decades. Headquartered in Dubai, the company operates across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Oman, and Bahrain, boasting a fleet of 16,000\+ assets including modular buildings, power solutions, climate control, and hybrid solar systems. Recognized as one of the Top 100 Global Equipment Rental Companies (IRN100\), Byrne is dedicated to delivering reliable, innovative, and sustainable turnkey rental and infrastructure solutions. The company is committed to regional growth, digital transformation, and green energy investments.

data.jd_text:
***Lead the next chapter of a 30\-year Middle East AV/Pro Audio distribution business. Full P\&L, UAE\-based, peer to the CEO. AED 25\-40K total comp potential.***

  





  





**Business Head – Distribution \& Digital Commerce** 




**Techniline Electronics Group** 




**Location:** 
 Dubai, UAE (on\-site) — 1 minute from Deira City Centre Metro Station, Red Line.
 



**Reports to:** 
 CEO
 



**Role Type:** 
 Senior Commercial Leadership \| Full P\&L Ownership
 



**Team Size:** 
 Multi\-channel commercial team across UAE and export
 



  




 About Techniline
 
 For over 30 years, Techniline Electronics has been the Middle East's trusted distributor of professional audio equipment, public address systems, and musical instruments. From our Dubai headquarters, we serve a network of resellers, system integrators, retailers, event companies, and end users across the UAE, Africa, GCC, and South Asia — built on transparency, reliability, and long\-term partnership.
 



 We operate at the intersection of distribution, retail, and digital commerce — including our flagship retail brands MusicMajlis and Soundline Main, alongside our principal distribution business and our growing e\-commerce platform. We are a hands\-on, owner\-led business of 40\+ people, running on the Scaling Up operating system: daily huddles, weekly KPIs, quarterly priorities, and A\-player standards.
 



  




 The Opportunity
 
 We are hiring a Business Head – Distribution \& Digital Commerce to own and lead the next chapter of growth for our core distribution business.
 



 This is the most senior commercial role in the company outside the CEO, with full P\&L ownership across all distribution channels — UAE trade and wholesale, key accounts, retail outlets, digital commerce, and export markets spanning roughly 30 countries.
 



 You will report directly to the CEO. You will operate as the commercial counterpart to the technical and projects function. You will own the team, the channel strategy, the pricing discipline, and the growth trajectory of a business with three decades of brand equity behind it and significant white space ahead of it.
 



  




 What You Will OwnFull Commercial P\&L
 
 Revenue, margin, cost\-to\-serve, and working capital discipline across the entire distribution business.
 


 Channel Leadership
 
 UAE channels (resellers, key accounts, SI/MEP/FM/contractors, retailers, event companies, end users, e\-commerce) and export markets across Africa, GCC, Middle East, South Asia, and beyond.
 


 Top Account Relationships
 
 Senior\-level engagement with our most important customers. Building account plans, deepening relationships, expanding share of wallet.
 


 Export Strategy \& Build\-out
 
 Diagnose, design, and execute the right go\-to\-market model for each export cluster — sales agents, distributors, country managers, or hybrid structures. The strategy is yours to design with the CEO.
 


 Digital Commerce Direction
 
 Lead the strategic review and evolution of our UAE digital commerce platform — its role, its model, its growth path.
 


 Sales Organisation Design
 
 Within 90 days, you will deliver a structured proposal for how the commercial team should be shaped to win — segmentation, KAM ownership, territory design, capability gaps.
 


 Pricing Governance
 
 Define discount bands, channel pricing rules, and approval matrices. Defend margin against pricing pressure.
 


 Team Building \& Performance
 
 Lead, assess, and upgrade the commercial team. Hire where needed. Coach, develop, and hold people accountable.
 



  




 What You BringMust Have
 
 •      10\+ years of commercial experience, with at least 5 years at Head / Director / Country Manager level carrying full P\&L (revenue AND margin)
 



 •      Career built on the distributor side of the transaction — you've owned inventory, appointed channel partners, managed trade terms, taken margin risk
 



 •      Industry background in professional AV, pro audio, musical instruments, or PA systems distribution (or directly adjacent: ELV systems distribution — CCTV, access control, fire alarm, structured cabling)
 



 •      Meaningful UAE or GCC commercial experience with existing channel relationships in the trade community
 



 •      Proven experience running both UAE/GCC domestic channels AND export markets — not one or the other
 



 •      Track record of building commercial systems from scratch — CRM rollouts, pricing frameworks, dealer hierarchies, territory design
 



 •      Comfort building or rebuilding a sales team or agent network from a low base
 



 •      Currently in UAE or able to relocate within 30 days
 



  




 Strong Preferences
 
 •      Native or fluent Arabic
 



 •      Experience in lean, owner\-managed organisations (under 150 people)
 



 •      Founder, co\-founder, or owner\-operator background in a distribution or trading business
 



 •      Africa export experience (East, West, or Central)
 



 •      Experience managing exclusive distribution or sole\-agency agreements
 



 •      Familiarity with brands in our portfolio or our competitive set
   




 What Success Looks Like
 
 By the end of your first 12 months, you will have:
 



 •      Taken full operational ownership of the commercial engine
 



 •      Implemented CRM discipline, pricing governance, and pipeline visibility
 



 •      Delivered structured strategies for the team, exports, and digital commerce
 



 •      Driven measurable revenue growth across UAE and export markets
 



 •      Deepened relationships with our top accounts and opened new significant ones
 



 •      Built or upgraded the commercial team for the next phase
 



 By the end of 24 months, the business runs on a commercial operating system that no longer requires founder presence in day\-to\-day execution — and you've created room for the next stretch.
 



  




 Compensation \& Benefits
 
 •      
 **Starting salary:** 
 AED 25,000 – 30,000 per month, all\-inclusive (depending on experience)
 



 •      
 **Structured 12\-month review:** 
 On delivery of Year\-One outcomes, total compensation potential of up to AED 35,000 – 40,000 per month inclusive of variable performance components
 



 •      
 **Performance variable:** 
 Gross margin\-based commission designed for meaningful upside on outperformance
 



 •      
 **Strategic bonus:** 
 Performance\-linked discretionary bonus tied to business profitability and named strategic milestones
 



 •      
 **Benefits:** 
 Per UAE Labour Law — visa, medical insurance, workmen's compensation, annual home leave ticket, end\-of\-service gratuity, 30 days annual leave
 



 •      
 **Tools:** 
 Laptop, mobile plan, vehicle allowance, expense account
 



  




 How to Apply
 
 If this sounds like the next chapter of your career, apply directly via the link below — no CV required upfront. The application takes approximately 5 minutes. You will be asked a short set of screening questions and may be invited to a brief AI\-led interview — please answer honestly, as your responses form part of how we shortlist for the next round.
 



 Shortlisted candidates can expect:
 



 1\.    Equip AI interview (\~30 min)
 



 2\.    Intro call with the CEO
 



 3\.    A full Topgrading career interview (90–120 minutes) covering your full work history
 



 4\.    Reference checks with at least 3 past managers
 



 5\.    A final meeting with our Managing Director
 



 6\.    Final compensation and start\-date discussion
 



 We move quickly when we find the right person. We are deliberate when we don't.
 



  




 A Note on Our Hiring Process
 
 We use the Topgrading hiring methodology because we believe most hiring failures come from rushing the assessment. Our interviews are thorough, our reference checks are real, and our scorecard is honest about what success looks like in this role. The strongest candidates appreciate this approach — it ensures both sides know what they're signing up for.

**About Art Dubai Group** 




  





 Art Dubai Group is a public\-private partnership with Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC) founded in 2007, and has grown to become the most experienced cultural programming company in the Gulf. Comprising more than 30 initiatives, including the region’s leading art and design fairs and festivals, it is a provider of industry expertise to the business and government sectors, alongside year\-round commissioning and professional development programmes.
 



  





 The group’s flagship initiatives include Art Dubai, the Middle East’s pre\-eminent international art fair; Downtown Design, the region’s leading design fair with a focus on high quality and original design; Dubai Design Week, the region’s largest design festival; and Prototypes for Humanity, the world’s largest and most diverse assembly of academics addressing social and environmental challenges.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 We are seeking a
 **Head of Operations** 
 to lead Art Dubai Group's cross\-company functions and drive operational excellence across the organization, with end\-to\-end accountability for operational performance and team management. In this pivotal role, you will lead Finance, HR, IT, CRM, Travel Management and Office Management \- building efficient, compliant, and scalable operations that support our growing portfolio of initiatives.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* Lead the cross\-company Operations team spanning Finance, HR, IT, CRM, Travel Management and Office Management \- driving operational excellence and efficiency company\-wide.
* Manage financial operations in collaboration with the Finance team, including FP\&A and General Accounting.
* Drive the HR function, including recruitment, staff development, and performance management, ensuring alignment with the company’s values and objectives.
* Oversee the management of office spaces and storage facilities, ensuring they meet the company’s needs and safety standards.
* Ensure that IT infrastructure and systems are robust, secure, and up\-to\-date, aligning with operational needs.

data.jd_text:
**About the job** 




 We are looking for a highly organised and execution\-focused Project Manager to bring structure, visibility and discipline to business\-as\-usual (BAU) operations and cross\-functional initiatives. This role is responsible for establishing governance, managing delivery and ensuring key projects, particularly product development, launches and activations are executed effectively in a fast\-moving, scaling organisation. The role reports into the Marketing Function and will work cross\-functionally to enable the business to scale with control, clarity and accountability.
 



  





**Core Responsibilities** 




**Governance \& Operating Rhythm** 




  




* Design and maintain fit\-for\-purpose governance, reporting and delivery cadence across business\-as\-usual (BAU) activities and strategic initiatives.
* Establish clear standards for scope, milestones, dependencies and decision\-making.
* Provide transparent, data\-led reporting on progress, risks, issues and resource constraints to support timely decision\-making.



  





**Project \& Initiative Management** 



* Own end\-to\-end project management for priority initiatives including New Product Development (NPD), product launches and market activations and campaigns.
* Develop and maintain end\-to\-end project plans, including critical paths and key dependencies ensuring alignment across functions.
* Coordinate cross\-functional teams across Product, Operations, Marketing, Business Development and Finance.
* Proactively manage risks, issues and dependencies using structured mitigation plans and clear escalation paths.



  





**Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Leadership** 



* Lead and coordinate cross\-functional teams across Product, Operations, Marketing, Business Development, Finance and Research and Development (R\&D) to deliver projects effectively.
* Act as the central point of coordination and communication, ensuring clarity on roles, responsibilities, timelines and decision ownership.
* Facilitate cross\-functional forums, project reviews and decision checkpoints to drive alignment and momentum.
* Influence without authority, constructively resolving conflicts and driving accountability to keep initiatives on track.



  





**Project Management Tools \& Artefacts** 



* Develop, implement and maintain project management toolsets, templates and artefacts (e.g. project plans, trackers, risk logs, decision logs, status reports).
* Ensure consistent use of tools and artefacts to drive clarity, accountability and execution discipline.
* Continuously evolve project management tools and ways of working to suit the scale and maturity of the organisation.



  





**BAU Coordination \& Execution Support** 



* Bring structure and visibility to recurring operational activities, ensuring alignment to business priorities and plans.
* Support the broader leadership team with planning, prioritisation and execution insights.



  





**Continuous Improvement** 



* Use data and performance insights to identify opportunities to improve execution efficiency and cross\-functional collaboration.
* Capture and apply learnings from completed initiatives to strengthen future execution.



  





**Skills and Experience** 




**Skills** 



* Strong project and delivery management capability with a focus on execution discipline.
* Excellent planning, prioritisation and organisational skills, including critical path management.
* Ability to assess, manage and mitigate delivery risk proactively.
* Strong stakeholder management and cross\-functional collaboration skills.
* Capability to design and operate governance, reporting and decision\-making frameworks.
* Analytical data\-led mindset with the ability to translate delivery metrics into actionable insights.
* Adaptability and resilience in fast\-moving, ambiguous environments.
* Clear and concise communication, able to align teams and escalate issues effectively.



  





**Experience** 



* 5\-8\+ years’ experience in project or programme management.
* Proven experience delivering complex, cross\-functional initiatives.
* Project management certification e.g., PRINCE2 or equivalent and risk management certifications.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent.
* Experience in FMCG, manufacturing, or supply chain environments desirable.



  





**What We Offer:** 



* Opportunity to work alongside a dynamic team in an innovative and entrepreneurial environment.
* A chance to contribute to the strategic direction and growth of the company.
* Competitive salary and benefits package.
* A collaborative culture that values creativity, learning, and making an impact.



  





 Interested candidates may send their updated C.V to: hr@fixchocolatier.com. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

In parallel, the role is expected to identify and execute growth opportunities across customer acquisition, retention, recurrence, pricing, subscriptions, partnerships, and market expansion. Working closely with Operations, Marketing, Product, Technology, Customer Support, and Finance, this position will ensure that operational excellence and business growth are developed as a single integrated strategy.

**Operations Leadership** 



* Own the overall operational performance of Citylink Shuttle.
* Lead daily operations, including dispatch, service delivery, customer support coordination, and operational execution.

* Monitor and improve operational KPIs, including fulfillment, service levels, ETA performance, productivity, and load factor.
* Identify and implement operational improvements through data, technology, automation, and process optimization.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, regulatory requirements, and operational standards.



**Growth \& Commercial Performance** 



* Drive customer acquisition, activation, retention, recurrence, and revenue growth.
* Develop pricing, subscription, promotion, and commercial initiatives to improve demand generation and customer loyalty.
* Identify growth opportunities through customer, operational, and market insights.
* Support the development of new products, partnerships, and revenue streams.

* Business Performance \& Analytics
* Establish and monitor KPIs across growth, operations, customer experience, and profitability.

* Monitor unit economics and recommend initiatives to improve revenue, productivity, and profitability.
* Translate operational and commercial data into actionable business recommendations.
* Team Leadership \& Stakeholder Management
* Lead and develop a high\-performing cross\-functional team.
* Establish clear objectives, accountability, and performance management frameworks.
* Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders, business partners, and relevant authorities.
* Foster a culture of ownership, execution, continuous improvement, and customer focus



**Growth \& Business Development** 



* Define and execute the business and operational strategy, aligning growth objectives, customer experience, operational performance, and financial results.
* Lead market development and expansion initiatives, including operational setup, commercial positioning, stakeholder management, and go\-to\-market execution.
* Drive customer acquisition, activation, retention, recurrence, and lifetime value through data\-driven growth initiatives.
* Develop pricing, subscription, and commercial strategies to improve demand generation, customer retention, load factor, revenue per user, and unit economics.
* Identify growth opportunities through market, customer, and operational insights, translating them into actionable initiatives.
* Optimize service design, network performance, capacity utilization, and customer experience to support sustainable growth.

* Strong analytical and commercial mindset with exposure to pricing, budgeting, forecasting, or business planning.
* Experience working across multiple functions and leading execution through cross\-functional teams.



**Key Competencies and Skills** 



* Leadership: Strong ability to lead large, diverse teams and manage cross\-functional operations.
* Operational Expertise: In\-depth knowledge of route optimization, scheduling, and dispatch principles.
* Strategic Thinking: Ability to develop and execute long\-term operational strategies.
* Customer Focus: Commitment to delivering exceptional customer experiences.
* Financial Acumen: Expertise in budgeting, cost control, and operational efficiency.
* Problem Solving: Advanced analytical skills to address complex challenges effectively.
* Communication: Excellent interpersonal, negotiation, and presentation skills.
* Technology Savvy: Experience with transportation management systems and process automation.



**Additional Requirements** 



* Familiarity with local regulations and market dynamics in the Middle East.

Publicis Groupe and Beiersdorf have created Publicis One Touch for their next digital transformation, a new type of agency model based on agility and interdisciplinary design. Publicis One Touch is designed to build a truly connected NIVEA marketing ecosystem, with data at its heart, to work with a single, connected view of marketing adoption and performance, brand health and customer insights across the entire customer journey to drive efficiency, effectiveness and brand love.
 



  





 Job Description
 



 The candidate will be responsible for leading integrated business delivery across assigned Emerging Markets hubs, with a primary focus on
 **India and ASEAN markets** 
 , combining client leadership with cross\-functional integration, operational governance, and commercial ownership.
 



 This is a hybrid leadership role requiring strong business acumen, structured operational oversight, and the ability to navigate complex multi\-market workstreams across Creative, Account Management, Production, Impact, Last Mile, and regional leadership teams.
 



 Given the operational complexity and pace of the India and ASEAN business, the role requires a highly collaborative and solutions\-oriented leader who understands the nuances of these markets, can connect multiple stakeholders, proactively identify risks, and ensure seamless delivery across evolving workstreams.
 



 The role will work closely with senior leadership, regional hub teams, and client stakeholders to ensure delivery excellence, operational discipline, and continuous process improvement across the POUL operating model.
 



 The candidate will also be responsible for mentoring and guiding junior team members while strengthening integration between India, ASEAN, and wider regional delivery teams.
 



  





 Responsibilities
 



**Technical \& Product** 



* Lead the end\-to\-end delivery of integrated campaigns and content workstreams across assigned India and ASEAN hubs, ensuring smooth transition from creative development through production and implementation.
* Act as the integration conduit across CDU (regional), Impact, Last Mile, Production, Creative, and teams.
* Maintain clear visibility across ongoing projects, milestones, dependencies, approvals, and delivery risks.
* Ensure project workflows align with agreed POUL / CDU ways of working and governance frameworks.
* Support creative development workflows including concept development, testing, storyboard / animatic development, production readiness, and digital adaptation.
* Guide teams on practical delivery solutions under compressed timelines and evolving business requirements.
* Ensure teams are aligned on ownership, roles, responsibilities, and next steps across workstreams.
* Bring practical understanding of delivery realities across India and ASEAN markets, including local stakeholder dynamics, operational dependencies, and regional nuances.



**Business Acumen \& Operational Efficiency** 



* Build trusted relationships with regional and local clients, positioning the team as a strategic and dependable business partner.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of client business priorities, operational realities, market nuances, and delivery challenges.
* Lead operational governance across assigned workstreams, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within scope, and to expected quality standards.
* Proactively identify risks, escalation points, resource gaps, and operational blockers; drive timely resolution within internal teams.
* Maintain strong commercial discipline across projects, including PO tracking, billing readiness, burn rate awareness, forecasting support, and financial escalations.
* Drive structured project management and disciplined follow\-through across multiple concurrent workstreams.
* Improve efficiency across teams by identifying process gaps, operational inefficiencies, and handover challenges, and recommending scalable solutions.
* Support regional leadership in managing complex delivery scenarios, compressed timelines, and evolving client asks across India and ASEAN hubs.



**Innovative \& Analytical Mindset** 



* Think strategically and operationally to solve business and delivery challenges across complex multi\-market workstreams.
* Join the dots across clients, internal teams, timelines, budgets, and delivery dependencies to propose practical solutions.
* Proactively identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve governance, and enhance delivery effectiveness.
* Demonstrate sound judgment in navigating ambiguity, competing priorities, and operational complexity.
* Bring a solution\-led mindset to challenges rather than escalating issues without clear recommendations.
* Produce clear, insightful, and well\-structured communication for both clients and internal leadership.



**People \& Leadership** 



* Act as a dependable leadership presence across assigned teams, providing clear direction, guidance, and support.
* Support Account Management and cross\-functional teams in navigating complex operational scenarios.
* Foster strong collaboration across markets, departments, and hub teams.
* Build trust and credibility with teams through practical leadership, responsiveness, and ownership.
* Coach junior and mid\-level team members on ways of working, project management discipline, and stakeholder management.
* Create clarity in moments of ambiguity and support teams in resolving challenges effectively.
* Encourage collaborative, integrated, and solutions\-oriented team culture aligned with the POUL operating model.
* Demonstrate strong judgement, maturity, and professionalism in both internal and external stakeholder interactions.



**Self** 



* Demonstrate agility and flexibility in responding to evolving business priorities and complex project demands.
* Take ownership and accountability for delivery outcomes across assigned workstreams.
* Operate with resilience and composure under pressure.
* Show strong initiative in anticipating risks, solving problems, and driving improvements.
* Demonstrate learning agility and openness to evolving ways of working.
* Maintain high standards of professionalism, collaboration, and commercial responsibility.
* Act with integrity, sound judgement, and strong accountability in all stakeholder interactions.



  





 Qualifications
 


* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related field.
* Minimum 8 years’ experience in integrated agency / communications / marketing delivery roles.
* Proven experience managing complex, multi\-market, cross\-functional workstreams.
* Strong understanding of creative development, production workflows, regional to local operations, finance know\-how, process optimisation \& change management.
* Experience in financial operations, billing governance, and commercial delivery management.
* **Prior experience working across India and/or ASEAN markets is strongly preferred.**
* **Candidates with direct market experience from India or ASEAN, or demonstrated experience managing these regions, will be strongly preferred given the nature of the role.**
* Experience working across matrixed regional / global organisations preferred.
* FMCG / Beauty experience is an advantage.
* Fluency in English.

At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision\-making through our leading AI\-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.
 



 What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.

 Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating
 
 our wins – big and small.
 



 Supported by operating principles of being strategy\-led, values\-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next \- together!
 



 We are seeking a highly driven self\-starter with exceptional program\-level delivery experience to join Anaplan in UAE. This is a rare, high\-impact opportunity to lay the groundwork and shape the success of our most strategic enterprise customers across the Middle East.
 



 At Anaplan, we are redefining how businesses plan and make decisions through our cutting\-edge Connected Planning platform, powered by our unique deterministic calculation engine and advanced AI capabilities. In this role, you will be at the forefront of this transformation.
 



 You will bring a proven track record of leading complex, high\-stakes implementations—ideally within Supply Chain, Financial Planning \& Analysis (FP\&A), or Workforce Planning. Thriving at the intersection of delivery and strategic advisory, you will scope, negotiate, manage escalations, and serve as an indispensable partner to both customer and internal stakeholders. From C\-level executives to daily end\-users, you will excel at influencing decisions and cementing your status as a trusted advisor.
 



 This is a hands\-on leadership position tailor\-made for a delivery expert who can seamlessly orchestrate multiple enterprise programs, ensure strict adherence to budget and scope, and expertly pivot to recover projects that have drifted off track.

 We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!
 



 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  
 



**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer** 
  
 



 It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.
 



 Anaplan does not:  
 


* Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.
* Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.



 All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

data.jd_text:
**Description**
 Amazon Now is building the future of ultra\-fast grocery delivery across the Middle East. We are looking for a Program Manager to drive measurable improvements across store capacity management, cost\-per\-order reduction, and delivery speed (Click\-to\-Door).
   

  

 This role sits within the Operations Excellence function and is responsible for identifying, scoping, and delivering high\-impact programmes that improve customer experience and unit economics across Amazon Now’s network in Saudi Arabia.
   

  

 You will work across Last Mile, Middle Mile, and Under\-The\-Roof (UTR) operations to find inefficiencies, build the business case, and drive cross\-functional execution. This is not a reactive role, you will proactively identify opportunities before they become problems, connect the dots across operational channels, and ensure every initiative ladders up to CX outcomes and P\&L impact.
   

  

 The right candidate is analytically sharp, comfortable with ambiguity, and operates with a bias for action. You think in systems, not silos. You’re as comfortable in the data as you are in a room with senior stakeholders making the case for change.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Store Capacity \& Cost Management
   

  

* Own programmes to optimise store capacity utilization, including bin density, ASIN rationalisation, gas tank management, and space allocation across darkstores.
* Drive cost\-per\-order reduction across the end\-to\-end operation: UTR pick efficiency, DA (Delivery Associate) productivity, hub\-to\-store transhipment costs, and middle mile truck utilisation.
* Analyse operational cost structures to identify the highest\-leverage opportunities for unit economics improvement. Build business cases with clear ROI and execution plans.
* Partner with UTR, Last Mile, and Middle Mile teams to implement changes that reduce waste, improve throughput, and lower cost\-to\-serve without degrading customer experience.
* Develop and maintain dashboards and reporting mechanisms to track capacity utilisation and cost metrics across KSA stores.


 Delivery Speed \& Click\-to\-Door (C2D)
   

  

* Own the programme roadmap for C2D reduction, identifying bottlenecks across order acceptance, pick \& pack, dispatch, and last mile delivery.
* Analyse delivery defects, early delivery marking, Did\-Not\-Receive (DNR) patterns, and other CX pain points to drive root cause resolution.
* Identify and eliminate handoff delays between UTR, Middle Mile, and Last Mile that contribute to C2D inflation.


 Project \& Programme Delivery
   

  

* Scope, plan, and execute operational improvement projects end\-to\-end, from opportunity identification through to measurable business impact.
* Build and manage a portfolio of initiatives across capacity, cost, and speed, with clear prioritisation based on CX and P\&L impact.
* Create mechanisms for project tracking, stakeholder communication, and escalation. Maintain a clear view of project status, risks, and dependencies.
* Drive cross\-functional alignment with ACES, Tech, Finance, Category, and operations teams to remove blockers and deliver on commitments.
* Contribute to the development of scalable solutions that can be replicated across KSA stores, solve once, scale everywhere.


 Cross\-Functional Influence \& Visibility
   

  

* Operate as the connective tissue between operational channels, ensuring improvements in one area don’t create problems in another.
* Build visibility into operational performance through data, dashboards, and regular reporting cadences (WBR/MBR contributions).
* Influence without authority, drive outcomes through data\-backed recommendations, clear communication, and stakeholder management.
* Support Automation \& AI initiatives that drive efficiency, reduce manual effort, and improve decision\-making across operations.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 5\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Master's degree
* Experience in program requirements definition, together with data and metrics leveraging to drive improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 5\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL

The Senior Project Manager will be responsible for overseeing the end\-to\-end delivery of high\-end hospitality and residential development projects on behalf of the client. This role requires a proactive leader with a strong technical background in project and construction management, capable of managing design, procurement, construction, and handover phases while maintaining the highest standards of quality, cost control, and schedule adherence. The Senior Project Manager acts as the key interface between the client, consultants, contractors, and other stakeholders to ensure that the client’s vision and brand standards are achieved.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 Project Leadership \& Planning
 


* Lead project delivery activities in alignment with company objectives and brand values.
* Develop, manage, and monitor project programs, budgets, and risk registers.
* Coordinate feasibility studies, site due diligence, and design development.
* Ensure compliance with local authority regulations, health and safety requirements, and sustainability objectives.



  





 Design \& Consultant Management
 


* Support the development team manage multidisciplinary design teams (architectural, interior design, MEP, structural, etc.) to ensure timely and coordinated outputs.
* Support the review of design documentation to ensure alignment with project brief, budget, and operational requirements.
* Facilitate design workshops and value engineering exercises.



  





 Procurement \& Contract Administration
 


* Support tendering and appointment of consultants, contractors, and suppliers.
* Review and recommend procurement strategies suitable for luxury hospitality and residential developments.
* Administer contracts in coordination with commercial and legal teams, ensuring compliance and fair execution.



  





 Construction \& Site Management
 


* Monitor construction progress, quality standards, and adherence to design intent.
* Conduct regular site inspections and progress meetings.
* Manage contractor performance and ensure timely resolution of technical and contractual issues.



  





 Stakeholder \& Client Interface
 


* Act as the principal client representative for all project\-related matters.
* Prepare and deliver regular project reports, presentations, and dashboards to senior management.
* Manage stakeholder expectations, ensuring alignment with project vision, cost, and delivery targets.



  





 Handover \& Closeout
 


* Oversee testing, commissioning, snagging, and final handover processes.
* Ensure proper documentation, operation manuals, and as\-built drawings are delivered.
* Support transition to operations and post\-completion evaluations.



  





  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 




  





 Education \& Certifications
 


* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, or Construction Management (Master’s degree preferred).
* Professional accreditation such as PMP, RICS, MRICS, MCIOB, or equivalent is highly desirable.



  





 Experience
 


* Minimum 10–15 years of relevant experience, with at least 5 years in the UAE or GCC region.
* Proven track record of managing luxury hospitality and high\-end residential projects from inception to completion.
* Experience working within client or developer organizations preferred.
* Strong knowledge of FIDIC\-based contracts, local permitting processes, and regional construction practices.



  





 Skills \& Attributes
 


* Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong financial acumen and ability to manage budgets and forecasts.
* High attention to detail with a commitment to delivering excellence.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment with multicultural teams.

The Opportunity
   

  

 Responsible for directing Professional and Continuing Education (PaCE) activities, including strategic planning, development, and execution of PaCE programmes, business development, training catalog oversight, and stakeholder engagement, to ensure alignment with market demand, client expectations, and the University’s policies and procedures.
   

  

 The Responsibilities
   

  

 Strategic \& Financial
   

  

* Lead the development and monitor the execution of the Department's strategy and align with ZU's strategic objectives, ensuring effective and efficient achievement of departmental operations.
* Oversee the Department’s performance through defined KPIs and targets, and continuously identify and recommend improvements to support the realisation of ZU's strategy.
* Direct the allocation of budget across the Department and ensure full adherence to approved plans and rectify any deviations in a timely manner.
* Provide the relevant organisational unit with consolidated budget input as required, ensuring that the Department’s requirements are appropriately addressed in the overall budget planning process.


 Operational
   

  

* Lead the development and execution of business development strategies to expand B2B and B2C professional training services in line with University’s objectives.
* Lead the establishment of strategic partnerships with industry, government, and community stakeholders to generate revenue, expand reach, and ensure programme sustainability.
* Lead the development of tailored proposals and promotional strategies to position PaCE as a leading provider.
* Direct the development, planning, and internal coordination of full\-scale and customised training programmes to ensure strategic alignment, resource optimisation, and successful delivery of the same.
* Lead the development and delivery of professional education programmes, including short courses, certifications, and hybrid learning models, to meet evolving market demands.
* Lead the engagement with external subject\-matter experts to maintain high\-quality content development and delivery across all training programmes.
* Lead the development and maintenance of a centralised training catalog and digital infrastructure, including LMS platforms, to ensure seamless access to current and upcoming training offerings.
* Direct institutional compliance by ensuring documentation, reporting, and quality assurance mechanisms across all PaCE training activities.
* Direct institutional initiatives that promote faculty and student participation in entrepreneurial training, venture creation, and business incubation programmes offered by the PaCE department.
* Perform ad\-hoc activities related to the job duties, as requested by the direct supervisor.


 People Management
   

  

* Review consolidated workforce planning reports, talent acquisition strategies, and budgets at the Department level to ensure adequate staffing for optimal operational smoothness, and submit to the appropriate authority for final approval.
* Set performance management objectives for all reportees and perform mid\-year and year\-end performance reviews.
* Identify talent for pivotal roles from a succession management standpoint to ensure business continuity.
* Provide guidance to reporting managers on people management matters.
* Manage organisational units within the Department and ensure effective leadership to adequately manage human capital.


 The Requirements
   

  

* Master's Degree with a minimum of 15 years of experience and at least 10 years in a managerial position.
* Certification in a relevant field is preferred.


 The Benefits
   

  

 The University’s benefits package is highly attractive, with competitive tax\-free salaries in the U.A.E., cash housing, annual vacation airline tickets for the employee and immediate family, educational subsidies for children, and healthcare for the employee and sponsored family members.
   

  

 To Apply

 WSP Middle East is seeking an experienced AI Business Partner to work in direct partnership with the Property \& Buildings (P\&B) Business Unit leadership.
