We are committed to providing fair and inclusive employment opportunities to all colleagues and applicants, regardless of race, colour, ethnicity, national origin, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, marital or family status, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

I am currently looking for an experienced
 **Project Director** 
 to lead the successful delivery of major construction projects across Dubai. This is a senior leadership position suited to an individual with a proven background managing large\-scale developments from construction stage through to successful handover.
 



  





 The successful candidate will be responsible for overseeing all site activities, ensuring projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and to the highest standards of quality. You will act as a key point of contact between clients, consultants, and project teams while providing strategic leadership throughout the project lifecycle.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Lead the delivery of complex, large\-scale construction projects, overseeing all site operations from mobilisation through to completion and handover.
* Manage project teams, contractors, subcontractors, and consultants to ensure successful project execution.
* Develop and implement project strategies, programmes, schedules, and delivery plans aligned with client expectations and contractual requirements.
* Monitor project budgets, commercial performance, resource allocation, and overall project progress.
* Oversee contract administration, ensuring compliance with contractual obligations, variations, claims, and project requirements.
* Identify potential project risks and implement effective mitigation strategies to protect programme, cost, and quality objectives.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, stakeholders, authorities, and project partners.
* Lead coordination between design, commercial, construction, and technical teams to ensure efficient project delivery.
* Ensure compliance with UAE construction regulations, authority requirements, health \& safety standards, and quality procedures.
* Drive best practices across project delivery, improving processes, efficiency, and overall project performance.
* Provide clear reporting and project updates to senior leadership and key stakeholders.
* Mentor and develop project teams, creating a high\-performance and collaborative working environment.



  





**Requirements:** 



* Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline.
* PMP certification or equivalent project management qualification is preferred.
* Minimum 18 years’ experience within construction, project management, or supervision, with a strong track record delivering major developments.
* Previous experience operating as a Project Director or Senior Project Manager on large\-scale building projects.
* Strong Middle East experience is essential, with proven knowledge of the Dubai construction market.
* Experience managing projects under contractual frameworks, including contractor management, claims, variations, and commercial processes.
* Strong understanding of construction methodologies, project controls, planning, cost management, and risk mitigation.
* Ability to manage large multidisciplinary teams across complex projects.
* Excellent client\-facing skills with experience dealing directly with developers, consultants, contractors, and government authorities.
* Strong leadership, communication, and decision\-making abilities.



  





 This is an excellent opportunity for an established Project Director to play a key role in delivering some of Dubai’s current high\-profile developments.

data.jd_text:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose\-driven, world\-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
   

  

 Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
   

  

 Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance\-focused culture.
   

  

**Background and Context**
 Digital \& Technology sits at the heart of Haleon’s ambition to Win as One. We are Haleon’s digital backbone – how we accelerate impact, unlock new value, and build a future‑ready organisation. Digital isn’t simply part of our business; it is how we operate, grow, and deliver everyday health at scale.
   

  

 The Digital \& Technology function plays a critical role as a strategic partner to the business, turning insights into impact and ideas into innovation. From secure, resilient operations and modern digital foundations, to hyper‑personalised customer and consumer experiences, digital is embedded across every part of Haleon – shaping how we innovate, supply consumer demand, go to market, and run our internal operations.
   

  

 Our focus is clear: to secure the business, run resilient and compliant operations, and transform Haleon into a digital organisation that is wired for excellence. This is enabled by sustained investment in a scalable, resilient technology foundation and the adoption of digital solutions that empower our people, elevate performance, and enable the 4–6% organic revenue growth and productivity savings underpinning Win as One.
   

  

 Digital only delivers when people are at the centre. Building skills, confidence, and modern ways of working is essential to realising value from technology. Together, we are reshaping the backbone of Haleon to become a best‑in‑class consumer health company – bold, resilient, performance‑focused, and fit for the future.
   

  

**Role Overview**
* The Senior OU Tech Partner (UAE) is a senior Organisational Unit (OU) Digital \& Technology partner accountable for delivering business\-critical digital capabilities that enable commercial growth and operational excellence across the MEA OU.
* The role is responsible for the day\-to\-day delivery and operational management of digital and technology capabilities supporting Haleon’s OU priorities in the MEA. Acting as the primary technology partner to OU business leaders, this role ensures digital priorities are translated into reliable, scalable solutions aligned to global platforms and standards.
* The focus is on execution excellence, adoption, operational performance, and measurable business impact, rather than enterprise or regional strategy ownership.
* The role requires experience delivering digital capabilities across sales, marketing, eCommerce, and digital platforms, alongside operational technologies such as infrastructure and security.
* Combining strong commercial understanding with execution leadership, the Senior OU Tech Partner owns end\-to\-end delivery, adoption, and performance of digital initiatives, while ensuring alignment with Haleon’s global roadmaps, governance, and ways of working.
* Success in this role is driven by delivery excellence, business impact, stakeholder leadership, and the ability to operate effectively within a complex, matrixed global environment.


**Key Responsibilities**
**Delivery \& Execution**
* Deliver agreed digital and technology initiatives supporting OU priorities in the MEA.
* Translate defined roadmaps and plans into clear delivery activities, milestones, and outcomes.
* Own end\-to\-end delivery accountability for key OU initiatives, ensuring measurable business outcomes (e.g. growth, productivity, adoption).
* Coordinate and lead delivery across internal teams, global platform partners, and vendors
* Coordinate delivery across internal teams, global platform partners, and vendors to ensure timely execution.
* Track progress, risks, and dependencies, escalating issues proactively.


**Business \& Stakeholder Collaboration**
* Work closely with OU Marketing, Sales, Customer, and Corporate teams to clarify requirements and support delivery.
* Partner with commercial leaders to align digital initiatives with market growth priorities, ensuring technology investments deliver tangible business value.
* Bring strong understanding of commercial drivers (sales execution, distribution, customer engagement, eCommerce) into solution delivery.
* Act as the primary day‑to‑day technology contact for assigned domains or initiatives.
* Build strong working relationships with business stakeholders to enable adoption and value realisation.


**Matrix \& Global Collaboration**
* Partner with global product, engineering, and platform teams to deliver MEA OU requirements in line with global standards.
* Contribute delivery feedback and local insights to support continuous improvement of global platforms and services.


**Governance, Risk \& Compliance**
* Ensure delivery activities follow secure‑by‑design principles and established architecture standards.
* Apply global IT governance, risk, and compliance frameworks within assigned scope.
* Support compliance with local regulatory, data privacy, and security requirements.


**Operations \& Financial Management**
* Monitor operational performance of owned digital and technology services and support issue resolution with global teams.
* Support budget tracking, vendor coordination, and benefits tracking for assigned initiatives.


**Team \& Capability Contribution**
* Lead cross\-functional delivery teams and workstreams across markets, global platform teams, and vendors.
* Provide direction, prioritisation, and decision support across complex initiatives.
* Act as a senior point of escalation for delivery, adoption, and performance challenges.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* 10\+ years’ experience in digital, technology, or commercial technology roles, including leadership of complex delivery initiatives.
* Experience delivering digital capabilities across sales, marketing, eCommerce, CRM, or digital experience platforms.
* Experience working in a matrixed, global organisation, partnering with central product and platform teams.
* Exposure to technology operations, vendors, or delivery partners.
* Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
* Clear communicator, able to engage both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
* Experience in CPG, retail, or consumer‑led environments advantageous.


**Job Posting End Date**
 2026\-06\-30
   

  

**Equal Opportunities**
 Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
   

  

 During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
   

  

 The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.
   

  

**Adjustment or Accommodations Request**
 If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.
   

  

**Note to candidates**
 The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.

* Ensures proper recording of potential claim/counter claim events, related to delays of goods/documentation, etc. and is responsible for the coordination of the conclusion/closure of these events in line with the project criteria for said.

 Preferred Attributes

**About the Role** 




 We are seeking an experienced Project Leader to join our Dubai Studio and play a key role in the successful design and delivery of major projects across the Middle East and Europe. The successful candidate will initially lead a significant rail infrastructure project before transitioning to support and lead other key projects across our diverse portfolio. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced Architect who enjoys working across complex, multidisciplinary environments and is motivated by designing and delivering high\-profile projects that shape cities and communities.

* Lead the delivery of major projects from planning and design through to construction and completion.

**About You** 




 You are an experienced Architectural Project Leader with a proven ability to lead the design and delivery of complex, large\-scale projects. Combining strong design sensibility with effective project leadership, you are skilled at managing clients, consultants, and multidisciplinary teams to deliver high\-quality architectural outcomes across all stages of a project's lifecycle.

Due to file upload restrictions we recommend providing a link to your portfolio within your resume. Applications will be treated in the strictest confidence. We do not accept unsolicited resumes or names from agencies. All personal data collected by us will be kept confidential and only used for recruitment purposes.
 



  





**Mandatory Requirement: It is an essential requirement that at the time of applying for this position, applicants must have the legal right to work in the UAE.**

 7C is an equal opportunity employer. The successful candidate will be confident engaging with C\-level executives and senior industry leaders across international markets.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Help research industry trends, market developments, and audience needs
* Help develop commercially viable conference agendas and event concepts
* Identify key discussion topics and emerging market opportunities
* Conduct competitor analysis and market mapping of industries into buyer and seller chains
* Research and build databases of target individuals suitable for speaking at events or attending advisory board meetings


**Identify targets according to:**
* Seniority level (e.g. CIO, CTO, CSO)
* Geographic focus
* Major companies within target markets
* Client recommendations


**Speaker Acquisition \& Management**
* Identify, approach, and secure senior\-level approved speakers and industry experts

* Achieve agreed monthly speaker confirmation targets across assigned events

* Keep live event agendas updated with confirmed speakers and allocated sessions

* Ensure event websites are continuously updated with speaker profiles and agenda changes


 Act as the main point of contact for all speaker communications regarding:
   

  

* Event participation
* Session content
* Travel and accommodation arrangements
* Event logistics and queries


**Assist with speaker travel budget allocation where required**
* Collect and organize speaker documentation needed for local event licensing procedures

* Ensure speakers are fully briefed and event\-ready at least two weeks before the event

**Advisory Board Management**

 Coordinate meeting logistics including:
   

  

* Sending Teams/Zoom invitations
* Distributing agendas in advance
* Managing confirmations and reminders


 Attend and record advisory board meetings where applicable
   

  

**Maintain accurate attendee records including:**
* Names
* Job titles

**Event Project Management**

**Marketing \& Website Coordination**

* Assist with the development and review of marketing copy including agenda descriptions, speaker highlights, email campaigns, and social media content
* Ensure all website content is accurate, professional, and aligned with brand standards and event timelines
* Support marketing initiatives by identifying compelling content and speaker announcements to help drive delegate registrations and engagement


**Commercial Support**
* Work closely with sponsorship and delegate sales teams to support event revenue goals
* Prepare sponsorship brief for each event detailing buyer seller categories with examples, why they should invest, specific leads generated through online and primary research, competitive event listings etc.
* Pass on weekly developments, agenda updates and new potential leads to sales team
* Help develop commercially attractive conference topics and speaker line\-ups
* Support the creation of sponsorship opportunities aligned with program content

**Required Skills \& Competencies**
* Strong research and analytical skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication
* Strong stakeholder and relationship management abilities

**Preferred Experience**

data.jd_text:
The Head of Engineering is responsible for establishing and leading the engineering function as a core competitive advantage for the System Integration Division. The role provides strategic and technical leadership across design, protection, automation, panel engineering, and system architecture to ensure delivery of reliable, cost\-effective, and compliant solutions.
   

  

 The position drives engineering excellence through standardization, technology adoption, strong customer technical engagement, and robust project execution while ensuring profitability, quality, safety, and customer satisfaction. The role also builds organizational capability by developing high\-performing engineering teams, strengthening supplier and OEM partnerships, and supporting bids, new solutions, and product development initiatives.
   

  

**Job Purpose**
****Job Responsibilities****
****Job Requirements****
**Engineering Strategy \& Technical Authority**
* Define and implement the engineering strategy, design philosophy, and technical governance framework for the division.
* Establish company standards for drawings, documentation, SLDs, wiring diagrams, design templates, and BOM structures.
* Act as the final technical approval authority for all engineering deliverables and design packages.
* Own technical risk management and ensure alignment with business profitability and margin targets.
* Lead high\-level technical engagement with clients, consultants, utilities, and OEM partners.
* Define and execute the technology roadmap including adoption of modern substation automation, IEC 61850 architectures, smart MCCs, and digitalization initiatives.
* Lead root cause analysis and corrective action for major technical failures, NCRs, or quality concerns.


* Project Engineering \& Bid Management
* Provide technical leadership during bids, tenders, and proposal stage, ensuring optimal technical and commercial positioning.
* Validate technical compliance with customer specifications, international standards, and contractual requirements.
* Oversee project engineering to ensure designs are delivered on time, within budget, and with zero major deviations.
* Manage interfaces with clients, consultants, OEMs (Siemens, ABB, GE, SEL, Schneider, etc.), and internal stakeholders.
* Balance standardization vs. customization to improve efficiency without compromising project requirements.
* Support business growth by enabling engineering capability for new markets, products, and solutions.
* Ensure seamless coordination with Testing \& Commissioning teams for successful system validation and handover.
* Departmental Leadership \& Capability Building
* Establish and lead a high\-performing engineering organization including Protection, Automation, Design, and Application Engineering.
* Define competency frameworks, skill matrix, and succession pipeline for critical roles.
* Drive recruitment, mentoring, and technical capability development.
* Optimize engineering resource planning across multiple concurrent projects.
* Foster a culture of innovation, ownership, and continuous improvement.
* Commercial \& Value Engineering
* Own engineering cost optimization through value engineering and design efficiency.
* Review and influence project profitability through technical decisions.
* Identify cost drivers within BOMs and propose alternatives without compromising performance.
* 
+ Support contract negotiations on technical clauses and deviations.

* Quality, Safety \& Compliance (Non\-Negotiables)
+ Ensure all engineering outputs comply with international standards including:
+ IEC 60255
+ IEC 61850
+ IEC 61131
+ IEC 61439
+ IEEE C37
+ ISO 9001
+ Integrate Safety by Design principles including arc\-flash mitigation, segregation, and isolation philosophy.
+ Ensure robust documentation control, ISO compliance, and accuracy of as\-built drawings and O\&M manuals.
+ Maintain centralized engineering data repository and knowledge management systems.


**Qualifications**
**Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering (Master’s preferred).** 
****Experience****
* 15–18\+ years of relevant experience in Protection, Automation, Panel, or System Integration Engineering.
* Minimum 5–8 years in a senior engineering leadership or departmental head role.
* Experience handling multi\-million AED EPC or system integration projects is preferred


**Knowledge \& Technical Expertise** 
  

  

* Protection Engineering
+ Deep expertise in protection schemes (Differential, Distance, REF, Overcurrent, Busbar).
+ Relay coordination , system studies, and CT/VT sizing.

* Panel \& System Design
+ LV/MV panel design, heat dissipation, segregation, earthing, and wiring philosophy.

* Automation \& Communication
+ SCADA, RTU, IEC 61850, Modbus, DNP3, IEC 60870\-5 protocols.

* Engineering Tools
+ EPLAN, AutoCAD Electrical
+ DIGSI, AcSELerator, EnerVista
+ ETAP / SKM

* Commercial Acumen
+ Strong understanding of technical specifications, BOM costing, value engineering, and project lifecycle

 As the

 , you will be responsible for planning, leading, organising, and motivating scrum teams either within a Release Train or outside to achieve a high level of performance and quality in the delivery of outputs that provide exceptional value to end users and customers. data.jd_text:
***Summary***




 The Sr. Manager \- Oracle Practice is accountable for the end\-to\-end ownership, governance, and continuous evolution of the Oracle Fusion Cloud platform across Finance (ERP), Procurement, and Human Capital Management (HCM). The role leads the strategy, delivery, and operations of all Fusion modules — partnering with CFO, CHRO, and CPO organizations to translate business priorities into a stable, secure, and value\-generating cloud platform. The incumbent oversees implementation programs, quarterly release management, integrations, support, vendor governance, and a multi\-disciplinary team of functional and technical consultants.
 



  





***Role***




**Strategic \& Governance** 



* Define and own the Oracle Fusion roadmap aligned with enterprise digital strategy and three\-year business plan.
* Establish Fusion governance: steering committee cadence, change advisory board, prioritization framework, and KPIs.
* Manage the annual Fusion budget (OPEX/CAPEX), license optimization, and total\-cost\-of\-ownership.
* Lead vendor governance for Oracle, implementation partners, and managed\-services providers — SLAs, performance reviews, and commercial negotiations.
* Ensure compliance with UAE regulations, IFRS, VAT, WPS, and group internal controls (SOX\-equivalent) within the Fusion environment.



**Finance (ERP) Module Ownership** 



* Own General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Cash Management, Fixed Assets, Expenses, Tax, and Intercompany.
* Drive month\-end / year\-end close optimization, financial reporting via OTBI / FRS / Smart View, and consolidations.
* Govern Chart of Accounts, ledger structures, and the Enterprise Structures Configurator.
* Lead enhancements in Project Portfolio Management (PPM), Revenue Management, and Subledger Accounting where applicable.



**Procurement Module Ownership** 



* Own Self\-Service Procurement, Purchasing, Sourcing, Supplier Portal, Supplier Qualification Management, and Procurement Contracts.
* Drive supplier onboarding, sourcing automation (RFx, auctions), and contract compliance.
* Align Fusion Procurement with adjacent platforms (e.g., Primavera Unifier for project tendering and commitments) and ensure clean data handoff between systems.
* Implement approval hierarchies, document categories, and policy controls to enforce procurement governance.



**Human Capital Management (HCM) Module Ownership** 



* Own Core HR, Absence, Talent, Performance, Compensation, Payroll (or Payroll Interface to ADP/Mercans), and Workforce Management.
* Lead annual HR cycles in the system: merit, bonus, talent review, and performance calibration.
* Manage WPS payroll compliance, gratuity calculations, and Emiratization reporting.
* Deploy self\-service experiences (Redwood / Journeys) to improve employee and manager adoption.



**Delivery, Operations \& Integration** 



* Lead implementations, rollouts to new entities, and quarterly Oracle release uptake (impact assessment, regression, go/no\-go).
* Govern integrations through Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) with banks, MOHRE, tax authority, BI tools, and other enterprise systems.
* Ensure platform security: role design, SoD analysis, data privacy, and audit readiness.
* Own incident, problem, and change management for Fusion; drive a 99%\+ availability and target SLA adherence.
* Sponsor data quality, master data management, and reconciliation across Finance, Procurement, and HCM.



**People Leadership** 



* Build and develop a high\-performing team of functional consultants, technical developers, and integration engineers.
* Define competency frameworks, certification plans, and career paths for the Fusion practice.
* Foster a product\-mindset, business\-partnership culture inside IT.



  





***Competencies***



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, or related discipline; Master's/MBA preferred.
* Oracle Cloud certifications in Financials, Procurement, or HCM (Implementation Specialist or higher) strongly preferred.
* CPA / ACCA / CMA, CIPS, or SHRM/CIPD certifications are an advantage.



**Experience** 



* 15\+ years in enterprise applications, with at least 8 years on Oracle Cloud (Fusion) — covering minimum two of Finance, Procurement, HCM end\-to\-end.
* Track record of leading at least two full\-cycle Fusion implementations or major upgrades from EBS / PeopleSoft / JD Edwards / SAP to Oracle Cloud.
* Experience managing multi\-entity, multi\-currency, multi\-jurisdiction deployments (UAE / GCC preferred).
* Demonstrated leadership of teams of 15\+ across functional, technical, and partner resources.
* Industry background in real estate, construction, hospitality, or large diversified groups is a strong plus.



**Technical Competencies** 



* Deep functional knowledge of Oracle Fusion ERP, Procurement, and HCM data models and configuration.
* Hands\-on familiarity with OIC, FBDI, HDL, HCM Extracts, BI Publisher, OTBI, Fast Formulas, and REST APIs.
* Strong understanding of security model, role design, and SoD (Risk Management / Advanced Controls).
* Working knowledge of adjacent Oracle products (Primavera Unifier, EPM, Analytics Cloud) and common integrations (banks, payroll bureaus, regulatory portals).

data.jd_text:
**Manatal** 
 is an HRTech software service (B2B SaaS) company headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand. Manatal is one of the fastest\-growing start\-ups in the region and is backed by Surge and Sequoia Capital.
 



 Manatal has a global presence and is trusted by thousands of businesses in over 135 countries. Our goal is to transform the entire hiring process by making it simple, efficient, and enjoyable for recruiters, hiring managers, and candidates alike. Our mission is to offer the best\-in\-class AI\-powered technologies to empower small, medium, and large businesses in their staffing \& recruitment transformation.
 



**Head of Engineering Operations** 




 As Manatal expands into the enterprise segment, the operational demands on engineering are growing beyond what product squads can absorb alongside feature development. Internal requests, data migrations, bug triage, and customer\-facing technical work require dedicated engineering ownership to maintain quality and velocity across the organization.
 



 The Head of Engineering Operations will own this function. Reporting to the Director of Engineering, this role is responsible for all engineering work that falls outside of product feature development and platform engineering but is critical to customer satisfaction, platform reliability, and business growth. This includes building and leading a team, establishing processes and SLAs, and systematically automating operational workflows.
 



 This is a deeply technical, hands\-on leadership position. The successful candidate will write production code across our backend (Python/Django, FastAPI) and frontend (Vue.js, React) codebases, contribute to both internal tooling and customer\-facing repositories, and be capable of investigating and troubleshooting infrastructure\-level issues. This person is expected to operate at the same technical level as our Director of Engineering and Head of Platform Engineering.
 



 The role also serves as the primary engineering counterpart to the L3 support team (which reports into Customer Support), ensuring that technical escalations are resolved efficiently and that product squads remain focused on product delivery.
 



 We are looking for a candidate who is energized by high\-tempo environments, comfortable engaging directly with customers, and capable of managing multiple priorities under pressure. Strong judgment in prioritization and effective delegation are essential.
 



**Responsibilities** 




**Engineering Requests \& Customer\-Facing Support** 



* Own the intake, prioritization, and resolution of all internal engineering requests (data exports, credit adjustments, technical investigations, one\-off scripts).
* Define and enforce SLAs to provide customer\-facing teams with clear expectations and predictable response times.
* Serve as the primary engineering point of contact for the L3 support team, meeting regularly to unblock escalations and ensure timely resolution.



**Data Migrations** 



* Own the data migration process end\-to\-end: intake, scoping, execution, and validation.
* Design, build, and improve migration pipelines to significantly reduce turnaround times.
* Troubleshoot and debug migration failures across the full stack (application, database, infrastructure).
* Data migrations are among Manatal's highest\-stakes operational challenges and a key driver of customer retention.



**Software Development \& Tooling** 



* Write production code across Manatal's backend (Python/Django, FastAPI) and frontend (Vue.js, React) codebases to fix bugs, implement operational improvements, and connect systems.
* Build and maintain internal tools (Retool, custom applications) that enable customer\-facing teams to self\-serve on tasks that currently require engineering intervention.
* Maintain and update API endpoints and Open API documentation as required.
* Identify and systematically eliminate repetitive manual work through automation.



**Bug Intake, Routing \& Lifecycle** 



* Own the bug triage process: intake, severity assessment, routing to the appropriate squad, and lifecycle tracking through resolution.
* Define and maintain bug SLAs. Implement automated reporting to provide leadership with visibility into bug volume, resolution times, and trends.
* Manage vulnerability report intake and ensure findings are triaged and routed to the appropriate team.



**Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 



* Work closely with the Director of Engineering to protect squad focus by absorbing operational engineering load.
* Partner with Customer Support, Sales, and L3 to identify pain points and deliver engineering solutions.
* Exercise strong judgment on escalation: determine when to resolve directly, when to delegate within the team, and when to engage a product squad.



**Requirements** 



* 5\+ years of hands\-on software engineering experience, with demonstrated ability to lead a team while remaining deeply involved in technical work.
* Strong proficiency in Python (Django and/or FastAPI), with the ability to write and ship production\-quality code.
* Experience with frontend development (Vue.js or React), including the ability to build interfaces and contribute to customer\-facing applications.
* Solid understanding of cloud infrastructure, with the ability to investigate production issues, interpret logs, and troubleshoot across the stack.
* Experience building or improving operational processes (bug triage, internal tooling, SLAs, request management).
* Demonstrated ability to work directly with customers or customer\-facing teams on technical matters.
* Strong prioritization skills and the ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams under pressure.
* People management experience.
* Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal.



**Nice to Have** 



* Experience with data migrations or data pipeline work at scale.
* Experience in a B2B platform company transitioning from SMB to enterprise.
* Background in building self\-service tooling for non\-technical teams (Retool or similar).
* Familiarity with API documentation standards (OpenAPI/Swagger).
* Familiarity with AI\-assisted workflows for operational automation.
* Experience with recruitment technology or HR tech.



**Working with Manatal** 



* This role is based at our Bangkok office in the heart of the city center
* As a team of diverse cultures and nationalities, English language proficiency is required
* We enjoy collaborating in person, and the team is working on\-site



**Why you'll enjoy working with Manatal** 



* Well\-funded start\-up backed by Surge \& Sequoia
* Be part of one of the fastest\-growing B2B SaaS start\-ups in the region
* You will be collaborating with talented individuals in the industry
* Join a lively and highly international team
* Indulge in a challenging and innovative working culture
* Attractive medical healthcare plan
* Personal development allowance
* 2 weeks of work from anywhere per year
* Regular fun team\-building activities



**Hiring Process:** 




 You can expect in our hiring process some or all of the following rounds:
 


1. Introduction interview with the HR team
2. Introduction interview with CTO and/or Director of Engineering
3. Technical Interview with technical assessment
4. Cultural fit interview with top management team



**Our Tech Stack:** 




 Our engineering team leverages a variety of modern technologies. While working at Manatal, you can expect to be exposed to the following stack:
 


* **Infrastructure:** 
 Amazon Web Services; Kubernetes; GitOps (ArgoCD), GitHub Actions, Terraform, among others.
* **Backend:**
* Language: Python (Django, FastAPI);
* Databases: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Open/ElasticSearch, and Redis, among others;
* Other: Celery, RabbitMQ, among others.
* **Frontend:** 
 Typescript (Vue, React)



**Learn more about Manatal:** 



* Get to know more about us and our product: www.manatal.com
* Watch a product demo of Manatal product: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v\=\-GG1GqXkAKQ



**Manatal Hiring:** 
*At Manatal, we are dedicated to building an intuitive AI\-powered application tracking system to streamline and transform the entire hiring and recruitment process.* 




*We are devoted to attracting the best talent worldwide to join our team and take pride in being an equal\-opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of religion, race, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, gender, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, marital or parental status, disability, age, citizenship or other class protected by applicable law.*

KEO is a creative enterprise, where innovation is a way of life. We are uniquely resourced with end\-to\-end services to take clients from inspiration – through conceptualization – to realization of planning, design or project delivery in the built and natural environments. For over 60 years we’ve led with vision, contributing to many of the world’s most ambitious projects, iconic places, remarkable experiences and prosperous communities.
 



  





 As a highly integrated and agile AEP/PMCM firm, KEO is recognized by ENR as one of the Top 225 International Design Firms and one of the Top 20 International PM/CM Firms. We are also ranked by World Architecture as the 51st largest global architecture firm and the \#1 Firm in the Middle East Region in their 2024 WA100 Survey.
 



  





 We invite you to join us. Why?
 



  





 When you join KEO, you’ll discover more than just a job – you’ll find a supportive environment that fosters your professional development through internal global mobility and career development and does so within a culture that supports company\-wide health and well\-being through on\-demand counselling services and regular workplace clinics. You will be invited to celebrate community events such as sports days, fun\-runs, in\-house sports teams and beach clean ups. In addition to your competitive package and benefits you will have access to a suite of policies that include hybrid working arrangements, individual athletic sponsorship, study assistance sponsorship, employee referral rewards.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  





 Our newest opportunity is for a talented Cloud and Infrastructure Platforms Director to to join our award\-winning team based in Dubai, UAE.
 



  





 This critical leadership role is responsible for defining, delivering, and managing the organization’s enterprise cloud, infrastructure, and platform strategy across regional and international operations. The successful candidate will lead the modernization of IT infrastructure, cloud adoption, cybersecurity resilience, digital workplace technologies, and enterprise platform services to support a rapidly growing construction consultancy business.
 



  





 The role requires a highly experienced technology leader with a strong background in hybrid cloud environments, enterprise infrastructure operations, IT governance, cybersecurity, and large\-scale transformation initiatives within complex, multi\-site organizations.
 



  





 We envisage success in this role to include;
 



  





**Strategic \& Platform Leadership** 




  




* Define and execute KEO's cloud\-first, platform\-first infrastructure strategy, leading the evolution from traditional operations toward a modern platform engineering model that enables self\-service, automated, and product\-oriented infrastructure capabilities.
* Manage and continuously improve service reliability at enterprise scale, owning KEO's infrastructure performance and availability posture in alignment with digital transformation goals and business priorities.



  





**Cloud \& Platform Engineering** 




  




* Own and evolve KEO's Microsoft Azure environment, leading the design, deployment, and lifecycle management of IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS platforms through cloud\-native architectures, infrastructure\-as\-code (IaC), and platform engineering principles to ensure scalability, security, cost\-optimization, and developer agility.
* Oversee identity and access management via Microsoft Entra ID, enforcing MFA, RBAC, and least\-privilege principles, and manage KEO's zero\-trust network architecture ensuring access is granted only through verified identity, context, and policy.
* Maintain certified digital platforms \- including Microsoft SharePoint and Autodesk Construction Cloud \- to their respective security and governance standards.
* Drive cloud cost optimization initiatives \- including right\-sizing, reserved capacity management, and workload scheduling \- to maximize return on cloud investment.



  





**Cybersecurity \& Digital Trust** 




  




* Champion KEO's cybersecurity posture across all infrastructure and platform operations, overseeing Microsoft Sentinel (SIEM) for real\-time threat detection, automated response playbooks, and rapid incident management, alongside cloud security posture management (CSPM) for continuous assessment and remediation of misconfigurations and vulnerabilities.
* Ensure zero\-trust, least\-privilege, and access control governance principles are consistently applied and independently verified via EY audits, and lead KEO's phishing simulation programme to drive continuous improvements in security awareness.
* Maintain and continuously improve Business Continuity Planning (BCP) and Disaster Recovery (DR) programmes \- including automation of recovery workflows, regular testing, and audit\-readiness \- with appropriate escalation to IT leadership and executive oversight.



  





**Modern Service Management** 




  




* Lead a shift from traditional ITIL\-process orientation toward experience\-driven, outcome\-based service management, owning service reliability engineering practices including SLAs, SLOs, and error budgets across all platforms.
* Lead continuous service improvement cycles, platform lifecycle governance, and technology refresh programmes, ensuring all operations adhere to KEO's IT governance standards, security policies, regulatory requirements, and green IT sustainability commitments.



  





**Automation, DevOps \& SRE Mindset** 




  




* Champion an automation\-first culture, leading the implementation of infrastructure automation, CI/CD pipeline integration, self\-service cloud provisioning, and zero\-touch operations to eliminate manual processes at scale.
* Apply Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles \- including error budgets, reliability targets, and blameless post\-incident reviews \- to drive continuous improvement in platform deployment velocity, reliability, and recovery time.



  





**Data\-Driven \& AI\-Enabled Operations** 




  




* Lead the adoption of observability platforms and AIOps tooling to enable predictive performance monitoring, anomaly detection, and automated incident response, driving responsible AI adoption to enhance infrastructure efficiency, intelligent capacity planning, and proactive operations
* Use operational telemetry and data\-driven insights to inform platform investment decisions and continuous improvement initiatives, staying at the forefront of AI\-driven infrastructure operations and edge computing to evaluate and recommend adoption pathways aligned to KEO's strategy.



  





**Team Leadership \& People Development** 




  




* Lead, coach, and develop a high\-performing, geographically distributed infrastructure team, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning.
* Set clear goals, provide regular feedback, and champion professional growth and certification of each team member.
* Build a psychologically safe team environment where automation innovation, constructive challenge, and knowledge sharing are actively encouraged.
* Promote cross\-functional collaboration with Digital Workplace, Enterprise Digital Solutions, and Technology Strategy teams to ensure “one IT” delivery



  





**Qualifications** 




  





 To be successful in this dynamic opportunity, we envision that your career journey to date will include 10–15\+ years of progressive experience in enterprise IT infrastructure, including a minimum of 3–5 years in a leadership capacity managing teams, cloud platforms, or enterprise infrastructure operations. You will hold a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline, or possess an equivalent combination of education and over 10 years of relevant professional experience.
 



  




* Proven, hands\-on experience managing Microsoft Azure cloud environments at enterprise scale, including hybrid cloud architecture, identity, and security services.
* Demonstrated experience leading a shift from traditional infrastructure management to modern platform engineering and DevOps\-aligned operations.
* Strong expertise in Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD for infrastructure, self\-service cloud provisioning, and zero\-touch operations.
* Experience applying Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles, including error budgets, SLOs, and blameless post\-incident review practices.
* Proven cloud financial management (FinOps) experience: cost optimization, chargeback models, consumption governance, and cloud cost dashboards.
* Deep expertise in cybersecurity operations: Microsoft Sentinel (SIEM), zero\-trust architecture, cloud security posture management (CSPM), Entra ID / Azure AD, and endpoint security.
* Experience managing third\-party governance and audit review processes.
* Familiarity with AI\-driven infrastructure operations, edge computing architectures, and platform product models.
* Experience in the AEC (Architecture, Engineering, and Construction) or professional services sector is advantageous.
* Understanding of sustainable/green IT infrastructure principles and their application to cloud operations.



  





 KEO’s performance is founded upon integrity, results, innovation, safety and our people. We embrace diversity and recognise its’ contribution to client success wherever we work.
 



  





 We are excited to hear how you can partner with our award\-winning team and treat all expressions of interest confidentially.

**Who We Are:** 
 At Huda Beauty, our Vision is to lead in creating a democratized beauty industry where power is given back to people to define, create, and enjoy beauty for themselves! Launched by award\-winning beauty powerhouse Huda Kattan in 2013, Huda Beauty is one of the world's fastest\-growing beauty brands. A lot has changed since our launch in 2013, but something that will forever remain at the core of Huda Beauty is our focus on business excellence and our unwavering passion for kindness!
   

  

**Summary:** 
 We're seeking a strategic and hands\-on
 **Head of Post\-Production** 
 to lead and elevate Huda Beauty's video content function. In this role, you will own the post\-production vision across brand campaigns, social\-first content, and marketing initiatives, while managing and mentoring a team of four in\-house editors.
   

  

 You'll work closely with Creative, Marketing, and Social teams to ensure best\-in\-class output, efficient workflows, and consistent on\-time delivery. This role requires deep post\-production expertise, strong leadership, and the ability to operate in a fast\-paced, high\-volume content environment. You'll be responsible for setting creative and technical standards, streamlining operations, developing talent, and ensuring creative excellence from concept through final delivery.
   

  

 This is a hybrid role: highly strategic, yet hands\-on when needed \- supporting shoots, defining technical approaches, and building a scalable ecosystem of videographers and freelance partners.
   

  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**
* Manage and mentor a team of 4 editors
* Lead, plan, and manage post\-production for a full slate of video projects
* Manage post\-production schedules and traffic control
* Create and implement processes and workflows that enable the team to work efficiently and independently
* Guide team development, helping junior members grow towards independence
* Oversee branded storytelling, ensuring delivery of best\-in\-class assets in line with brand vision
* Juggle multiple high\-priority post\-production projects in various stages, ensuring deadlines are met
* Identify workflow gaps in post\-production and lead continuous improvement initiatives
* Develop and refine a distinctive Huda Beauty editing style \- color grading, motion graphics/animation, sound design
* Work closely with the Head of Agency to build efficient project tracking, workflow systems, and deadline rigor
* Be a force for innovation \- integrate AI or other new tools into video production where appropriate
* Build robust storage solutions and archives
* Maintain a network of freelancers/vendors to scale up for projects when needed


**Requirements**
* 10\+ years' experience in post\-production management or a closely related field
* Deep understanding of all areas of post‑production: editing, color grading, VFX, sound design
* Ability to manage multiple projects at once under tight deadlines
* Experience working in agency, brand in\-house, or post\-production house environments
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence, align, and drive decisions across multiple teams
* Prior experience managing teams of 5\+ direct reports and freelancers
* Proficient with editing software (Premiere Pro is required; After Effects, etc.)
* Excellent creativity, communication, and attention to detail
* Social\-first mindset with a deep understanding of digital and platform\-native video content


**Benefits**
* Monthly "Self Love Days" (at company discretion)
* Premium Medical/Dental/Vision coverage for employee plus dependents
* Monthly coaching sessions with our in\-house Success Coach
* Employee discounts on all Huda Beauty products
* Quarterly product gifting


*Huda Beauty is committed to building diverse and inclusive teams and upholding an equal employment workplace that is free from discrimination. We hire stellar individuals regardless of their race, color, ancestry, religion, gender identity, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, medical conditions, disability, or veteran status. If you need reasonable accommodations at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.*

data.jd_text:
**Enjoy a career, packaged with care, whilst helping protect food, people and the planet**
 We are a key global provider of sustainable packaging solutions. We’re on a mission to make all packaging recyclable, reusable, or compostable. Every day, we ensure the hygiene and safety of food and drink for people around the world. We are Huhtamaki.
   

  

 You could be part of our vision. Because it’s our talented people that make it happen. Our people on the shop floor producing innovative, sustainable products. Our people in our offices delivering excellence for our customers every day. It’s every one of us working together.
   

  

 We offer a place where you can feel safe, be supported, and make an impact so we can all focus on the future together.
   

  

**Your opportunity**
 We are looking for a Head of Finance, MEA, to plan, organize, lead and control the Finance activities for the Region in order to support the delivery of the required growth, revenue, profit, working capital, cash flow and EBIT objectives. You will be the finance business partner for regional leadership and play an essential role in providing financial information, analysis and recommendations to make strategically consistent and financially sound decisions.
   

  

 This role reports to VP MEA and to our Flexible Packaging Segment VP Finance.
   

  

**Where you’ll be**
 This role is located in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Develop and execute the financial strategy for the MEA region, ensuring alignment with overall business objectives.
* Take full responsibility for financial reporting and controlling across the MEA region, delivering timely, accurate, and insightful analysis in line with Segment and Group reporting requirements.
* Lead and coordinate strategic and budget planning processes, ensuring clear targets, KPIs, and objectives are established and aligned with business goals.
* Ensure accurate forecasting to support effective decision\-making and long\-term planning.
* Oversee capital expenditure planning and monitoring, including project costs, approvals, financing, cash flow, and return on investment. Regularly review existing investments to assess their continued viability.
* Drive working capital optimization by collaborating closely with country teams to improve inventory, receivables, payables, debt management, and capital project efficiency, ultimately maximizing cash flow and returns.
* Identify and manage foreign currency exposures to minimize risk and protect financial performance.
* Review and enhance financial processes and procedures, ensuring strong governance, data accuracy, compliance, and operational discipline.
* Provide financial analysis and support for divestments, restructuring, and expansion initiatives, including the development of robust financial models for strategic decision\-making.
* Ensure effective implementation of business and productivity improvement initiatives by establishing follow\-up and control mechanisms to track progress, savings, efficiency gains, and value creation.
* Support continuous process improvements and ERP transformation initiatives within Flexible Packaging MEA.
* Lead the Finance organization in MEA, delivering high\-quality operational finance services and business controlling. Build a capable, well\-structured team while fostering strong engagement and collaboration, and supporting regional business priorities.


**What You’ll Bring To The Role**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field and / or a professional qualification (e.g., CPA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent).
* Strong experience in finance leadership on regional or multi country level or global context preferably in manufacturing or FMCG environment.
* Proven experience in managing and leading finance teams and functions with a strong business partnering ability.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.
* Resilience and willingness to win.
* Ability to assess, analyze and synthesize a great deal of information and simplify the complexities.
* Fluent in English, excellent communication skills with ability to establish credibility, respect and build strong working relationships.
* A leadership style aligned with Huhtamaki’s values: Care, Dare and Deliver.


**What We Offer In Return**
* Opportunity to make an impact: in this role you can truly bring value with your finance and business expertise to drive business performance, co\-develop the business strategy and direction while providing leadership to finance teams with build up talent and capabilities.
* A meaningful job: At Huhtamaki, we believe in protecting food, people and the planet. Our innovative and transformative solutions touch the daily lives of people everywhere.
* Development opportunities: We care for each other – and want to see our talent thrive and develop.
* Responsible employer: Sustainability is embedded in everything we do. We believe diverse teams fuel innovation. We invest in fostering an environment where everyone is safe both psychologically and physically and where diversity and inclusion are promoted through day\-to\-day behaviors, reinforced by our policies and practices.


 If this sounds like a good fit, then we’d love to hear from you!
   

  

 Join us. Help protect food, people and the planet.

data.jd_text:
**MAIN OBJECTIVE OF ROLE**
 To maximize fleet value by optimizing Cost per Available Seat Kilometer (CASK), aircraft utilization, operational introduction and lifecycle performance across all operated fleets (737, 787\), by managing key fleet cost drivers such as modification programs, BFE agreements, maintenance contracts, and utilization efficiency through structured SLA and KPI analysis, and ensures effective governance of contractual performance guarantees and deliverables across operational agreements, while leading operational project execution with strong cost control, disciplined oversight, operational performance and delivery within agreed timelines.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Establishes processes for analyzing CASK at an aircraft level across all fleets, establishing a baseline cost per fleet.
* Evaluates changes to baseline costs resulting from modification programmes, system changes, network planning data and new contracts.
* Ensures that existing contracts for OEM, BFE \& Maintenance Services are performing in accordance with expectations, SLAs and performance guarantees.
* Establishes structured framework for contract management over the lifecycle in order to ensure compliance against scope, ensure that objectives are clearly understood and enforce contract adherence
* Identifies risks on the CASK, resulting from operational influences, engagement with stakeholders to ensure mitigation.
* Evaluates OEM \& 3rd Party changes and proposed changes to fleet and evaluate cost impact against financial expectation, ensuring that agreed business cases yield positive results.
* Provides strategic oversight for statistical analysis, data visualization, reports to stakeholders, make recommendations supported by data trends
* Oversees end\-to\-end ownership of operational fleet strategy across all fleet typesensuring alignment with network, operations, and commercial requirements
* Establishes definition and continuous optimization of fleet configuration strategies across all sub\-fleets to support efficiency and standardization
* Ensures full lifecycle cost management including acquisition, operations, modification, and retirement cost driversin liaison with relevant stakeholders.
* Oversees management of fleet configuration complexity and retrofit and reduction of sub\-fleet variation where commercially and operationally viable .
* Manages and oversight of CAPEX prioritization, benefits realization, and lifecycle value optimization across all major operational investments.
* Defines and translates fleet data into actionable decisions for strategy, investment, and operational optimization
* Consolidation of fleet governance forums, committees, and working groups into a single accountable structure
* Prioritizes and sequencing of fleet modification programs based on cost impact, operational disruption, and strategic value.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s Degree (3\+ years)
* Bachelor’s Degree in Aviation Management, Finance or Engineering with a Master’s Degree preferable
* Fluent in English
* Extensive experience in airline operations, engineering, and fleet/technical programs, operational systems with exposure to both narrow\-body and wide\-body aircraft environments. Proven track record in delivering large\-scale CAPEX and strategic transformation projects, including aircraft induction, retrofit programs, and IT/system implementations. Strong background in governance of multi\-million\-dollar portfolios, with focus on cost optimization, lifecycle value, and performance of key operational contracts. Demonstrated ability to lead cross\-functional initiatives across COO, engineering, airport operations, and external partners to ensure disciplined, on\-time project delivery and business impact.
* 0
* Years with qualifications: 10 \- 12 years


**COMPETENCIES**
* Customer Focus
* Team work
* Effective Communication
* Personal Accountability \& Commitment to achieve
* Resilience and Flexibility (Can do attitude)
* Inspiring \& Developing Others
* Decision Making
* Strategic Thinking
* Business Acumen


**Isr Requirements**
 Reads and complies with the ISR policies of the Company and diligently reports any weakness or incidents to the respective Line Manager or the Information Security team. Completes all required ISR awareness sessions and follows associated guidelines in the day\-to\-day business operations.

data.jd_text:
**Project Manager – ONESOURCE**
**Thomson Reuters** 
 is a leading provider of transaction tax management solutions to companies of all sizes, enabling Finance, Tax and IT professionals to achieve accurate, timely and cost\-effective compliance. Our flagship offering, the Thomson Reuters Application Suite, provides Consolidated Transaction Tax Management software and services, enabling global enterprise to manage sales, use, value\-add, excise and specialty taxes with consistency, accuracy, control and efficiency. The marketplace is demanding our products, and Thomson Reuters is poised to grow significantly over the next several years in geographies across the world.
   

  

 We are now hiring an
 **ONESOURCE Technology Implementation \& Consulting Project Manager** 
 to lead the delivery of software implementation projects within the Indirect Tax consulting organization. You will work closely with project teams, peer project managers, sales, customer service, clients, and partner consulting teams.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a
 **ONESOURCE Project Manager,** 
 you will be responsible for:
   

  

* Service Delivery \& Portfolio Management
* Manage an assigned portfolio of Thomson Reuters implementation projects.
* Direct project teams and own end\-to\-end delivery.
* Ensure strong planning, quality control, client management, and customer satisfaction.
* End\-to\-End Project Management
* Lead project planning sessions to define scope, approach, and delivery plans.
* Manage multiple complex projects/issues simultaneously, often requiring subject matter expertise.
* Drive operational improvements, efficiency, and results.
* Meet revenue and utilization targets as defined by management.
* Communication \& Status Reporting
* Maintain clear communication with clients and internal teams.
* Prepare and deliver regular project status updates.
* Share knowledge and updates across the broader organization.
* Delivery Leadership
* Provide guidance and leadership to team members (and/or manage a team).
* Make routine decisions within established guidelines, including approved exceptions.
* Manage or contribute to project cost control, forecasting, and budget recommendations.
* Ensure quality and timeliness of deliverables; maintain accountability across the team.
* Provide insights and recommendations to support broader organizational goals.
* Consulting \& Subject Matter Expertise
* Deliver consulting services to external clients in tax technology, legal, and global trade domain as part of Thomson Reuters Professional service team.
* Provide subject matter expertise to support customer deliverables.
* Travel
* 40–45% travel is required.


**About You**
 To be our
 **ONESOURCE Project Manager** 
 , you will likely have:
   

  

* 12\+ years of core project management experience (with project management certification e.g., PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent).
* 15\+ years total experience in ERP, tax, or technology domains.
* Experience delivering consulting and technology implementation projects with diverse teams and large customers, including MENA and global clients.
* Proven ability to manage multiple parallel projects end\-to\-end.
* Strong understanding of:
+ O2C (Order\-to\-Cash) and/or P2P (Procure\-to\-Pay)
+ Indirect tax, e\-invoicing, or related tax technology processes

* Background in tax technology or professional services organizations (e.g., systems integrators, ERP consulting firms, Big 4\), ideally supporting large enterprises.
* Strong communication and coordination skills, including stakeholder management with senior client leadership, partners, and consultants.
* Fluent English (Arabic is a plus).


**Highly Desired**
* Integration/implementation experience with enterprise tax products such as ONESOURCE Tax Determination, Pagero e\-invoicing, Taxware, Vertex, Avalara
* Experience with implementation and rollout of large ERP programs and/or Tax transformation and/or E\-invoice solution implementation project management.


**What’s in it For You?**
* Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment (2\-3 days a week in the office depending on the role) for our office\-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
* Flexibility \& Work\-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work\-life balance.
* Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real\-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills\-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI\-enabled future.
* Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company\-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
* Culture: Globally recognized, award\-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work\-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
* Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro\-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
* Making a Real\-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.


**About Us**
 Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.
   

  

 We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.
   

  

 As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug\-free workplace.
   

  

 We also make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law. More information on requesting an accommodation here.
   

  

 Learn more on how to protect yourself from fraudulent job postings here.
   

  

 More information about Thomson Reuters can be found on thomsonreuters.com.
