 Serve as the owner's area manager for the Utilities area on the 2\.5 Mtpa green Direct Reduced Iron (DRI) / Hot Briquetted Iron (HBI) project in Duqm, Oman. Carry technical and commercial accountability for the Utilities area, encompassing air separation (ASU; nitrogen and ox
data.jd_text:
**Purpose / Mission:**
 Serve as the owner's area manager for the Utilities area on the 2\.5 Mtpa green Direct Reduced Iron (DRI) / Hot Briquetted Iron (HBI) project in Duqm, Oman. Carry technical and commercial accountability for the Utilities area, encompassing air separation (ASU; nitrogen and oxygen production), water treatment and management (raw water, demineralised water, cooling water, fire water), wastewater management and zero liquid discharge (ZLD), compressed air and instrument air, plant air, gas distribution (nitrogen, oxygen, hydrogen, natural gas as applicable), and the utilities\-process interface with DRI and BoP areas. Dual\-role overlay as Lead Process Engineer for utilities scope; DRI process authority sits separately with a dedicated DRI Process Engineer post\-FID. Lead the Utilities scope from pre\-FID through FEED, EPC tender, construction, commissioning and ramp\-up.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
 Own technical and commercial accountability for the Utilities area, including scope definition, OEM selection, contract negotiation, claims management, schedule and cost ownership for the area.
   

  

 Lead the owner's engineering definition of the air separation unit and gas distribution system serving the plant.
   

  

 Lead the owner's engineering of the plant water systems including raw water intake or supply, demineralised water production, cooling water systems, fire water, and the integrated water balance.
   

  

 Own the design and delivery of the wastewater management and zero liquid discharge (ZLD) strategy, with particular attention to the water\-constrained Duqm site and applicable Omani regulatory requirements.
   

  

 Lead the owner's engineering of compressed air, instrument air, plant air and gas distribution systems including nitrogen and oxygen distribution to point\-of\-use.
   

  

 Provide cross\-area utilities discipline authority including review and assurance of utility interfaces with the DRI, BoP, Materials Handling and HV areas.
   

  

 Provide Utilities area input to specifications, tender documentation, technical evaluations and award recommendations for the utility EPC and equipment packages, including interfaces with major utilities OEMs and licensors (Air Liquide, Linde, Air Products and equivalents).
   

  

 Review and approve utilities engineering deliverables from the Owner's Engineer and EPC contractors.
   

  

 Lead Utilities area input to HAZID, HAZOP, SIL assessment, LOPA and related process safety studies.
   

  

 Support cost estimate development for utilities scope to FID\-level accuracy.
   

  

 Provide Utilities area technical and commercial leadership during construction, pre\-commissioning, commissioning and performance testing.
   

  

 Cross\-area coordination: the plant\-wide cable and pipe bridge system spans the BoP, Materials Handling and Logistics, Utilities and High Voltage areas. Civil and structural design ownership sits with the BoP Area Manager; routing, occupancy and interface management is a joint responsibility of the BoP, MH\&L, Utilities and HV Area Managers. The four Area Managers will agree corridor strategy, support spacing, occupancy planning and revision control as a co\-ordinated workstream.
   

  

 Contribute to the development and mentoring of process and utilities engineering resources as the in\-country team grows from pre\-FID into execution.
   

  

**Requirements / Skills / Experience:**
 Minimum 15 years' experience in heavy industrial process plant utilities engineering, with a clear strength in process discipline depth across multiple utilities including at least three of: air separation, water treatment systems, wastewater and ZLD, compressed air and gas distribution, and steam systems where applicable.
   

  

 Strong preference for direct experience on integrated steel, ironmaking, petrochemical, fertilizer, refinery, mining or analogous heavy industrial greenfield projects.
   

  

 Direct experience interfacing with major utilities OEMs and licensors (Air Liquide, Linde, Air Products for ASU, and equivalents for water treatment) is a strong advantage.
   

  

 Experience across the full project lifecycle: FEED, detailed design, procurement, construction supervision, commissioning and ramp\-up.
   

  

 Demonstrated commercial muscle on top of technical authority: experience owning a utilities package end\-to\-end from scope definition through OEM selection, contract execution, claims management and closeout.
   

  

 Direct experience with ZLD or advanced wastewater systems is a strong advantage for the water\-constrained Duqm site.
   

  

 Experience with cooling water systems including seawater cooling is a strong advantage.
   

  

 Demonstrated familiarity with international process and utilities design codes (ASME, API, ISA, IEC) and applicable Omani regulatory requirements.
   

  

 Demonstrated leadership in process safety, including accountability for HAZOP, SIL and process hazard analysis outcomes.
   

  

**Prior GCC Or Extreme\-environment Project Experience Preferred.**
 Demonstrated ability to operate as a senior technical and commercial authority in a lean owner team environment.
   

  

 Strong communication, technical writing and review skills.
   

  

**Required Education / Qualification / Training:**
 Bachelor's degree in Chemical, Process, Mechanical or related engineering discipline (required). Master's degree in Process or Chemical Engineering (preferred). Chartered Engineer, Professional Engineer or equivalent internationally recognized professional status (preferred). Member of a recognized professional engineering institution (e.g. IChemE, AIChE, IMechE) (preferred).
   

  

**Required Language Proficiency:**
 English \- Fluent
   

  

 Arabic \- Nice to have

We are partnering with a leading regional bank looking for a senior executive to lead its enterprise\-wide digital and AI transformation agenda. This is a high\-impact role connecting the business, technology, and innovation, with responsibility for shaping and executing the bank’s digitalization strategy across multiple markets.
   

  

 The right candidate will work closely with the executive leadership to drive value using advanced analytics, AI, and next\-generation digital capabilities, while ensuring alignment with commercial objectives, regulatory expectations, and customer outcomes.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Define and drive the organization’s digital and AI transformation strategy in line with overall business goals
* Identify high\-value opportunities to embed AI and advanced analytics across core banking functions and customer journeys
* Lead the development and deployment of scalable digital and AI\-driven solutions
* Oversee innovation initiatives, including emerging technologies, and ensure practical business application
* Build, lead, and develop a high\-performing team of data scientists, AI specialists, and digital experts
* Partner with senior stakeholders across business, risk, technology, and compliance to ensure seamless execution
* Establish clear success metrics to track impact, adoption, and ROI of digital initiatives


**Required Experience \& Skills:**
* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or similar
* Extensive experience leading digital and AI transformation within financial services
* Strong track record of delivering enterprise\-wide technology\-driven change initiatives
* Deep understanding of AI, machine learning, and data\-driven decision\-making
* Proven ability to build and lead multidisciplinary, high\-performing teams
* Strong commercial mindset with the ability to link technology initiatives to business value
* Experience engaging with senior executives and influencing strategic direction


**What We’re Looking For:**
* Strategic thinker with a hands\-on approach to execution
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
* Forward\-looking mindset with a passion for innovation and emerging technologies
* Sound understanding of governance, risk, and ethical considerations in digital and AI initiatives


 If interested, please apply to this advertisement directly or send your CV to
   

  

**mailto:anam.fatima@madisonpearl.com**

data.jd_text:
**Shape the future of AI on a global scale with a market leader!** 




  





 A globally recognized industrial technology organisation is seeking an exceptional AI leader to define and execute its enterprise\-wide artificial intelligence strategy.
 



  





 This is a rare opportunity to build and lead a newly established Global AI Hub, influencing the future direction of a multinational business that is investing heavily in digital transformation, intelligent products, and AI\-enabled services.
 



  





 Reporting to executive leadership, you will be responsible for embedding AI across products, operations, customer solutions, and business functions, creating measurable commercial impact and long\-term competitive advantage.
 



  





**The Opportunity** 



* Define and execute the organization's global AI vision, strategy and operating model.
* Build and lead a world\-class Global AI Hub, establishing the capabilities, governance and delivery frameworks required for enterprise\-scale success.
* Identify high\-value AI opportunities across products, services, manufacturing, operations and customer\-facing solutions.
* Lead the development and commercialization of AI\-enabled products and digital services from concept through to market launch.
* Drive AI adoption across global business units, regional organizations and functional teams.
* Establish robust governance covering AI ethics, data management, cybersecurity, regulatory compliance and responsible AI practices.
* Develop strategic partnerships with leading technology providers, universities, research institutions and AI ecosystem partners.
* Inspire cross\-functional teams to accelerate innovation and deliver measurable business outcomes.



  





**About You** 



* 8\+ years' experience leading AI, digital transformation, technology or innovation functions within complex global organisations.
* A proven track record of building AI, data science or digital innovation teams from the ground up.
* Experience delivering technology\-led products, platforms or digital services that generate measurable business value.
* Strong knowledge of modern AI and data ecosystems, including cloud platforms, MLOps, data engineering and technologies such as Databricks, Kafka or comparable enterprise platforms.
* Deep understanding of artificial intelligence, Generative AI, machine learning and customer\-centric digital product development.
* Exceptional stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence executive leadership, business units, engineering teams and external partners.
* Experience leading geographically distributed, cross\-functional teams in international environments.
* A strategic mindset balanced with the ability to execute and deliver tangible results.



  





**Ideal Background** 




 We are particularly interested in leaders from sectors such as:
 



  




* Industrial Technology
* Smart Manufacturing
* Industrial IoT
* Building Technologies
* Water Infrastructure \& Utilities
* Critical Infrastructure
* Digital Platforms
* AI\-enabled Software \& Technology



  





 Experience within engineering\-led or industrial organizations would be highly advantageous, although exceptional candidates from adjacent technology sectors will also be considered.
 



  





**Why This Role?** 




 This is more than a leadership position, it is an opportunity to define how AI shapes the future of a global organisation.
 



  





 You will have executive sponsorship, significant investment, and the autonomy to build a best\-in\-class AI function that delivers real commercial impact across international markets.
 



  





 If you are excited by the opportunity to build, lead and scale enterprise AI on a global stage, we would welcome a confidential discussion.

**Job Description**
 Payments Product Management is a dynamic and diverse Product team responsible for product strategy, development and commercialization of the payments solutions that J.P. Morgan delivers to global clients. These product solutions cover across CEEMEA countries and support our corporate and financial clients.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 As a CEEMEA Core Cash Payments Product Manager in the CEEMEA Core Cash Payments team you will be an integral part of the team that innovates new product offerings and leads the end\-to\-end product life cycle. As a core member of the team, you will be responsible for acting as the voice of the customer and developing profitable products that provide customer value. Utilizing your deep understanding of how to get a product off the ground, you guide the successful launch of products, gather crucial feedback, and ensure top\-tier client experiences. With a strong commitment to scalability, resiliency, and stability, you collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality products that exceed customer expectations.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with Sales, Service, Treasury, Operations, Technology, Risk, Compliance and Legal
* Own P\&L (Profit \& Loss) including accurate financial planning, analytics and delivery against revenue and expense targets
* Define and delivers the Core Cash Payment product strategy ensuring we achieve market leading and innovative capabilities with reduced risk and costs whilst driving increased financial profitability
* Act as Subject matter expert in core cash payments across CEEMEA countries
* Assume end\-to\-end understanding and accountability of payment execution
* Demonstrate a lead role in the payment industry through membership of industry working groups
* Implement thought leadership into our strategy, clients and the market
* Collaborate with various internal and external stakeholders in order to identify, develop and implement new solutions and product improvements that are globally consistent
* Design, presents and owns internal training and client facing materials
* Anticipate internal and external factors impacting the various Legal Entities and implementing plans to mitigate risks and capitalize on opportunities
* Understand the risks inherent in the product and drive programs to reduce or eliminate


**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* Extensive experience in designing and implementing solutions, either for clients or for improvement of internal processes, including development of roadmap/plan and timelines for execution
* Creative problem solver, capable of developing innovative and differentiated solutions
* Experience with and/or prior collaboration with Sales, Service, Operations and Technology
* Execution\-oriented self\-starter who likes to take initiative
* Commercial mindset with thought leadership
* Past experience in the Financial Services and payments business
* Demonstrated track record of managing risk
* Proven communication, presentation, influencing and interpersonal skills
* Computer skills including Excel, PowerPoint (PitchPro), Word and Tableau


**ABOUT US**
 J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first\-class business in a first\-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long\-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.
   

  

 We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.
   

  

**About The Team**
 J.P. Morgan's Commercial \& Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial \& Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

data.jd_text:
Welcome to
 **MultiBank Group** 
 , a global financial pioneer established in 2005 in California and now proudly headquartered in Dubai, UAE. We specialize in delivering cutting\-edge trading technology, deep liquidity, and exceptional customer service. Our extensive range of financial products includes Forex, Metals, Shares, Indices, Commodities, and Cryptocurrency CFDs.
 



  





 Join our thriving community of over 2 million clients across 100 countries, contributing to a daily trading volume exceeding US$ 35 billion. As a heavily regulated institution with oversight from 18\+ financial regulators across 5 continents, and recipient of over 80 financial awards, MultiBank Group is devoted to innovation, excellence, and empowering clients to achieve their financial goals.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are seeking a
 **Senior Manager, Global Payments \& Reporting** 
 to support the development, execution, and ongoing enhancement of our global payments infrastructure across brokerage and digital asset platforms.
 



 This role will play a key part in multi\-currency and crypto payment flows, reporting, transaction efficiency, and coordination with internal and external stakeholders to ensure scalable, compliant, and reliable payment operations across multiple markets.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




 • Contribute to the development and execution of global payments initiatives aligned with business growth across CFD/FX and crypto verticals.
 



 • Support the delivery of scalable, compliant, and cost\-efficient payment solutions across multiple markets.
 



 • Work closely with internal stakeholders to ensure payment operations support business requirements, platform performance, and client experience.
 



 • Assist in managing a global payments framework with flexibility for regional and local payment requirements where applicable.
 



 • Coordinate with relevant teams to ensure payment processes remain operationally effective, regionally relevant, and aligned with internal standards.
 



 • Monitor payment performance across markets, partners, platforms, and payment channels.
 



 • Work with banking partners, PSPs, payment gateways, digital asset payment channels where applicable, and internal platforms to support smooth payment operations.
 



 • Support payment integrations, process improvements, and enhancements to existing payment flows.
 



 • Help ensure the payment infrastructure supports multi\-currency fiat transactions and, where applicable, crypto\-related payment activity.
 



 • Monitor transaction flows, success rates, and operational efficiency through reporting and data analysis.
 



 • Prepare payment\-related reports, insights, and updates for internal stakeholders and management.
 



 • Identify trends, issues, and improvement opportunities to enhance payment processing, reporting accuracy, and operational performance.
 



 • Collaborate with technology, product, and operations teams to support secure, scalable, and user\-friendly payment solutions.
 



 • Contribute to process improvements and system enhancements within the payments function.
 



 • Support the improvement of internal payment workflows, controls, and reporting processes.
 



 • Work with Compliance and Risk teams to support adherence to applicable regulatory standards, AML/KYC protocols, and payment\-related requirements.
 



 • Monitor and escalate payment\-related risks, operational issues, and partner\-related concerns where required.
 



 • Support a controlled, compliant, and reliable payment environment across relevant jurisdictions.
 



  





**Qualifications** 




 • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Technology, Economics, or a related field is preferred.
 



  





**Required Experience \& Skills** 




 • Proven experience in payments, payment operations, fintech, brokerage, financial services, or crypto exchange environments.
 



 • Experience working with PSPs, banking partners, payment gateways, settlements, reconciliations, and fraud prevention processes.
 



 • Experience supporting or managing cross\-border payment flows, multi\-currency payments, and payment partner relationships.
 



 • Exposure to brokerage, CFD/FX, trading platforms, digital assets, or crypto\-related payment environments is preferred.
 



 • Experience coordinating with vendors, internal stakeholders, and cross\-functional teams across multiple markets.
 



 • Strong understanding of payment ecosystems, including transaction flows, settlements, reconciliation, reporting, and operational controls.
 



 • Strong analytical and reporting skills, with the ability to interpret payment data and present clear business insights.
 



  





**Preferred Skills** 




 • Good understanding of operational risk, compliance requirements, AML/KYC considerations, and regulated financial services environments.
 



 • Strong communication, problem\-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
 



 • Ability to work in a fast\-paced, global environment with multiple priorities and stakeholders.
 



 • Familiarity with regulatory frameworks across MENA, EU, and APAC regions is a plus.
 



  





**Why Join Us?** 



* Work with one of the world’s leading financial derivatives institutions.
* Competitive salary plus performance\-based incentives.
* Access to a dynamic, international, and fast\-growing environment.
* Strong opportunities for career progression within a global financial group.
* Be part of a business committed to innovation, excellence, and long\-term growth.



  





*Become part of our international community at MultiBank Group, dedicated to excellence, innovation, and shaping the future of finance.* 




  





*MultiBank Group is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of nationality, gender, age, religion, or disability.*

**About Us**
 We’re building the world’s leading cross\-border fintech for emerging markets \- empowering families, fueling local economies, and changing how millions access financial services.
   

  

 Since our launch in 2019, we have transformed how money moves across borders with our operations spanning 6 out of 7 continents and covering both the busiest and most underserved (remittance) corridors. We tapped into a massive shift \- from banks to phones \- bringing digital finance to places where traditional systems never reached. The next stage of growth will fuel a network of services and products especially designed to make money more accessible to diaspora communities including local cards, and additional savings and payments features.
   

  

 We’re growing fast, backed by world\-class investors, and scaling a product that blends
 **real world impact with cutting edge fintech innovation** 
 .
   

  

**Here’s a Little More**
* Founded by Harvard grads and 3\-time founders who previously built Segovia (acquired) and GiveDirectly (\>$300M revenue, fastest\-growing NGO in the world)
* Backed by top investors including Spark Capital, Canaan, Reid Hoffman, Breyer Capital, Unbound, Wamda, and more
* Built by global top performers from Bain, Google, McKinsey, Uber, Checkout, Bolt, and beyond \- we move fast, stay humble, and care deeply about our mission
* Truly global team \- 250\+ people, 50\+ nationalities, 50\+ languages
* Guided by our values \- ownership, impact, humility, and heart \- in deed, not just word


**Role**
 As Global Expansion Lead, you will report to the Director of Regulatory Affairs and own and drive our regulatory licensing strategy as we expand into new markets worldwide. You will sit at the intersection of regulation, product, and expansion, working cross\-functionally to apply for and obtain regulatory approvals.
   

  

 You’ll lead licensing applications across multiple jurisdictions, manage relationships with regulators and external advisors, and act as a key internal partner to teams across Legal, Compliance, Product, Operations, and Commercial. This is a hands\-on role for someone who thrives in complex regulatory environments and enjoys turning expansion strategy into reality.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own the end\-to\-end market entry process for new jurisdictions and products, navigating the approvals and frameworks needed to operate compliantly and at scale.
* Develop and maintain a global expansion roadmap aligned with the company's growth priorities.
* Assess feasibility, timelines, costs, and risks for new markets and products — and translate findings into clear recommendations for leadership.
* Track and interpret market and regulatory developments that impact our international growth and communicate them in practical terms to internal teams.
* Build scalable frameworks that support new market entry and help us transition smoothly from approval to live operations.


**Requirements**
* 5\+ years of experience in regulatory licensing, compliance, legal, or international expansion within financial services, fintech, or payments
* Direct experience leading license applications in multiple jurisdictions (e.g., UK, EU, Africa, Americas, LATAM, APAC)
* Strong understanding of cross\-border payments, cryptoassets, remittances, and regulated financial products
* Experience working with regulators and managing regulatory correspondence independently

* Outgoing \- you love speaking to people and enjoy building meaningful relationships
* Execution Oriented \- we have an ‘impact first’ philosophy and a lot to get done. You should be able to take an idea to implementation
* Mission Oriented \- you are passionate about working for a net positive organisation/tech for good
* Organised \- you have a system for how you approach the work that can keep you on track and prioritise well
* Driven \- you thrive in an ambitious, target\-oriented company

 Win with grit

All employment decisions are decided on the basis of qualifications, experience and business need. We strongly encourage applications who are members of underrepresented communities to apply.

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
 finera is seeking a Merchant Settlements Officer to join the Finance team in Dubai. This role is responsible for ensuring the accuracy, timeliness, and integrity of merchant settlement processes across payment systems and internal financial records.
   

  

 The position plays a key role in managing day\-to\-day settlement operations, supporting merchant fund flows, and resolving settlement\-related queries and discrepancies. You will work closely with Finance, Operations, Account Management, and payment partners to maintain financial control, ensure settlement transparency, and deliver a high standard of merchant support.
   

  

 Operating within a fast\-paced fintech environment, the role also provides exposure to multi\-currency and digital asset (cryptocurrency) settlement environments, including interaction with modern custody and wallet infrastructure.
   

  

**Job Requirements**
**Education**
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field


**Experience**
* 3–5 years of experience in merchant settlements, payments operations, or financial operations
* Experience in fintech, payments,  or high\-volume transaction environments is preferred
* Exposure to digital asset or  cryptocurrency settlement environments is advantageous


**Technical Skills**
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel
* Experience with accounting or ERP systems (e.g., Xero, Oracle NetSuite, or similar platforms)
* Understanding of payment processing systems, settlement flows, FX applications, and reconciliation practices
* Familiarity with digital asset platforms such as Fireblocks or Utila is an advantage
* Strong proficiency in integrating AI tools into daily workflows to drive efficiency, quality, and innovation


**Competencies**
* Strong attention to detail and financial accuracy
* Analytical mindset with the ability to investigate and resolve discrepancies
* Ability to clearly communicate financial concepts to non\-finance stakeholders
* Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities


**Nice to Have**
* Experience in cryptocurrency or  digital asset settlement operations
* Familiarity with merchant  acquiring and payment gateway ecosystems


**Job Responsibilities**
**Merchant Settlement Execution \& Fund Flow Management**
* Execute daily merchant settlement processes, ensuring timely and accurate fund transfers
* Manage and monitor settlement flows across payment processors, banking partners, and internal systems
* Validate settlement amounts, deductions, and net payouts to ensure accuracy and completeness
* Monitor settlement cycles (e.g., T\+N structures) and ensure adherence to agreed timelines
* Ensure accuracy of fund flows to mitigate financial and operational risk


**Settlement Reconciliation \& Validation**
* Perform reconciliation of  settlement data across processors, internal systems, and reports
* Validate transaction and  settlement data to ensure consistency across multiple data sources
* Identify and investigate  discrepancies related to settlements, fees, and transaction activity
* Support resolution of  reconciliation breaks impacting merchant settlements.


**Account Monitoring \& Financial Controls**
* Act as a key point of contact for Account Management teams on settlement\-related matters
* Respond to and resolve merchant  queries related to:
	+ settlement statements and transaction breakdowns
	+ FX conversions and rate applications
	+ rolling reserves and reserve releases
	+ fees, deductions, and net settlement calculations
	+ balance confirmations and outstanding positions
	+ settlement schedules, payout timelines, and funding cycles (T\+N structures)
* Provide clear, accurate explanations of settlement flows, balances, and financial adjustments
* Support Account Management in maintaining strong merchant relationships through timely and effective query resolution


**Account Monitoring \& Financial Controls**
* Monitor merchant accounts for  irregularities, outstanding balances, and settlement issues
* Maintain and update records of  rolling reserves, settlement positions, and outstanding balances
* Conduct due diligence checks to  validate merchant financial details and safeguard fund flows
* Ensure adherence to internal  financial controls and operational procedures
* Identify and escalate settlement  risks or financial exposure where required


**Reporting \& Data Accuracy**
* Prepare daily and periodic  settlement reports, ensuring completeness and accuracy of financial data
* Maintain structured and auditable  records of settlement activities
* Highlight discrepancies, trends,  or risks impacting settlement accuracy and timelines
* Support accurate and complete reporting of all merchant\-related transactions across multiple platforms, ensuring readiness for financial control review, audit requirements, and  regulatory compliance


**Process Improvement \& Operational Efficiency**
* Identify opportunities to improve settlement workflows, accuracy, and operational efficiency
* Support the implementation of  process enhancements and automation initiatives
* Work with Finance and Operations teams to reduce manual processes and improve scalability
* Contribute to building robust and efficient settlement frameworks as transaction volumes grow


**Cross\-Team Collaboration**
* Collaborate with Finance, Operations, Account Management, and external partners to ensure smooth settlement processes
* Liaise with payment processors, banks, and digital asset platforms to resolve settlement\-related issues
* Support onboarding of new merchants or payment partners by aligning settlement and reporting requirements


**Job Benefits**
* Competitive salary package aligned with experience and market standards.
* Medical Insurance starting from day 1\.
* Access to training resources and development opportunities that support your professional growth.
* Well\-stocked office with snacks, drinks, and refreshments available daily.
* A multinational organisation that promotes a strong, collaborative culture
* Regular team\-building events and company activities that strengthen collaboration across teams.
* Employee Recognition Program celebrating our "Employee of the Month" with special perks.

data.jd_text:
Egis is an international player active in architecture, consulting, construction engineering and mobility services. We create and operate intelligent infrastructures and buildings that respond to the climate emergency and contribute to more balanced, sustainable and resilient territorial development. Operating in 100 countries, Egis puts the expertise of its 19,500 employees at the service of its clients and develops cutting\-edge innovations accessible to all projects. Through its wide range of activities, Egis is a key player in the collective organisation of society and the living environment of citizens all over the world.
   

  





 With 3,500 employees across 8 countries in the Middle East, Egis has delivered over 700 complex development projects, stimulating economic growth and enhancing quality of life. Ranked among the top ten firms in the Middle East by Engineering News Record (ENR), Egis is committed to sustainable development. The Group’s operations in the Middle East are built on strategic acquisitions and a deep understanding of local market conditions. Egis has long history of providing comprehensive engineering, consulting, and project management services makes it a trusted partner for regional governments, investors, and developers.
   

  





  

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 The Director of Facilities Management provides strategic, technical, and operational leadership for the full lifecycle management of the organisation’s built and natural assets. This role oversees the planning, mobilisation, operation, and continuous improvement of all Facilities Management (FM) and Landscape Operations \& Maintenance (O\&M) services across a complex, multi‑site programme, ensuring world‑class service delivery, promoting best\-practice asset management, and acts as a Senior advisor to the Executive Leadership, Government Agencies, and internal and external stakeholders.
   

  





 The Facilities Management Director is responsible to provide the overall Landscape Operations and Maintenance support to RCRC during the lifecycle of all programme components.
   

  

  

  





**1\. Strategic Leadership \& Governance**



* Develop and implement the organisation’s comprehensive FM and Landscape O\&M strategy aligned with long‑term corporate objectives.
* Establish governance frameworks, performance management systems, SLAs, and KPIs for all FM disciplines (hard, soft, infrastructure, and landscape).
* Lead strategic asset management planning, including lifecycle cost modelling, capital replacement strategies, and sustainability\-focused asset performance improvements.
* Represent the FM function at executive committees, senior leadership briefings, and cross‑government steering groups.



  

  





**2\. Lifecycle \& Operational Management**



* Provide expert guidance throughout the full asset lifecycle: design review, mobilisation, operation, maintenance, optimisation, and decommissioning.
* Ensure that all assets and facilities achieve optimal operational availability, resilience, and compliance.
* Direct the mobilisation of FM and O\&M contracts, establish operational readiness programmes, and oversee contractor onboarding and performance.
* Ensure operations integrate seamlessly with the broader urban, environmental, and community context.



  

  





**3\. Procurement, Contracts \& Commercial Oversight**



* Lead the development of procurement strategies, technical documentation, scopes of work, and high‑quality RFPs for all FM and O\&M services.
* Manage the full tendering process including bid evaluation, technical and commercial assessment, negotiation, and contract award.
* Maintain full budgetary and financial control, ensuring cost forecasting, contract variations, cash\-flow analysis, and risk/opportunity tracking are accurate and timely.
* Drive value engineering, cost optimisation, and commercial innovation across the FM portfolio.



  

  





**4\. Performance, Compliance \& Risk Management**



* Ensure all facilities, operations, and contractors comply with regulatory, statutory, environmental, and HSE requirements.
* Oversee the creation of risk registers, emergency preparedness plans, and business continuity strategies.
* Implement quality assurance frameworks to monitor performance and ensure consistent, high‑quality delivery across all service providers.
* Conduct regular reviews of O\&M delivery, identify areas for improvement, and implement corrective measures.



  

  





**5\. Stakeholder \& Client Leadership**



* Serve as the senior point of contact for government entities, municipalities, regulatory bodies, clients, community groups, and internal stakeholders.
* Lead high‑level presentations, executive reporting, workshops, and strategic planning sessions.
* Build strong collaborative relationships with partners, service providers, and cross‑functional teams to ensure organisational alignment.



  

  





**6\. Team Leadership \& Talent Development**



* Lead, mentor, and develop a multi\-disciplinary team of FM, landscape, engineering, and O\&M professionals.
* Cultivate a high‑performance culture emphasising accountability, technical excellence, and continuous improvement.
* Identify capability gaps and drive training, succession planning, and professional development initiatives.
 
**Technical \& Professional Skills**
* Extensive experience (15\+ years) in Facilities \& Asset Management of large, complex, multi\-site environments.
* Deep knowledge of O\&M across hard services, soft services, infrastructure, and large\-scale landscape environments.


**Qualifications**

 Bachelor’s Degree in Facilities Management, bachelor’s degree in urban design, architecture or landscape or Equivalent
   

  

  

  




**Additional Information**

 Years of Experience (min) 15

**Overview**
 The ITS Director for Fare Collection Systems with a minimum of 12 years senior technical and management experience and a university degree, shall be responsible for the overall management, performance, and integration of the fare collection system of the Intelligent Transport Systems (ITS) across the Public Transport Network. This includes AFC (Automatic Fare Collection), CCC (Customer Contact Center) and associated systems and interfaces, including integration with external stakeholders such as the Metro Network. He shall ensure that the interfaces between the ITS Contractors and the other project transport operators are efficient and implemented in sufficient time to allow for the smooth operation of the Bus and metro systems. He shall be responsible for all ITS\-related technical deliverables on behalf of the Employer and shall ensure that no scope or responsibility gaps exist across Contractors or systems. He shall be responsible for system performance, revenue management, Central Clearing House, stakeholder reporting, vendor management and compliance with RCRC/contract obligations. The role ensures that all ITS systems operate efficiently, meet contractual KPIs, and support seamless public transport operations across around 1,000 metro and bus stations.
   

  

**Role And Responsibilities**
* Oversee the performance, reliability of the Fare collection systems including AFC, CCC as well as all integration with AVM and Journey Planning systems.
* Ensure effective interface management between Bus Contractors, ITS Contractors, and external systems and stakeholders such as Metro.
* Monitor system performance and resolve inconsistencies, faults, and integration issues.
* Ensure robust revenue collection and management processes are implemented between the operators and the Client finance department.
* Ensure contractors meet contractual KPIs and performance targets.
* Oversee maintenance, backup, cybersecurity, and data protection practices for all systems.
* Lead vendor and contractor management related to ITS systems.
* Ensure proper implementation of software management best practices and data security requirements.
* Review and approve all technical deliverables submitted by ITS contractors.
* Identify and close any responsibility gaps related to ITS scope.
* Ensure timely implementation of interfaces to support smooth bus operations.
* Lead stakeholder reporting related to ITS performance and compliance.
* Support operational readiness and continuous improvement initiatives.


 Qualification \& Education Requirements
   

  

* Bachelor degree in Engineering, IT, or related field


**Mandatory Experience**
* Minimum 12 years of experience in ITS and transport systems or related fields
* Proven experience in managing large\-scale ITS systems integrations and management of their operations and maintenance
* Experience in contractor and stakeholder management
* Strong understanding of system interfaces, software management, and cybersecurity
* Experience in KPI monitoring and performance management


**Additional Notes**
* Proven ability to lead diverse, multidisciplinary teams and foster a culture of technical excellence.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities
* Ability to manage complex, multi\-contractor environments
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Full\-time on project site in Riyadh

data.jd_text:
TradePay, a Sanabil Studio company, is redefining how B2B commerce operates by enabling suppliers and distributors to offer flexible payment terms to business merchants through a seamless Stock\-Now\-Pay\-Later solution.
   

  

 Backed by Sanabil Studio, TradePay combines technology, financing infrastructure, and operational expertise to help businesses unlock working capital, improve cash flow, and scale more efficiently across industries.
   

  

**THE ROLE** 
 What you'll own here.
   

  

* Lead the development of AI\-enabled products across credit decisioning, fraud and risk monitoring, dynamic limit management, and inventory and cashflow intelligence.
* Translate complex, real\-world data into decision tools that improve accuracy, reduce loss rates, and responsibly expand access to finance.
* Drive a responsible AI approach, including model monitoring, drift detection, explainability, and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows where required.
* Own the architecture and engineering roadmap from pilot through MVP to scale, ensuring systems are secure, scalable, and maintainable.
* Build and operate a modern data and ML platform covering ingestion, feature pipelines, training, serving, experimentation, and monitoring.
* Define AI work streams, milestones, and measurable outcomes; including approval lift, loss reduction, time\-to\-decision, and merchant growth impact.
* Establish technical standards across code quality, CI/CD, observability, reliability, and documentation.
* Make pragmatic build\-versus\-buy decisions across infrastructure, data providers, scoring components, KYC tooling, and payment rails.
* Hire, develop, and lead a high\-performing engineering and data team in Riyadh.
* Build strong security and privacy foundations that can withstand audits and support future licensing requirements.
* Partner closely with Risk, Operations, Finance, Legal/Compliance, and Partnerships teams.


**THE PROFILE** 
 You're probably a fit if…
   

  

* You have proven experience shipping AI/ML\-powered products into production; not just prototypes.
* You bring strong software engineering fundamentals alongside hands\-on experience in machine learning and data platforms.
* You have experience in fintech, lending, BNPL, payments, risk, fraud, or underwriting, and understand the importance of correctness in these environments.
* You have a track record of turning complex datasets into real\-world decision tools with measurable business impact.
* You have hired, mentored, and led teams in fast\-paced, ambiguous environments.
* You take full ownership of outcomes and maintain high standards for reliability, security, and scalable architecture.
* You communicate clearly with engineers, executives, and cross\-functional stakeholders.
* You are based in Riyadh or open to relocation; this is an on\-site leadership role.
* Bonus: Experience with credit bureaus, alternative data, open banking signals, cloud\-native architectures at scale, regulated environments, or GCC fintech products.


**THE ENVIRONMENT** 
 : What working here actually looks like.
   

  

* Builder Role, Real Scope: You won’t be maintaining an existing system; you’ll define the architecture, build the team, and own outcomes from day one.
* AI at the Core: AI is central to how TradePay operates, from underwriting to risk monitoring and merchant intelligence, and you will lead that effort.
* Close to the Top: You will work directly with the CEO and leadership team in Riyadh, with fast feedback loops and real influence on company direction.


**What You Get From Us**
* Competitive pay: A package that reflects your seniority and the market.
* Meaningful equity: Real upside tied to the long\-term value you help create.
* Premium gear, day one: Fully set up and ready before your first day.
* Mentorship that matters: Learn from people who have built and scaled ventures.
* An accelerated curve: You’ll learn more here in 12 months than most roles offer in three years.

data.jd_text:
**Job Summary**
 The Insurance \& RCM Director is responsible for the strategic and operational management of all relationships, contracts, and agreements with medical insurance companies. This role aims to maximize revenue, expand the center’s payer network, and optimize the Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) process. The director will oversee medical approvals, claims, and rejection, while analyzing rejection root causes (medical or technical) to maximize acceptance rates and drive annual revenue growth in alignment with the Center’s financial goals.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Contract Management \& Strategic Partnerships:**
* Policy Review \& Optimization: Regularly review and evaluate current insurance policies to protect the Center’s financial interests and secure optimal reimbursement rates.
* Network Expansion: Identify, negotiate, review and establish new contracts and agreements with medical insurance companies and third\-party administrators (TPAs) not currently in the network.
* Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong, long\-term strategic relationships with key stakeholders at insurance firms to secure competitive pricing and favorable terms.


**Operational Management (Claims \& Approvals)**
* Approvals \& Claims Supervision: Oversee the end\-to\-end workflow of medical approval requests and ensure accurate, timely submission of financial claims to payers.
* Rejection Management: Analyze the root causes of medical and technical rejections and implement corrective action plans to minimize rejection and steadily increase the "Approval Rate."
* Financial Reconciliation: Follow up on collections, settlements, and aging accounts receivable with insurance companies to resolve discrepancies and accelerate cash flow.


**Financial Analysis \& Revenue Growth**
* Revenue \& Profitability Analysis: Analyze the revenue share and financial performance of each insurance provider to identify high\-yield versus low\-performing payers.
* Annual Growth Targets: Develop and execute strategic pricing and negotiation tactics to ensure sustainable annual revenue growth from insurance channels.
* RCM Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Coordinate closely with clinical and ancillary departments (Physicians, Nursing, Pharmacy) to improve medical documentation and data quality, directly accelerating the revenue cycle and eliminating revenue leakage.


**Reporting**
* Periodic Reporting: Prepare and present comprehensive performance reports (weekly/monthly/quarterly) to executive management, highlighting RCM efficiency, rejection/approval metrics, payer\-specific growth, and strategic recommendations.


**Job Requirements \& Qualifications**

**We are an applied AI lab building end\-to\-end software agents.**
 We're the makers of Devin, the first AI software engineer, and Windsurf, the AI\-native IDE. Together, they represent our vision for collaborative AI teammates that enable engineers to focus on more interesting problems and empower teams to strive for more ambitious goals.
   

  

 Our team is small and talent\-dense. Among our founding team, we have world\-class competitive programmers, former founders, and leaders from companies at the cutting edge of AI including Scale AI, Palantir, Cursor, Waymo, Tesla, Lunchclub, Modal, Google DeepMind, and Nuro.
   

  

 Building Devin and Windsurf is just the first step—our hardest challenges still lie ahead. If you’re excited to solve some of the world’s biggest problems and build AI that can reason on real\-world tasks, apply to join us.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As an Account Director, you will be responsible for sourcing, closing and activating enterprise customers, while providing critical product feedback to the Cognition team. You will be a crucial contributor to Cognition’s revenue growth and Devin’s development.
   

  

 You’ll work closely with the whole Cognition team including engineering, product and go\-to\-market to accelerate the sales cycle and help build one of the fastest\-growing AI startups.
   

  

 Successful candidates will have deep experience selling highly technical solutions to businesses, have experience with software engineering and exhibit the drive and grit required to win consistently in a fast\-paced, high\-intensity environment.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Drive revenue for Cognition, owning the entire sales cycle, from prospecting through close and activation for early stage through enterprise companies
* Navigate layered customer organizations including working directly with C\-suite executives, Tech and AI leaders, procurement and legal stakeholders
* Develop strategies for sourcing, demoing the product, and closing opportunities with layered buying organizations
* Deeply understand the customer’s technical pain points and priorities, and qualify the best use cases and teams to deploy Devin to large technology organizations
* Discover new use cases in our customers’ Tech organizations and overshare customer feedback with our product and engineering teams
* Focus on results \- generate pipeline, revenue, and help build the best technical sales organization to bring Devin to market


**Requirements For The Role**
* Demonstrate a track record of success selling deeply technical products to enterprise customers
* You have technical experience \- either as a software engineer, sales engineer or forward deployed engineer. If not, you have an exceptional ability to learn and understand the complex technical problems and requirements our customers are trying to solve using Devin
* Thrive in ambiguous and rapidly changing environments — you’re willing to move fast and quickly grow in scope and responsibility
* You have a demonstrated exceptional ability to learn


**You might excel if you…**
* previously founded a startup
* successfully sourced and closed large, complex enterprise software deals
* were a software engineer or sales engineer, or studied computer science, but moved into go\-to market roles to be closer to the customer
* are a competitive, highly ambitious person who loves working in high\-intensity environments


 Equal Opportunity

**About The Job**
 As an Account Lead within the Fintech Team at HTS, you will be responsible for driving the success of our fintech solutions with airline partners. You will work closely with airlines to launch new products, optimize and grow existing solutions, and develop new opportunities that drive both business growth and enhance the traveler experience.
   

  

 You’ll be at the intersection of strategy, product development, and partnership management, working directly with airline stakeholders to ensure our fintech products align with their business objectives and success metrics. This role requires a combination of strong interpersonal skills, creativity, and analytical ability to navigate complex airline ecosystems and deliver impactful results.
   

  

**What Would Your Day\-to\-day Look Like**
* Build \& Manage Strategic Partnerships: Cultivate and manage relationships with airline partners to understand their needs, challenges, and opportunities in the fintech space.
* Product Development: Lead the development and launch of new fintech products for airlines. This includes driving product vision, collaborating with internal teams, and ensuring alignment with airline partners’ goals and success metrics.
* Optimize Existing Solutions: Work with airlines to improve and grow existing fintech products, ensuring they meet evolving business needs and maximize ancillary revenue opportunities.
* Product Implementations: Lead product implementations and delivery for diverse accounts, including project and stakeholder management, maintaining documentation, executing user acceptance testing and issue triaging.
* Data\-Driven Insights: Leverage analytical tools and data to monitor product performance, assess customer feedback, and make data\-backed decisions to optimize product offerings.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with internal teams (engineering, design, marketing, and customer success) to deliver seamless product experiences.
* Market Intelligence: Stay up\-to\-date with trends in the fintech and travel industries to anticipate market shifts and identify new opportunities for innovation.


**An ideal candidate has**
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills to engage with stakeholders at all levels. Someone who can build trust with partners and internal teams through clarity, consistency, and professionalism.
* Ability in vibe coding/ prototyping products/ features or workflows with AI tooling like LLM (Claude, Gemini, Chatgpt, etc)
* Proven ability to manage and grow strategic partnerships.
* Excellent analytical skills with experience in data\-driven decision\-making.
* Creativity and strategic thinking to identify new opportunities in the fintech and travel spaces.
* Strong project management and organizational skills.
* Familiarity with airline operations, challenges, and revenue streams, or previous experience working within the airline industry is a strong plus.
* Native Arabic speaker with fluency in English. The ability to communicate effectively with ME and NA partners and stakeholders is crucial.


**Perks And Benefits Of Working With Us**
* Well\-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and upsides of pre\-IPO equity packages.
* Hopper covers 100% of premiums for EOR offered supplemental medical insurance, via Tawuniya
* Insurance Company. Is available to extend to your family and dependents.
* Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards!.
* Access to co\-working space on demand through FlexDesk AND Work\-from\-home stipend.
* Housing \& Transportation Benefit monthly allowance.
* Carrot Cash travel stipend.
* Unlimited PTO.
* Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business.
* Open communication with management and company leadership.
* Small, dynamic teams \= massive impact.


**More about Hopper**
 At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world\-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips.
   

  

 The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. he Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.
   

  

 While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands.
   

  

 Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end\-to\-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.
   

  

**Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company’s recent growth:**
 Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year.
   

  

 Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no\-questions\-asked resolutions.
   

  

 Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1\.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel.
   

  

 Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business.
   

  

 Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co\-develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more.
   

  

 Hopper has been named the \#1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the \#3 largest online travel agencies in North America and 70% of our app customers are Gen\-Z and millennials travelers.
   

  

 Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen Z and Millennials.

data.jd_text:
Sanabil Studio is a venture builder that blends industry expertise, technology, and startup know\-how to turn bold ideas into real businesses. We take concepts from zero to launch, and when a venture proves its potential, we back it with seed funding and hands\-on support to help it scale.
   

  

 TradePay is one of those ventures building the trade finance infrastructure for FMCG in Saudi Arabia. Our mission is to replace informal supplier credit with structured, data\-driven working capital that helps small merchants grow, protects suppliers from credit risk, and strengthens the FMCG supply chain. We are building a new credit system for underbanked merchants where risk is priced from real transaction behavior, not balance sheets. Our model leverages supplier, distributor, and marketplace data to power embedded B2B BNPL experiences across FMCG ecosystems. This is not traditional lending this is supply\-chain\-native decisioning built from real commerce data.
   

  

 We are looking for a Head of Operations to build and lead TradePay's operational backbone from the ground up reporting directly to the CEO.
   

  

**THE ROLE What you'll own here** 
 .
   

  

* Design and build TradePay's end\-to\-end collections infrastructure and execution workflows
* Manage repayment reminder strategies across SMS, WhatsApp, calls, and automated payment systems
* Own outbound collections activities, promise\-to\-pay tracking, escalation workflows, and legal recovery coordination
* Manage third\-party collections partners and build collections dashboards and reporting
* Oversee merchant onboarding operations including KYB/KYC document collection, account activation, and merchant operational records
* Build and manage the merchant support function covering repayment inquiries, operational issues, complaints, and escalations
* Design and manage dispute workflows, coordinating with suppliers and merchants to resolve issues and maintain audit trails
* Oversee merchant repayment processing, payment reconciliation, settlement coordination, and payment exception resolution
* Manage operational relationships with FMCG suppliers, distributors, force automation providers, marketplaces, payment providers, collection agencies, and KYB/KYC providers
* Produce daily collections reports, DPD and aging reports, and operational KPI dashboards
* Build scalable operational processes, SOPs, and controls, and automate manual workflows in partnership with Product and Engineering


 How Success Will Be Measured Scalable collections infrastructure fully operational, automated reminder and collections engine implemented, merchant support function operating to defined SLAs, real\-time operational reporting and dashboards live, reconciliation and settlement processes fully controlled, dispute management framework operational, and operational readiness achieved for national scale.
   

  

 Where This Role Can Go Head of Operations → Chief Operations Officer as TradePay scales its operational infrastructure across the region.
   

  

**THE PROFILE You're probably a fit if…**
 You have 8\+ years of experience in fintech, lending, BNPL, payments, collections, customer operations, or financial services operations
   

  

**You Have Proven Experience Building Operational Functions From Scratch**
 You bring strong collections and customer servicing experience
   

  

 You have experience managing operational teams and third\-party vendors
   

  

 You have strong analytical and reporting capabilities
   

  

**You Have Startup Or High\-growth Company Experience**
 You have Saudi Arabia or GCC experience
   

  

**THE ENVIRONMENT What Working Here Actually Looks Like.**
 1\- Operational Engine Ownership You own the infrastructure that keeps TradePay running. Every merchant onboarding, every collections workflow, every settlement and reconciliation process runs through what you build.
   

  

 2\- Direct Impact on the Business Collections performance, merchant satisfaction, and operational scalability all trace back to your systems. What you build moves the business forward directly.
   

  

 3\- A Role That Grows With You This position has a clear path into Chief Operations Officer as TradePay scales its operational infrastructure across the region.
   

  

 What You Get From Us

data.jd_text:
**The role**
 SiFi is building the business wallet Saudi companies actually want to use. The Platform squad owns the core of that promise: how companies control spend, capture receipts, enforce policy, and understand where their money goes. It's also the most complex surface on the platform, and your job is to make it feel simple.
   

  

 This is a product team, not a feature factory. You'll be handed problems and outcomes, not a roadmap to execute. If you need a spec to feel safe, this isn't the seat.
   

  

 We're not hiring for domain expertise. We're hiring for an instinct: to sit with a confused finance lead, find the real pain under what they say, and turn that mess into a product decision that's obviously right.
   

  

**What You'll Own**
 You'll work directly with finance leaders and business owners to surface the problems that slow them down: expense processes that take too long, policies that are hard to enforce, receipts that go missing, spend that's impossible to reconcile at month\-end.
   

  

 This role covers the full product lifecycle. You'll take new ideas from zero to one, defining the problem, validating with real users, and shipping something that works before anyone else knows it's needed. You'll scale what's already live, removing friction, improving reliability, and driving adoption across the customer base. And you'll work closely with marketing on go\-to\-market, making sure new features actually land, get used, and stick.
   

  

 Data is how you stay honest. You'll obsess over usage numbers, drop\-off points, and adoption curves, and you won't let a hypothesis live long without testing it. You act on what the data says, not what feels right.
   

  

 Your job is to understand user pain deeply, then turn it into product decisions that make the platform dramatically simpler to use.
   

  

**How We Work**
 Small squads, real ownership, weekly customer contact, high taste bar. We move fast and we say no to most things so we can do a few things at a world\-class level.
   

  

**Requirements**
**What we're looking for**
* 2\+ years shipping B2B SaaS products people use daily. You've owned a real surface, not assisted on one.
* You have a genuine pull toward customers. You talk to users every week because you want to, not because a process tells you to. You hear what people don't say, and you keep asking "why" until the real problem surfaces.
* You have a simplification instinct. Show us a flow you made dramatically simpler, and explain what you removed and why it mattered.
* You're fluent in data. You build your own dashboards, spot patterns before anyone flags them, and act on what you find. Data is your default lens, not a secondary check.
* You turn messy, contradictory customer input clear decisions, and you bring decisions to the table, not options. You write clearly, and you're decisive under ambiguity.


**Nice to have**
* Saudi or MENA market experience, and Arabic. You've felt finance\-ops pain firsthand, or are fast at building context. You've worked somewhere that treated design as a core competency, not decoration.

 Visa’s strategy on capturing a share of new flows focuses on Government payments as a key pillar. Government payments often contribute between 30\-40 percent of total market payments and governments everywhere are investing heavily to modernize and digitize their infrastructure. As the new VGS team, we will be leading the company efforts in developing our strategy, leverage expertise in various groups around the company and develop comprehensive government solutions. We are also prioritizing markets for focus and enablement of specialized sales teams.

* Support the development of Government technology needs or partnership integration requirements into Visa Technology requirements for prioritization, scoping and build
* Support developing joined up solutions that leverage Visa digital technologies including VisaNet, CyberSource, Visa Secure, Tokenisation, Click to Pay, Visa Risk Manager, Visa Developer Consumer Control APIs etc.
* Support thought leadership on Government payment processing options that blend Visa and partner capabilities with broad government agendas and national payments infrastructure.
* Demonstrate in\-depth knowledge of Visa’s capabilities to complement your understanding of national payments infrastructure and trends in payments generally plus the ability to think holistically about the design of a new offering and the implications related to both the customer’s experience as well as the organization’s ability to implement and scale
* Work closely with business partners including Risk, Client Services, Legal, Privacy, Government Engagement on the introduction of new solutions.

 High degree of competence in RESTful APIs, various architecture patterns, API and SDK integration, mobile/web application development, RTP payment architecture and Open Banking exposure
   

  

 Design thinking product development methodology experience
   

  

 Experience in business development or partnership development in payments industry is a plus.
   

  

 Strong client and executive\-facing communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence multiple stakeholders across a matrixed environment
   

  

 Proven ability to work on complex and often ambiguous problems, to drive results.
   

  

 Must have a mindset that embraces creativity, optimism, ambiguity and learning quickly.
   

  

 Product person at heart
   

  

 Fluency in Arabic language is a must for this position
   

  

**Visa is an EEO Employer**
 Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

 What working here actually looks like.

 You’ll report directly to the Founder and CEO, with short feedback loops and real influence on company direction from day one.

 TradePay operates in the real economy \- FMCG supply chains, merchant credit, and supplier settlements. The problems are challenging, the impact is tangible, and the platform is yours to shape.

 We’re building with operational discipline and a long\-term view. You’ll set the product foundation that takes TradePay from where it is today to genuine scale.

* Competitive pay: A package that reflects your seniority and the market.
