**About QNB**
 Established in 1964 as the country’s first Qatari\-owned commercial bank, QNB Group has steadily grown to become the largest bank in the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region.
   

  

 QNB Group’s presence through its subsidiaries and associate companies extends to more than 31 countries across three continents providing a comprehensive range of advanced products and services. The total number of employees is more than 28,000 serving up to 20 million customers operating through 1,000 locations, with an ATM network of 4,300 machines.
   

  

 QNB has maintained its position as one of the highest rated regional banks from leading credit rating agencies including Standard \& Poor’s (A), Moody’s (Aa3\) and Fitch (A\+). The Bank has also been the recipient of many awards from leading international specialised financial publications.
   

  

 Based on the Group’s consistent strong financial performance and its expanding international presence, QNB currently ranks as the most valuable bank brand in the Middle East and Africa, according to Brand Finance Magazine.
   

  

 QNB Group has an active community support program and sponsors various social, educational and sporting events.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The incumbent will execute the marketing process of all Treasury products to corporate clients. The incumbent will supervise the process of generating profitable Corporate Treasury Product sales and in creating potential for the Group as a whole to leverage additional benefit from these sales.
   

  

 Main Responsibilities
   

  

* Shareholder \& Financial:
* Implements the Group’s strategies to position QNB Country in the corporate Treasury segment.
* Ensures the achievement of set targets/ objectives, business growth and expansion for the Corporate Sales Unit.
* Implements and evaluates best practice work methods in area of responsibility to achieve optimum level of performance efficiency.
* Act within the limits of the powers delegated to the incumbent and delegate authority to the respective staff and monitor exercise of the same.
* Implements KPI’s and best practices for role
* Promote cost consciousness and efficiency and enhance productivity, to minimise cost, avoid waste, and optimise benefits for the bank.
* Demonstrate clear understanding of the important factors behind the bank's financial \& non\-financial performance.
* Customer (Internal \& External):
* To assist customers in all their queries on Bank’s product and seek solution to their requests
* Maintain activities in accordance with Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with internal departments/ units to achieve improvements in turn\-around time.
* Build and maintain strong and effective relationship with all other related departments and units to achieve the Group’s goals/objectives.
* Provide timely and accurate information to the external and internal Auditors, Compliance, Financial Control and Risk Functions as and when required.
* Maintains relationships with key Corporate clients to maximise their retention as profitable customers of the Bank.
* Internal (Processes, Products, Regulatory):
* Ensures compliance to the department’s policies and procedures for conducting sales calls and visits, preparing presentation on products internally and externally, maintaining the contact database and maintaining/ collating MIS pertaining to profitability/ revenue.
* Develops new Corporate relationships, within the delegated authority, allocates responsibility for these within the Corporate team and subsequently act as focal point for guidance and assistance in resolution of any contentious issues arising in the course of managing Corporate relationships.
* Liaise with the Group Treasury to identify potential customers and to cross sell treasury services in addition to providing requisite training to Corporate Banking staff on the treasury products and services that are provided by the Group.
* Maintains the database for corporate treasury customers, ensuring its timely update after contact with potential and current QNB customers.
* Networks with Corporate customers and marketing groups within and outside QNB in order to solicit customer feedback, gain market intelligence, benchmark selling techniques and enhance the Group’s profile in the market.
* Is involved in the Corporate product development process, in coordination with Group Treasury
* Monitors and enhances the Corporate product development process, provide timely update to the Country GM and Group Treasury on customer needs and new market opportunities.
* Sets meetings and visits with Corporate customers to present/ conduct meetings and visits.
* Ensures that Corporate treasury sales team members have a constructive personal working relationship through regular planned calling, visits, entertainment etc…. with the objective that the customer is responsive to our calls and considers the Group a strategic partner when in need of Corporate treasury products and services.
* Stay abreast of market and product developments in the area and update colleagues.
* Maintains a well motivated, well trained, focused team with a reputation for the highest standards of professionalism and ethical behaviour to ensure a good name in the market.


**Learning \& Knowledge**
* Proactively identify areas for professional development of self and undertake development activities.
* Seek out opportunities to remain current with all developments in professional field.
* Hold meetings with staff and assess their performance and your teams overall performance on a regular basis.
* Take decisive action to ensure speedy resolution of unresolved grievances or conflicts within the team members.
* Identify development opportunities and activities for staff and facilitate/coach them to improve their effectives and prepare them to assume greater responsibilities.


**Legal, Regulatory, And Risk Framework Responsibilities**
* Comply with all applicable legal, regulatory and internal compliance requirements including, but not limited to, Group Compliance Policies and Procedures (AML \& CTF, Anti\-Bribery and Corruption, Sanctions Policy, Data Protection Policy, Fraud Control Policy, Whistle Blowing Policy, Conflict of Interest and Insider Dealing Policy).
* Understand and effectively perform your role under the Three Lines of Defence principle to identify measure, monitor, manage and report risks.
* Ensure systematic good outcomes for clients in accordance with Conduct Risk policy.
* Support the framework of RCSA, KRI, Incident reporting and remediation, as appropriate, in accordance with the Operational Risk Management requirements.
* Maintain appropriate knowledge to ensure full qualification to undertake the role.
* Complete all mandatory training provided by the Bank, attain, and maintain the required levels of competence.
* Attend mandatory (internal and external) seminars as instructed by the Bank.


**Other**
* Ensure high standards of data protection and confidentiality to safeguard commercially sensitive information.
* Maintaining utmost confidentiality concerning customer and internal bank information obtained during the course of business and provide such information on a need to know basis only to Senior Management of QNB, Audit and Compliance functions, and relevant Regulators.
* Maintain high professional standards to uphold QNB's reputation and to strengthen its market leadership position.
* All other ad hoc duties/activities related to QNB that management might request from time to time.


**Education And Experience Requirements**
* Bachelors Degree in Business, Finance, Marketing, Mathematics, or Economics (Related field of study).
* MBA, CFA, or a related professional certification is a plus
* 12 years banking experience with at least 4 years or more Treasury Sales experience


**Required Special Skills**
* Excellent oral and written communication skills in English
* Exceptional presentation skills.
* Good MS Office skills (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
* Good knowledge of a wide range of treasury products.
* Analytical and problem solving skills coupled with decision making ability.
* A strong customer service orientation with exceptional knowledge of Customer Relationship Management (CRM).
* Must be able to work effectively under market pressures whilst maintaining risk control and limit compliance.
* Proven marketing and sales skills.
* Understanding of the relevant laws, regulations and practices.
* Good interpersonal skills.
* Ability to motivate and lead teams from diverse cultural backgrounds.
* Undoubted ethical awareness and conscious of risks being undertaken.
* Profit and results driven.

* Resume/CV
* Copy of your Passport
* Copy of Education Certificate

**The opportunity**
 As part of EY’s Financial Services Risk \& Finance practice, you will help leading banks, capital markets firms, insurers, non\-banking financial institutions and public\-sector financial services entities strengthen resilience, meet regulatory expectations and unlock value through risk and finance transformation. Our work spans regulatory compliance and prudential supervision, credit and capital (incl. capital adequacy and liquidity), market risk, operational risk, enterprise risk, structured finance and quantitative advisory.
   

  

 At EY, you’ll join a collaborative, inclusive and high\-performing team where your development is intentional and continuous. With a structured career framework and a global network, you’ll gain exposure to leading practices, complex engagements and diverse perspectives across industries and geographies. Saudi Arabia is a strategic priority market for EY, offering exceptional growth and the opportunity to shape outcomes for some of the region’s most important financial institutions and national champions.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 As a Financial Services Risk Senior Manager, you will lead and deliver complex FS Risk engagements and provide technical direction across workstreams. You will operate as a trusted team leader—owning day\-to\-day delivery, coaching team members, managing stakeholders and proactively updating engagement Directors and Partners on progress, risks and dependencies. You will build strong relationships with clients and internal peers, contribute to compelling presentations and support business development through proposals and pursuit materials.
   

  

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Leading and delivering financial risk and risk transformation programs, domestically and/or internationally
* Ability to analyse current\-state reporting and the underlying complexity (requirements, data, reporting solutions and operating model)
* Experience across finance and data/reporting initiatives; strong IT and financial accounting knowledge to bridge business and technology
* Ability to profile and interpret data constructs and translate them into meaningful business constructs
* Self\-motivated, with strong energy, drive and accountability
* Proven ability to lead teams and projects, communicate and influence senior stakeholders, resolve issues and deliver under pressure
* Learning agility—able to ramp up quickly, explore new ideas and identify opportunities

* 10\+ years of strong Financial Services Risk experience within leading FS organisations and/or top\-tier consultancy firms
* Prior experience working (as an employee or a consultant) with government\-owned financial institutions—particularly development funds and sovereign wealth funds (SWFs)
* Experience in as many of the following areas: quantitative analytics, treasury and treasury operations, investments, market risk, performance measurement, ALM/FTP, fixed income, derivatives and hedging, credit risk modelling and ECL, liquidity analysis, financial planning and forecasting, capital and RWA management/optimisation, risk appetite, credit lifecycle and operating model, loan pricing and analytics, etc.
* Experience in economic capital modelling, economic analysis, data analytics, design and implementation of ERM solutions, and deployment / integration of risk analytics into business processes, etc.
* Prior experience in credit risk, market risk, liquidity risk and/or operational risk
* Ideally, the previous experience in developed markets (e.g., EU, US, Canada, Australia, Hong Kong, Singapore, etc.) and some presence in, or connection to, MENA is preferred
* Strong educational background from a top institution in a quantitative discipline (finance, economics, actuarial science or related)

**About QNB**
 Established in 1964 as the country’s first Qatari\-owned commercial bank, QNB Group has steadily grown to become the largest bank in the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region.
   

  

 QNB Group’s presence through its subsidiaries and associate companies extends to more than 31 countries across three continents providing a comprehensive range of advanced products and services. The total number of employees is more than 28,000 serving up to 20 million customers operating through 1,000 locations, with an ATM network of 4,300 machines.
   

  

 QNB has maintained its position as one of the highest rated regional banks from leading credit rating agencies including Standard \& Poor’s (A), Moody’s (Aa3\) and Fitch (A\+). The Bank has also been the recipient of many awards from leading international specialised financial publications.
   

  

 Based on the Group’s consistent strong financial performance and its expanding international presence, QNB currently ranks as the most valuable bank brand in the Middle East and Africa, according to Brand Finance Magazine.
   

  

 QNB Group has an active community support program and sponsors various social, educational and sporting events.
   

  

**Job Purpose Summary**
 The overall role for the position is to assist the SVP/ VP Innovation to drive cultural change around one dedicated strategic innovation themes. The incumbent will manage and monitor all innovation initiatives within his/ her scope in order to ensure that they are implemented and completed within the defined time, budget and requirements with the support of the originally allocated resources. The incumbent will also be responsible for developing, driving and rolling out appropriate tracking metrics for regular reporting to core stakeholders at a project, initiative and program level. He/ she is also responsible for actively maintaining and updating the established ecosystem.
   

  

**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities By Dimensions**
* Shareholder \& Financial:
* Establish and maintain strong working relationships across all business and support units as well as countries across QNB Group
* Assist SVP/ VP in identifying, exploring and validating one or several Strategic themes: AI/ ML, API/ Open banking, Platforms and marketplaces, Robotics and automation
* Own post\-mortems on completed innovation initiatives to ensure that they delivered the forecasted value creation to the Group
* Assist other departments in identifying, analyzing and monitoring external innovation trends
* Manage the roll out of appropriate innovation tracking metrics for regular reporting to core stakeholders at a project, initiative and program level
* Supervise the update of established performance metrics
* Implements KPI’s and best practices for Assistant Vice President Innovation role.
* Promote cost consciousness and efficiency and enhance productivity, to minimise cost, avoid waste, and optimise benefits for the bank.
* Act within the limits of the powers delegated to the incumbent.
* Customer (Internal \& External):
* Support the SVP/ VP Innovation to successfully run the innovation agenda
* Foster and empower employees to create a bottom\-up innovation culture in which participants share ideas to improve existing products/ services
* Act as a partner to the concerned business and support divisions and lead process improvement projects together with representatives from one or more business and support divisions
* Manage activities centered around instilling the innovation culture at QNB, such as innovation days, hackathons, innovation lab, etc.
* Supervise in the preparation of regular updates to the Executive Management on global innovative trends, status of current QNB innovation initiatives and impact of completed innovation projects
* Act as a coach and support for SMEs in the evaluation stage \- Act as a content owner for the Innovation Learning and Development resources accessible to the QNB employee base
* Internal (Processes, Products, Regulatory):
* Obtain mandate, inputs and overall direction from EVP/ SVP/ VP Innovation on specific initiatives
* Supervise the development and preparation of all policies/ processes and procedures as well as standards
* Coordinate the innovation execution by managing the portfolio of group\-wide innovation initiatives and conducting the post\-mortem on completed initiatives
* Be involved and engaged in individual projects on a day\-to\-day basis to provide assistance to the project teams
* Demonstrate advanced project management skills and implement industry best practices and standards of project portfolio management
* Demonstrate deep understanding of Lean and Process Management to ensure alignment with the work undertaken across the wider Innovation Department
* Learning \& Knowledge:
* Identify related areas for professional self\-development
* Possess strong project management fundamentals as well as project portfolio management methodology/ techniques and tools
* Maintain basic knowledge about banking processes, regulations, and generally accepted operating practices.
* Research industry topics and react by recommending changes to products, services, and systems
* Carry out other similar duties that can be defined within the broad functional job and functional responsibilities outlined above
* Proactively identify areas for professional development of self and undertake development activities.
* Seek out opportunities to remain current with all developments in professional field.


**Education \& Experience Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree from Top tier university degree or equivalent
* Minimum of 10 years work experience in a change management and senior advisory function within the financial services arena
* Proven track record within the field of innovation preferably from global financial services institution
* Track record as a change leader, motivator, driver for cultural change throughout a large and complex organization
* Substantial management experience and proven track record in driving senior management agenda
* Demonstrated career development, progress, and experience in establishing new functions
* High level knowledge of all major banking related business and support functions


 Note: you will be required to attach the following:
   

  

* Resume/CV

data.jd_text:
Akura Medical, a Shifamed portfolio company, is advancing a differentiated platform for the treatment of venous thromboembolism (VTE), which affects up to 900,000 Americans each year. The company recently received US IDE approval for its QUADRA\-PE study evaluating the Katana™ Thrombectomy System in acute pulmonary embolism patients. In parallel, Akura Medical is developing NavIQ™, a software platform that transforms CT angiograms into 3D pulmonary vascular models to enhance visualization, procedural planning, and clot assessment towards better safety, efficacy, and ease of use. Akura has recently completed a $53 million first close of its Series C financing, led by the Qatar Investment Authority, supporting the launch of a joint venture and a new R\&D and manufacturing center in Doha, Qatar.
 



  





**About Shifamed** 




 Founded in 2009 by serial entrepreneur Amr Salahieh, Shifamed LLC is a privately held medical device innovation hub focused on the development of novel medical products to address clinical needs in the rapidly evolving fields of cardiology and ophthalmology.
 



  





 Description:
 



 This position is responsible for the development, implementation, and management of quality systems and practices. This position will oversee and ensure that the development, manufacture, testing and release of products are performed according to the applicable federal and state regulations, international standards, and the Company’s Quality Policy.
 



  





 Responsibilities, Skills \& Hands\-On Experience:
 


* Ensure compliance with applicable Quality System Regulations and standards, including FDA QSR, ISO 13485, MDR, GMP, and Design Controls.
* Partner with R\&D and Operations to establish and maintain quality requirements throughout product development, transfer, manufacturing, and post\-market activities.
* Lead and maintain Design History Files (DHF), Risk Management Files, and associated quality documentation for products and processes.
* Develop and implement quality engineering activities including design verification/validation, process validation, equipment qualification, test method validation, and first article inspections.
* Support manufacturing quality activities including inspection processes, nonconformance investigations, CAPA, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Develop, maintain, and oversee manufacturing and quality documentation including procedures, inspection instructions, Lot History Records, and Bills of Materials.
* Manage supplier quality activities including supplier qualification, audits, source inspections, supplier controls, and ongoing quality performance monitoring.
* Prepare for, host, and support internal, customer, supplier, and regulatory audits and inspections.
* Coordinate quality system training and promote company\-wide quality system awareness and compliance.
* Support complaint handling, MDR/vigilance reporting, field actions, and investigation of product or process failures.
* Serve as Quality representative on cross\-functional project teams and act as site Management Representative and/or Quality signature authority as required.
* Lead and manage Quality Assurance resources to ensure effective execution of quality system and regulatory compliance activities.
* Other duties as assigned.



  





 Education \& Work Experience:
 


* Bachelors or Masters in Engineering or scientific discipline, or equivalent relevant work experience
* 15\+ years of Quality or Technical Management experience in the medical device industry or a related field.
* Previous direct people management experience.
* Previous experience bringing a company into regulatory compliance and approval, preferred.
* Solid knowledge of FDA regulations and interpretation of FDA regulations, guidelines, and policy statements.
* Solid knowledge of international regulations, standards, and guidelines (i.e. MDR, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, IEC 60601 and collateral standards, IEC 62304, IEC 62366, FDA guidance documents for cybersecurity).
* Ability to train others in processes and procedures.
* Excellent communications skills (both written and verbal) required.
* Ability to work effectively across functional lines to reach effective outcomes for the business.
* Ability to travel as required.



  





 Our salary ranges are calculated by role, level, and location. Please note that your position within that range will be determined by your job\-related knowledge, location, skills, experience, relevant education, and training/certifications.
 



  





 NOTICE TO CANDIDATES: Please be aware that Shifamed and its portfolio companies do not conduct interviews or extend offers through mobile web chat applications. Please report any such occurrences to hr@shifamed.com.

data.jd_text:
The Funding and Capital Structure Director is a strategic leadership role responsible for managing the Group’s capital structure and executing complex funding and treasury initiatives. The role ensures optimal balance between debt and equity, drives cost\-efficient financing solutions, and oversees capital transactions across projects, acquisitions, and corporate initiatives.
 



 The position requires strong leadership, deep expertise in structured finance, and the ability to manage high\-value funding transactions in collaboration with internal stakeholders and external financial institutions.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Capital Structure \& Strategy** 



* Lead the development and execution of the Group’s capital structure strategy, ensuring an optimal balance between debt and equity.
* Contribute to initiatives aimed at reducing cost of capital and strengthening financial stability.
* Assess and recommend strategic financing options for Group investments, projects, and acquisitions.



**Funding \& Transactions** 



* Lead end\-to\-end funding processes including debt and equity financing transactions.
* Prepare and review key financing documents such as teasers, term sheets, and financial models.
* Oversee execution of debt issuances, refinancing, restructuring, and equity raising activities.
* Ensure timely completion of all conditions precedent (CPs) and closing requirements for financing deals.



**Debt Portfolio Management** 



* Manage and optimize the Group’s debt portfolio, including refinancing, reprofiling, and restructuring opportunities.
* Identify efficiencies to improve funding terms and overall cost of debt.



**Treasury Projects \& Execution** 



* Lead treasury\-related capital projects ensuring delivery within timelines and budget.
* Coordinate cross\-functional teams to track progress, resolve bottlenecks, and ensure successful execution of funding initiatives.



**Financial Analysis \& Risk** 



* Develop advanced financial models to evaluate funding structures and scenarios.
* Conduct risk assessments for financing options and capital allocation decisions.



**Leadership \& Stakeholder Management** 



* Lead and develop a high\-performing team responsible for capital transactions and treasury execution.
* Engage with banks, investors, and advisors to secure optimal financing arrangements.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders across finance, legal, strategy, and project teams.



  





**Job Knowledge \& Skills** 



* Strong expertise in debt and equity financing structures.
* Proven experience in debt restructuring, reprofiling, and capital optimization.
* Advanced financial modelling and valuation capabilities.
* Strong understanding of transaction execution and closing processes.
* Proficiency in financial systems and tools (SAP preferred).
* Strong risk management and cost optimization capabilities.
* AI and digital finance fluency is an advantage.



  





**Experience Requirements** 




  




* Minimum
 **20 years of professional experience** 
 in finance or treasury functions.
* At least
 **15 years in leadership or senior management roles** 
 .
* Minimum
 **5 years GCC experience preferred** 
 .



  





**Education** 




  




* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or related field.
* Professional certification preferred (e.g., ACCA or equivalent).



  





**Core Competencies** 




  




* Leadership \& team development
* Financial control \& risk management
* Strategic thinking \& agility
* Cost optimization
* Process and systems improvement
* Execution speed \& delivery focus
* Business valuation expertise
* Resilience under pressure

**Graduate Trainee Programme \- Qatar Nationals Only
   

  

 Location: Doha, Qatar**
**About HSBC**
 HSBC is one of the world’s leading banks, with a network covering 67 countries and territories. Our global reach means we offer many ways for you to develop your career. We offer an inclusive, values\-led culture, tailored learning and development programmes and competitive benefits. We have roles in retail, commercial, investment and private banking and a range of operational and functional teams.
   

  

**OUR STRUCTURE**
 Our network covers both established and emerging markets across Europe, Asia\-Pacific, Middle East and North Africa, North America and Latin America. Within these markets, we serve our customers through our global businesses: Commercial Banking, Global Banking and Markets, Global Private Banking, and Retails Banking and Wealth Management.
   

  

**The Graduate Programme** 
 is a two year rotational programme offering ‘on the job’ training experience in a fast paced dynamic environment for new and recent graduates.
   

  

 The programme focuses on providing participants with professional development opportunities and real time tailored personal growth opportunities.
   

  

 HSBC Graduate Programmes Are All Underpinned By The Same Desire; To Maximise Your Chances Of Becoming a Highly Effective Leader In a Market\-leading Global Organisation. To Help Realise This Goal, Our Graduate Scheme Provides a Range Of Leadership Development That Run Parallel To The Business\-specific Training You’ll Receive. We’re Very Confident You’ll Be Fully Supported Along The Way, And Here’s Why
   

  

**Mentoring Scheme:** 
 You’ll be assigned a senior mentor within the business. They’ll have real insight into how best to manage your career, and they’ll be available for advice and guidance at the times you need them most.
   

  

**Communication, Influencing and Business Partnering:** 
 This programme provides you the ability to work effectively across the organisation and will be critical to your future success. This programme will challenge your thinking and really develop your interpersonal style and skills.
   

  

**Teamwork:** 
 Maximising team performance is a skill we’ll be keen to help you develop. Short courses and individual coaching will seek to help you develop your understanding of team dynamics and your impact on others.
   

  

**Job Rotations:** 
 Four six\-month placements will provide you with specialist knowledge of our operations with the below business areas.
   

  

 HSBC graduate careers provide specialist development in specific areas of the Bank’s Qatar operations, and whichever route you take, you’ll be sure to get your career off to a great start. We will work with you to understand your areas of interest and your aspirations and offer placement opportunities available.

Our understanding of long\-term economic trends and insight into opportunities on an international level enables us to develop product and services for governments, corporates and institutions.

We offer career opportunities ranging from customer service and relationship management jobs in branches to roles in product development, sales, strategy, asset management and insurance. Generalist, specialist and managerial roles are available at all levels.

We use our expertise and technology to improve the bank’s customer service and efficiency. HSBC Operations, Services and Technology (HOST) has responsibilities that include: Running customer service operations and business processes from contact centres to payments processing\| Developing software and applications that underpin HSBC’s banking systems, Managing IT systems, infrastructure and support, Implementing major strategic change programmes, Procuring goods and services for the Group, Managing HSBC’s global corporate real estate portfolio.
* Global Functions HSBC’s Global Functions (GF) play a vital role in supporting the bank’s Global Businesses and offer a broad range of career opportunities in areas from legal, risk and finance to human resources, sustainability, marketing and communications. Our operational and functional teams around the world help HSBC’s Global Businesses to operate efficiently and effectively on a day\-to\-day basis. They also focus on controls and governance to reduce risk and protect the Group’s reputation.

* Knowledge of international business and various industry sectors
* Exposure to and appreciation of working in a global environment
* Strong ‘team’ skills promoting an environment of co\-operation and trust, overcoming resistance where encountered
* Possess analytical and financial skills
* Good prioritizing, organizational and time management abilities
* Ability to make decisions
* Good verbal and written communications skills


**WHY HSBC?**
 We put diversity at the heart of our business and we take our responsibility to develop our talent seriously.
   

  

 Joining HSBC will give you the chance to work in a collegiate, supportive and inclusive environment in which we seek to develop and promote people based on merit. We will provide you with tailored training and support to help you identify and follow your chosen career path, as well as access to a range of market\-competitive benefits.

**Role Summary** 




 The Section Head – Data Governance Unit is responsible for leading and scaling the Bank’s enterprise data governance framework to ensure data quality, regulatory compliance, and effective data management practices across all business units.

* Ensure alignment with Qatar Central Bank (QCB) regulations and other applicable regulatory requirements
* Define and monitor data quality KPIs to improve data accuracy, integrity, and consistency
* Partner with business and IT stakeholders to ensure robust data lineage, metadata management, and data cataloging practices
* Identify and mitigate data\-related risks and ensure appropriate governance controls are in place
* Lead the Data Governance Council and drive accountability for data ownership and stewardship across business units
* Oversee the implementation, adoption, and optimization of data governance tools and platforms
* Align data governance initiatives with the Bank’s digital transformation and AI strategy
* Ensure governance of master data to maintain a single, trusted source of truth

* Lead organization\-wide data literacy and awareness initiatives
* Act as the primary point of contact for internal and external audits related to data governance

* Strong understanding of data governance frameworks, regulatory requirements, and data risk management
* Proven experience in driving enterprise\-wide governance initiatives and operating model transformations
* Solid understanding of data architecture, data lineage, metadata, and data quality frameworks
* Experience leading cross\-functional teams and engaging with senior stakeholders and executives
* Strong experience in audit management and regulatory reporting
* Master’s degree in computer science, Data Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field
* Data governance certifications (e.g., CDMP, DAMA, DCAM) preferred



  





**Leadership Competencies** 



* Strong influencing and stakeholder management skills at senior and executive levels
* Proven ability to drive organizational change and build data\-driven culture
* Ability to lead and develop high\-performing data governance teams
* Strong strategic thinking combined with hands\-on execution capability

* Act as the primary Wealth Management subject matter expert (SME) across advisory and discretionary portfolio models, client onboarding, KYC, suitability assessments, order management, execution, settlement, corporate actions, performance measurement, and reporting.
* Engage and collaborate with senior client stakeholders such as Wealth Heads, CIOs, COOs, and Product Heads to shape business requirements, validate functional design, and ensure alignment of technology solutions to desired business outcomes.
* Provide functional leadership and guidance across Deloitte delivery teams and client organisations, driving consistent Wealth domain expertise throughout project lifecycles.
* Lead end\-to\-end business analysis activities for Wealth Management programmes, including requirements elicitation workshops, As\-Is and To\-Be process mapping, business rules definition, and functional decomposition and prioritisation.
* Translate complex business strategies, regulatory requirements, and operational needs into clear, actionable functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and detailed functional specifications aligned to Wealth platforms.

* Conduct platform fit\-gap analysis, document and prioritise gaps, and collaborate closely with Engineering and Integration Leads to ensure functional intent is preserved in technical design and delivery.
* Drive pre\-sales activities by leading functional solutioning and business analysis approach definition for RFPs and proposals, including defining functional scope, assumptions, delivery approach, effort estimation, risks, and dependencies; contribute to solution narratives, demo scenarios, and client presentations.
* Act as Functional Design Authority and Business Analysis Lead during delivery, governing requirement change control, scope management, and traceability through build, test, and UAT phases; support UAT planning, execution, and defect triage to ensure delivered solutions meet business objectives, regulatory expectations, and operational readiness.


**Leadership Capabilities**
* Builds own understanding of our purpose and values; explores opportunities for impact.
* Demonstrates strong commitment to personal learning and development; acts as a brand ambassador to help attract top talent.
* Understands expectations and demonstrates personal accountability for keeping performance on track.
* Actively focuses on developing effective communication and relationship\-building skills.
* Understands how their daily work contributes to the priorities of the team and the business.


**Qualifications**
* 10–15\+ years in Wealth Management technology and transformation
* Strong, demonstrable experience playing a Lead Business Analyst role on complex Wealth programmes
* Deep understanding of front\-to\-back Wealth processes
* Experience working with leading Wealth platforms
* Proven ability to translate complex business needs into executable functional designs
* Strong stakeholder facilitation, documentation, and communication skills
* Willingness to travel

**Data Governance Officer** 




  





**Role Summary** 




 The Data Governance Officer is responsible for executing and monitoring data governance policies across the bank to ensure data quality, integrity, and regulatory compliance.
 



 This role acts as a central coordination point for governance activities, supporting data stewards and business units while ensuring alignment with Qatar Central Bank (QCB) regulations and internal standards.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Execute and monitor adherence to data governance policies, standards, and procedures across the organization
* Align data governance practices with Qatar Central Bank (QCB) and other regulatory requirements
* Monitor data quality using automated tools and track key data quality metrics
* Log data quality issues, coordinate root cause analysis, and track remediation with data owners and custodians
* Maintain and validate end\-to\-end data lineage across systems and reporting layers
* Manage and update enterprise data dictionary, business glossary, and metadata repositories
* Support Data Stewards in governance activities and act as a key point of contact across business units
* Prepare and distribute data quality scorecards and governance dashboards to management
* Support enhancements to data governance tools, including user acceptance testing (UAT) and implementation
* Validate data governance and data quality requirements during system or application deployments
* Conduct awareness sessions and training to promote data governance practices across the bank
* Prepare documentation, logs, and evidence required for internal and external audits



  





**Requirements** 



* 8\+ years of experience in data management or data\-related roles
* Minimum 2\+ years of experience in data governance within banking or financial services
* Strong understanding of data governance frameworks, data quality management, and regulatory requirements
* Good understanding of data flows, data lineage, and data lifecycle
* Experience with data cataloging, metadata management, and data quality tools
* Proven experience in tracking data issues, coordinating remediation, and supporting governance processes
* Strong stakeholder management and coordination skills across business and IT teams
* Experience supporting audits and compliance activities is preferred
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Data Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field
* Data governance certifications (e.g., CDMP, DCAM) are preferred

data.jd_text:
**About QNB**
 Established in 1964 as the country’s first Qatari\-owned commercial bank, QNB Group has steadily grown to become the largest bank in the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region.
   

  

 QNB Group’s presence through its subsidiaries and associate companies extends to more than 31 countries across three continents providing a comprehensive range of advanced products and services. The total number of employees is more than 28,000 serving up to 20 million customers operating through 1,000 locations, with an ATM network of 4,300 machines.
   

  

 QNB has maintained its position as one of the highest rated regional banks from leading credit rating agencies including Standard \& Poor’s (A), Moody’s (Aa3\) and Fitch (A\+). The Bank has also been the recipient of many awards from leading international specialised financial publications.
   

  

 Based on the Group’s consistent strong financial performance and its expanding international presence, QNB currently ranks as the most valuable bank brand in the Middle East and Africa, according to Brand Finance Magazine.
   

  

 QNB Group has an active community support program and sponsors various social, educational and sporting events.
   

  

**Job Purpose Summary**
* Responsible for implementation of Target Operating Model (TOM) across the International Branches and Subsidiaries
* Conduct Domain Assessment, Evaluation and Gap Analysis, Regulatory requirements, and report periodically
* Support EVP / direct manager in governance implementation and day\-to\-day governance responsibilities over branches and subsidiaries.
* Assist in reviewing and implementing Policies \& Procedures re\-engineering,
* Coordinate various projects to grow the usage of the Group’s International banking branches / products in line with corporate initiatives.
* Assist in implementing Quality assurance framework in all designated countries.
* Support Domain Owner to Control and Monitor all ongoing implementation of new products, systems and processes in designated countries.


**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities By Dimensions**
* Shareholder \& Financial:
* Provide required information to Domain Owner to Create Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for performance monitoring and quality measurement purposes pertaining to the services / activities performed by the branches and subsidiaries.
* Implements KPI’s and best practices for Assistant Vice President Central Operations Relationship Management
* Act within the limits of the powers delegated to the incumbent and delegate authority to the respective staff and monitor exercise of the same.
* Demonstrate clear understanding of the important factors behind the bank's financial \& non\-financial performance.
* Customer (Internal \& External):
* Instruct and co\-ordinate with the related user departments and International Branches to secure the requirements and schedule for the respective projects/facilities maintenance works execution.
* Co\-ordinate with the Domain Owner plan Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with internal departments/ units to achieve improvements in turnaround time.
* Build and maintain strong and effective relationship with all other related departments and units to achieve the Group’s goals/objectives.
* Internal (Processes, Products, Regulatory):
* Provide required support to international branches/subsidiaries in TOM implementation roll\-out plan in respect to products implementation, operational training and guidance,
* Gather Country specific requirements from international branches/subsidiaries in initiation of new business opening.
* Review Business Requirements draft \& branch procedures received from related parties and provide review input and obtain approvals from stakeholders when required.
* Ensure International branches/subsidiaries are reporting Daily, Weekly and Monthly operational activities, monitor the reports, and take necessary action if required.
* Monitor and escalate compliance related issues to Group Compliance and communicate Business decision to relevant international unit.
* Coordinate in all banking projects for various corporate initiatives including acquisition conversions, systems changes, new products, services, and product enhancements.
* Ensure direct oversight of high\-volume activity, consistently complex issues and/ or high\-level risk and exposure items that have a significant impact on the achievement of the objectives of the department and potentially the International Operations Department.
* Support in efficiency management, quality improvement, and system optimization projects.
* Effectively interact with other operating units, managers and stakeholders.
* Coordinate and guide International Branches and Subsidiaries to take necessary action on Internal/External audit observation, recommendation within target date until closure.
* Periodic visit to international branches and assess respective domains are in line. Continuous improvement
* Set examples by leading improvement initiatives through cross\-functional teams ensuring successes.
* Identify and encourage people to adopt practices better than the industry standard.
* Continuously encourage and recognize the importance of thinking out\-of\-the\-box within the team.
* Encourage, solicit and reward innovative ideas even in day\-to\-day issues.
* Learning \& Knowledge:
* Provide direct support and guidance to project managers, supervisors, and analysts to international branch users.
* Maintain a high level of knowledge about electronic banking, Core Banking and its processes, international regulations, and generally accepted operating practices. Research industry topics and react by recommending changes to products, services, and systems
* Hold meetings with staff and assess their performance and your team's overall performance on a regular basis.
* Take decisive action to ensure speedy resolution of unresolved grievances or conflicts within the team members.
* Identify development opportunities and activities for staff and facilitate/coach them to improve their effectives and prepare them to assume greater responsibilities.
* Legal, Regulatory, and Risk Framework Responsibilities:
* Comply with all applicable legal, regulatory and internal compliance requirements including, but not limited to, Group Compliance Policies and Procedures (AML \& CTF, Sanctions Policy, Data Protection Policy, Fraud Control Policy, Whistle Blowing Policy, Conflict of Interest and Insider Dealing Policy).
* Understand and effectively perform your role under the Three Lines of Defense principle to identify measure, monitor, manage and report risks.
* Ensure systematic good outcomes for clients in accordance with Conduct Risk policy.
* Support the framework of RCSA, KRI, Incident reporting and remediation, as appropriate, in accordance with the Operational Risk Management requirements.
* Maintain appropriate knowledge to ensure full qualification to undertake the role.
* Complete all mandatory training provided by the Bank, attain, and maintain the required levels of competence.
* Attend mandatory (internal and external) seminars as instructed by the Bank.
* Other:
* Ensure high standards of data protection and confidentiality to safeguard commercially sensitive information.
* Maintaining utmost confidentiality concerning customer and internal bank information obtained during the course of business and provide such information on a need\-to\-know basis only to Senior Management of QNB, Audit and Compliance functions, and relevant Regulators.
* Maintain high professional standards to uphold QNB's reputation and to strengthen its market leadership position.
* All other ad hoc duties/activities related to QNB that management might request from time to time.


**Education/Experience Requirements**
* Bachelors University graduate preferably with a Major in Marketing, Banking, Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration or Information Technology (related field of study), Masters preferred
* 10 years of experience of Electronic Banking \& Operations experience of which at least 5 years in managing International Operations.
* Full Banking Operational knowledge and experiences to guide all International Branches from opening to going live and continuous support.
* Full Compliance expertise to meet Regulatory requirements in International Branches
* High\-level document writing capability such as, Business requirements, Procedure and guidance document for all products and Branches position levels.


 Note: you will be required to attach the following:
   

  

* Resume/CV
* Passport
* Educational Certificates

**About QNB**
 Established in 1964 as the country’s first Qatari\-owned commercial bank, QNB Group has steadily grown to become the largest bank in the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region.
   

  

 QNB Group’s presence through its subsidiaries and associate companies extends to more than 31 countries across three continents providing a comprehensive range of advanced products and services. The total number of employees is more than 28,000 serving up to 20 million customers operating through 1,000 locations, with an ATM network of 4,300 machines.
   

  

 QNB has maintained its position as one of the highest rated regional banks from leading credit rating agencies including Standard \& Poor’s (A), Moody’s (Aa3\) and Fitch (A\+). The Bank has also been the recipient of many awards from leading international specialised financial publications.
   

  

 Based on the Group’s consistent strong financial performance and its expanding international presence, QNB currently ranks as the most valuable bank brand in the Middle East and Africa, according to Brand Finance Magazine.
   

  

 QNB Group has an active community support program and sponsors various social, educational and sporting events.
   

  

**Job Purpose Summary**
 The role is primarily responsible for carrying out the preliminary financial and industry analysis for the existing and prospective clients handled by the Corporate and Institutional Banking Business, in adherence to the Credit Policy Guidelines and the Standardized Procedures. The role is also responsible for supporting the Relationship Managers in conducting the preliminary review of AML/KYC documents for the existing and New\-To\-Bank clients, besides providing the proactive and effective support to the Relationship Managers by liaising with internal support units/stakeholders, to ensure “the best customer experience, higher share of client’s wallet and development of the portfolio”. This position is expected to act as Backup Resource for Relationship Managers in their absence, and thus is expected to gain full knowledge over the complete range of Products and Services offered by QNB Group. These will typically include credit, trade, transaction banking and deposit services, as well as international transactions or other specialised services.
   

  

 Main Duties
   

  

* Shareholder \& Financial:
* Proactively assist the Relationship Managers in undertaking the Financial and Industry (Sectoral) analysis, so as to complete the New \& Review/Renewal Credit appraisals in time.
* Proactively undertake the Internal Obligor Risk Ratings, feed the same in Bank’s internal/external rating tools to develop the Rating Reports and Spreadsheets.
* Proactively support the Business Unit in reviewing the client’s constitutive documents to uphold and monitor full adherence and compliance with the prevailing best corporate banking practices.
* Proactively support the Business Unit/Relationship Managers in liaising with the internal Support Units for quick and smooth delivery of services.
* Proactively assist in the implementation of the strategies and plans to achieve all volume, revenue, development and profit targets for the Business Unit’s customer portfolio.
* Observes and promotes cost consciousness and efficiency, and enhance productivity, to minimize costs, avoid wastes, and optimize benefits for the bank.
* Proactively support the Business Unit in the development of Key Performance Indicators for the purpose of systematic performance monitoring and quality measurement of the Business Unit’s function, customer portfolio development and the monitoring of achievements.
* Act within the limits of the powers delegated to the incumbent and adheres to QNB policies
* Customer (Internal \& External):
* Proactively support the Business Unit in maintaining and developing customer relationships, acting as an alternative to Relationship Managers, as may be required.
* Proactively support the Business Unit in dealing with and resolving customer problems and requirements, in coordination with appropriate in house and external support functions, to ensure timely, friendly and accurate responses and provision of Bank products / services.
* Provide timely and accurate information to the external and internal auditors and Corporate Banking’s compliance function, as and when required.
* Build and maintain strong and effective relationships with all other related functions / units to assist in the achievement of the Corporate Banking’s goals and objectives.
* Internal (Processes, Products, Regulatory):
* Proactively support the Business Unit to develop and manage on a day\-to\-day basis both potential new customer targets and existing customers to meet assigned financial and non\-financial targets, in compliance with QNB policies and procedures, regulations and prevailing best practices.
* Assist the Business Unit to prepare comprehensive credit proposals for new / prospective customers that adequately address all relevant risk factors and satisfy minimum acceptable standards of QNB corporate credit.
* Assist the Business Unit to prepare comprehensive credit reviews for existing customer facilities, at least one month before limit expiry, that adequately address all relevant and current risk factors and the latest developments in the industry, market and business.
* Assist the Business Unit to identify and timely report on all negative events and early signals on potentially problematic accounts / relationships.
* Assist the Business Unit to maintain the timely review of credit applications and documents within set turn\-around time, in coordination with Credit Risk. Support the RMs, Unit Heads and others as requested, in identifying weak aspects of the credit applications.
* Assist the Business Unit in monitoring the customer credit positions for full compliance with set limits and QNB’s Investment and Credit Strategy.
* Support the Business Unit in the preparation of periodic Management and Business Information reports to executive management, as requested.
* In the absence of Credit Admin Role:
* Liaise with HO credit admin on the credit documentation meeting the terms \& conditions as per approval.
* Seek HO Credit Admin acknowledgment when needed for collaterals submitted and supporting documents.
* Seek HO Credit Admin Review and have the checklist completed for Credit Operations to complete the remaining tasks
* To assist customers in all their queries on Bank’s product and seek solution to their requests
* Maintain activities in accordance with Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with internal departments/ units to achieve improvements in turn\-around time.
* Build and maintain strong and effective relationship with all other related departments and units to achieve the Group’s goals/objectives.
* Provide timely and accurate information to the external and internal Auditors, Compliance, Financial Control and Risk Functions as and when required.
* Learning \& Knowledge:
* Possess good knowledge of the corporate banking business; its products and services, related risks, documentation, regulatory requirements and report preparation together with a superior knowledge of controls.
* Develop a good knowledge of QNB Oman’s portfolio of customer’s business and needs.
* Possess good IT skills to be able to compose correspondence and reports using standard Bank platform and applications.
* Takes responsibility for self\-development as well as acquiring skills and knowledge required to fulfilment of one's duties by proactively identifying areas for professional development of self and undertake development activities

We are a leading independent telecoms infrastructure company, with one of the most extensive tower portfolios across Africa and the Middle East. Our business model promotes tower infrastructure sharing and enables mobile network operators (MNOs) to deliver mobile connectivity more quickly, reliably, cost\-effectively and with a lower carbon footprint. In turn, this supports the expansion and quality of mobile connectivity, driving sustainable development in our markets.
   

  

**What We Do**
 We build, acquire, lease\-up and operate telecommunications towers that can accommodate and power the needs of multiple tenants. Our tenants are the major Mobile Network Operators (MNOs) and we serve them across nine high\-growth markets (8 in Africa and Oman in the Middle East). Our purpose, mission and sustainable business strategy are underpinned by our values of integrity, partnership and excellence.
   

  

**Overview**
 Reporting to the Group Director of SOC \& Systems (or relevant Group Operations leader), you will play a pivotal role in leading the transformation of a distributed, multi\-market NOC environment into a digitally enabled Smart Operating Centre.
   

  

 This is a Group\-level transformation leadership role responsible for embedding governance discipline, strengthening cross\-market accountability, integrating core operational systems, and delivering measurable improvements in uptime, energy efficiency, SLA compliance and operational performance across nine markets.
   

  

**Location** 
 : Dubai
   

  

**Role Responsibilities**
 As the Group SOC \& Systems Senior Manager, you will be responsible for:
   

  

* Leading the transformation and standardisation of multi\-OpCo NOC operations into a unified Smart Operating Centre model
* Embedding structured governance frameworks, escalation discipline and audit trail compliance across all markets
* Driving integration across RMS, ServiceNow, ERP, ICCP and workforce management platforms to create a single operational view
* Strengthening incident management processes, improving MTTR and ensuring SLA\-driven operational excellence
* Enhancing real\-time telemetry utilisation, alarm\-to\-action automation and predictive analytics capabilities
* Managing and influencing cross\-market stakeholders and third\-party field service partners without direct line authority
* Improving uptime engineering, energy optimisation and fuel governance across site portfolios
* Establishing clear accountability frameworks, KPIs and operational value metrics (e.g. truck roll reduction, SLA penalty avoidance, fuel efficiency)
* Translating technical operational issues into financial and business impact for executive stakeholders


**Requirements For The Role**
 To succeed in this role, you will have:
   

  

* At least 10 years’ experience in infrastructure or mission\-critical operations, including NOC, SOC or control centre environments
* Demonstrable experience leading multi\-country or multi\-site operational environments
* Strong expertise in real\-time telemetry, alarm environments, incident management and SLA\-driven operations
* Experience integrating or optimising platforms such as RMS, ServiceNow, ERP, ICCP or workforce management systems
* Proven ability to embed governance discipline, structured escalation frameworks and operational accountability across complex organisations
* Experience managing outsourced field service ecosystems and third\-party partners

 Run gap, impact, and feasibility analysis, and surface risks and dependencies early
   

 Maintain requirements traceability from need through to delivered feature
   

 Partner with product, architecture, and engineering, and support user acceptance testing

data.jd_text:
The Director of Engineering is responsible for the strategic leadership, operational management, and continuous improvement of all engineering functions within the hotel. This role oversees the maintenance and reliability of the property's physical assets, including building infrastructure, mechanical, electrical, plumbing (MEP) systems, HVAC, fire and life safety systems, energy management systems, and all back\-of\-house facilities.
 



  





 The incumbent ensures that all engineering operations support the delivery of exceptional guest experiences while maintaining the highest standards of safety, regulatory compliance, sustainability, and financial performance. The Director of Engineering develops long\-term asset management strategies, leads capital improvement initiatives, and drives preventive and predictive maintenance programs to maximize equipment reliability and lifecycle value.
 



  





 As a member of the Executive Committee, the Director of Engineering collaborates closely with hotel leadership to align engineering objectives with overall business goals and serves as the lead coordinator for emergency preparedness and response activities related to facility operations.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Engineering Operations \& Technical Leadership** 




  




* Provide strategic leadership and oversight of all engineering and maintenance operations across the property.
* Direct the operation, maintenance, and optimization of HVAC systems, chillers, cooling towers, boilers, refrigeration systems, electrical distribution networks, generators, UPS systems, plumbing infrastructure, water treatment systems, swimming pool systems, kitchen and laundry equipment, elevators, and Building Management Systems (BMS).
* Establish and implement preventive and predictive maintenance programs to ensure optimal equipment reliability and minimize operational disruptions.
* Monitor engineering performance indicators, identify opportunities for improvement, and implement corrective actions to enhance operational efficiency.
* Ensure all engineering activities comply with established Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and manufacturer recommendations.



  





**Asset Management \& Capital Planning** 




  




* Develop and execute long\-term engineering strategies aligned with the hotel's business objectives and brand standards.
* Lead the development and execution of the annual Engineering Business Plan and departmental objectives.
* Prepare, justify, and manage the annual engineering operating budget and capital expenditure plans.
* Develop and maintain a 5 to 10\-year asset replacement strategy for major plant and equipment.
* Manage renovation projects, equipment upgrades, and capital improvement initiatives from planning through commissioning.
* Supervise contractors, consultants, and project teams to ensure projects are completed safely, on time, within budget, and to required specifications.



  





**Financial Management** 




  




* Monitor departmental expenditures and maintain effective control over engineering operating costs.
* Analyze financial reports, payroll summaries, utility consumption trends, and P\&L statements to identify areas for optimization.
* Implement cost\-saving initiatives related to energy consumption, maintenance practices, procurement strategies, and service agreements.
* Ensure effective inventory management and control of engineering tools, spare parts, and consumables.
* Contribute to the annual budgeting and forecasting process.



  





**Energy \& Sustainability Management** 




  




* Lead energy conservation initiatives aimed at reducing utility consumption while maintaining guest comfort and operational efficiency.
* Monitor and optimize electricity, water, gas, and fuel usage through data\-driven analysis and system enhancements.
* Promote sustainable engineering practices and support environmental initiatives aligned with corporate sustainability objectives.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend improvements that enhance operational performance and reduce environmental impact.



  





**Fire, Life Safety \& Regulatory Compliance** 




  




* Ensure full compliance with all applicable local regulations, Qatar Civil Defence requirements, health and safety standards, environmental regulations, and hotel brand standards.
* Maintain the operational readiness of all fire detection, fire suppression, emergency lighting, evacuation, and life safety systems.
* Oversee the testing, inspection, certification, and maintenance of all statutory systems and equipment.
* Ensure all permits, licenses, certifications, and maintenance records remain current and readily available for audit purposes.
* Serve as the Chairperson of the Emergency Response Team and lead preparedness planning for facility\-related emergencies.



  





**Team Leadership \& Talent Development** 




  




* Lead, mentor, and develop the engineering management team and technical staff to foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Establish clear performance expectations and conduct regular performance evaluations.
* Identify training needs and facilitate technical and leadership development initiatives.
* Promote a safe working environment through effective implementation of health and safety practices.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, labor regulations, and disciplinary procedures.
* Encourage employee engagement through open communication, recognition programs, and succession planning initiatives.



  





**Guest Experience \& Service Excellence** 




  




* Support hotel operations by ensuring all guest\-facing facilities remain in excellent working condition.
* Respond proactively to engineering\-related guest concerns and implement corrective measures to prevent recurrence.
* Collaborate with operational departments to minimize disruption during maintenance activities.
* Drive initiatives that enhance comfort, reliability, and overall guest satisfaction through engineering excellence.



  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 




  





**Education** 




  




* Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Building Services Engineering, Facilities Management, or a related discipline from an accredited institution.
* Professional certifications in HVAC, electrical systems, facilities management, energy management, or project management will be considered an advantage.



  





**Experience** 




  




* Minimum of 8–10 years of progressive engineering experience within luxury hospitality environments, including at least 3–5 years in a senior engineering leadership role.
* Proven experience managing large\-scale hotel engineering operations, preferably within internationally recognized five\-star hotels or resorts.
* Demonstrated expertise in preventive maintenance programs, asset lifecycle management, and capital project execution.
* Experience managing engineering budgets, utility optimization programs, and vendor relationships.



  





**Technical Competencies** 




  




* Strong knowledge of HVAC systems, refrigeration plants, electrical distribution systems, plumbing systems, water treatment processes, fire and life safety systems, Building Management Systems (BMS), and Energy Management Systems (EMS).
* Familiarity with Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS).
* Thorough understanding of Qatar Civil Defence regulations, local statutory requirements, and international hospitality engineering standards.
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, technical manuals, and financial reports.



  





**Leadership Competencies** 




  




* Strategic thinking and business acumen.
* Strong decision\-making and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Excellent project management and organizational skills.
* Effective communication and stakeholder management abilities.
* Demonstrated ability to lead high\-performing teams in a fast\-paced hospitality environment.
* Commitment to service excellence, continuous improvement, and operational integrity

data.jd_text:
**About the Company**
 Careem is building the Everything App for the greater Middle East — making it easy to move around, order food and groceries, manage payments, and more. Our purpose is simple: to simplify and improve people’s lives and build an awesome organisation that inspires.
   

  

 Since 2012, Careem has enabled earnings for over 2\.5 million Captains, simplified the lives of more than 70 million customers, and built a platform where the region’s best talent and entrepreneurs thrive. We operate in 70\+ cities across 10 countries, from Morocco to Pakistan.
   

  

***We’re now entering our next chapter — one powered by AI. We’re looking for AI talent: curious problem\-solvers who know how to apply AI to build tools, automate workflows, and create real impact. Whether it’s streamlining operations, enhancing customer experience, or reimagining internal systems — we want people who can make Careem work smarter and move faster.***
**The mission**
 We believe the transformative potential of AI is significantly under\-realised in our region. To bridge this gap, we are incubating a new division within Careem dedicated to Enterprise AI Transformation.
   

  

 We are reimagining and building the future of work to simplify and improve how businesses function in the era of GenAI with WorkOS: a next\-generation ‘operating system’ designed to deploy, orchestrate, and improve AI agents across every customer and operational journey (and increasingly autonomously). This isn’t just automation; it’s about creating a hybrid workforce where self\-learning AI agents handle the heavy lifting, empowering our people to focus on the highest\-value, most creative work.
   

  

**The team**
 This group operates as a
 **startup within Careem** 
 with a distinct mandate: move fast, build boldly, and deliver production\-grade AI systems that fundamentally change how the region leverages technology.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are looking for a
 **Founding Forward Deployed Engineer \- WorkOS \- Enterprise Agentic AI** 
 to be the vanguard of the WorkOS mission. This is a role for a "heretic": someone who cares more about solving the problem and delivering value than following a rigid spec. You will be the bridge between our core AI engine and the messy, high\-stakes reality of our customers’ operations.
   

  

 As an FDE, you aren't sitting in the back office; you are on the front lines, embedded with internal Careem verticals and external enterprise partners. In partnership with your implementation squad, consisting also of business transformation consultants, you will identify their deepest friction points and build the "special ops" code that proves the power of WorkOS. Your work is the proof of concept that will redefine how the region works.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Tip of the Spear: Lead the deployment of WorkOS in the field. You will be responsible for understanding a customer's operational "chaos" and architecting an AI\-driven solution that fixes it in weeks, not months.
* Rapid\-Fire Execution: Build, iterate, and ship. You will write high\-quality, full\-stack code to create bespoke integrations and augment our platform’s core capabilities and create custom agents. This goes beyond context engineering; you’ll build the connective tissue \- integrating bespoke APIs, setting up RAGs and Evals, tuning the E2E system and performance, and architecting multi\-agent handoffs.
* Feedback Loop Mastery: You are the eyes and ears of the product team. You will translate field\-tested insights into core product requirements, ensuring WorkOS remains grounded in real\-world utility.
* Winning Stakeholders: Act as the technical face of WorkOS. You’ll need to win the trust of stakeholders, navigate complex enterprise hierarchies, and persuade skeptics by shipping results that speak for themselves.
* Technical Versatility: One day you’re setting up a RAG pipeline; the next, you’re debugging a legacy enterprise API or designing a custom dashboard. You do whatever is necessary to make the solution land.


**What You’ll Need**
* 5–8\+ years of high\-octane engineering experience. You are likely a senior\-level engineer who is "hungrier" than your peers and bored by traditional, slow\-moving dev cycles.
* The FDE Pedigree: Experience in forward\-deployed, mission\-driven environments (e.g., Palantir, high\-growth startups, or specialized consultancy) where you worked directly with customers.
* Full\-Stack Polyglot: Mastery of the modern stack (React/TS, Python/Node) with the ability to jump into any codebase and be productive on day one.
* AI Fluidity: Strong working knowledge of LLMs, prompt engineering, and agentic frameworks. You don't just know the theory; you know how to make AI work in production.
* Excellent Communication: You are a "social engineer." You can explain complex AI logic to a CEO and then pivot to a deep\-dive session with an infrastructure lead without missing a beat.
* Relentless Bias for Action: You are a builder who values shipping over perfection. You have a "founder\-level" sense of ownership and aren't afraid to get your hands dirty.
* Willingness to work on\-site full time in UAE, with occasional travel to be embedded with regional partners.


**What You’ll Receive**
* A Blank Canvas and Live Ammunition: The rare opportunity to build a "0\-to\-1" product while immediately deploying it into the real\-world operations of a regional giant. No "sandbox" projects here, you’ll be shipping code that moves people and goods on day one. This is a huge opportunity to create impact in our region.
* A Special Ops Mission: We’re a lean, impact\-obsessed team operating with total autonomy. You’ll be free from corporate bureaucracy and legacy baggage, focused entirely on winning the customer and solving "unsolvable" problems.
* Direct Collaboration with Leadership: Direct engagement with Careem and enterprise client leadership, in addition to working side\-by\-side with the WorkOS founding team including Magnus Olsson (Careem’s original Co\-founder).
* Competitive Compensation: Including direct equity in this new division. Our philosophy is meritocratic: we want you to own a meaningful stake in the value you create.


**What We’ll Provide You**
 We offer colleagues the opportunity to drive impact in the region while they learn and grow. As a full time Careem colleague, you will be able to:
   

  

* Work and learn from great minds by joining a community of inspiring colleagues.
* Put your passion to work in a purposeful organisation dedicated to creating impact in a region with a lot of untapped potential.
* Explore new opportunities to learn and grow every day.
* Work remotely from any country in the world for 30 days a year with unlimited vacation days per year.
* Access to healthcare benefits and fitness reimbursements for health activities including gym, health club, and training classes.
